title: Backend Engineer - Data (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Alcemy
description_html:
Berlin Mitte · Hybrid (up to 2 days/week remote) · €60,000–75,000 + VSOP equity


Help us decarbonize cement and concrete - not tomorrow, today

alcemy is on a mission to keep 100 million tons of CO₂ out of the atmosphere every year by 2030. Making concrete accounts for around 8% of global CO₂ emissions, and our machine-learning software runs inside cement and concrete plants 24/7 to cut it - without sacrificing quality or driving up costs. We're already live in a third of Germany's cement plants and 30+ ready-mix concrete plants.

The role

You'll own the systems that get plant data into alcemy.

That data comes from external partners, and it arrives messy. You'll build and own the APIs and services that take it in, make sense of it, and feed the machine-learning models behind our recommendations - designing those systems, deploying them, keeping them running, and diagnosing what went wrong when something upstream changes without warning.

It's a backend engineering role with a data problem at the centre of it, and it's refreshingly hands-on with customers: you'll dig into real-world data, explain what you find to non-technical people, and make getting data into alcemy dramatically easier.

What you need is solid production Python, the ability to run what you build, and comfort talking to the people on the other end of the pipe.

What you'll do

  • Own the data ingestion systems that bring messy plant data from external partners into something our ML can use
  • Build and improve our ingestion APIs, moving us from strict, structured data requirements toward flexible, AI-powered ingestion — so customers onboard with far less friction
  • Deploy, monitor and troubleshoot your systems in production, diagnosing and fixing issues when something upstream changes without warning
  • Track down data anomalies and explain your findings to customers in plain language
  • Build and maintain the APIs and PostgreSQL databases behind our products, and keep production running smoothly
  • Work shoulder to shoulder with external partners, customers, sales and customer success - translating between the technical and the non-technical
  • Collaborate with the product team on backend work

Requirements

You'll thrive here if... above all, you care about climate change and want your work to count.

Must-haves

  • You've deployed production-grade Python applications
  • You know how to deploy, monitor and troubleshoot production systems in a cloud environment
  • You communicate clearly in writing and in conversation, and you collaborate well across roles
  • You're comfortable working directly with customers, sales and customer success - patient, plain-spoken, and at ease with non-technical enterprise teams
  • You pick up unfamiliar codebases quickly, and you're keen to contribute early
  • You're open to using AI tools to augment how you work

Nice-to-haves

  • Exposure to machine learning or data pipeline projects
  • Experience with FastAPI, Flask or Django
  • PostgreSQL or similar SQL databases
  • Experience designing or maintaining integrations with third-party or partner systems


Don't tick every box? We'd still love to hear from you.


How we work

You won't be working alone - you'll build collaboratively alongside senior and junior engineers, owning features end to end: build, test, review, deploy.

Small team, direct customer exposure, fast startup pace - so async communication, clear prioritisation, transparency, and direct feedback are the norm, and how we work is something we shape together, and keep improving.

We use Claude Code responsibly: AI to move fast, engineers always in charge and accountable, no AI-slop merge requests.

We'll ask you to be flexible. We don't have fixed teams or fixed projects here. As the business shifts, we'll ask you to move to where the work matters most and pick up new problems. If you enjoy variety and switching between problems, you'll do well here.

Hybrid by design (Berlin Mitte office, up to 2 days remote, plus offsites and boat trips), with real room to grow along technical-expert or management tracks - and the chance to lead a product area within a couple of years.

Benefits

    • 25 days' vacation - plus an extra day for every 2 years here, and the days between Christmas and New Year off
    • €1,500/year and 3 days/quarter for your own development
    • The Mac of your choice
    • An office in the heart of Berlin Mitte


Our Tech Stack

    • Backend & data: Python throughout - FastAPI (auto-generated Swagger/OpenAPI), SQLAlchemy, pydantic, pytest, mypy; pandas, polars, numpy, sklearn; uv for dependencies
    • Infra: PostgreSQL, AWS on Kubernetes managed with Terraform, ArgoWorkflows for scheduled jobs, GitLab for code
    • Frontend: React & Next.js in TypeScript with TailwindCSS; Blueprint.js / Radix UI; TanStack Query or axios; Streamlit for internal tools


Our Hiring Process is fully remote

    1. Intro call with our Recruiter
    2. Meet our Hiring Manager
    3. A take-home task that mirrors the real work you'd be doing
    4. Technical interview (90 min) with two engineers, including 30 min of live coding
    5. Team-fit interview (45 min) with two future teammates


At alcemy, we're building a team as diverse as the industry we're transforming. We welcome applications from everyone and assess every candidate on merit alone - regardless of gender, age, ethnic or national origin, religion or worldview, disability, sexual orientation, or gender identity. We especially encourage people who are underrepresented in tech to apply. If you need any adjustments to take part fully in our hiring process, just let us know and we'll make them.


Note: We don't currently offer visa sponsorship, so you'll need a valid EU work visa.

title: Legal Specialist Tech & Data (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Neon
description_html:
Overview

NEON is a highly specialized business law firm providing advice at the highest level. We embrace shared entrepreneurship, are more than just colleagues, and love what we do. Our teams – including Venture Capital, Private Equity, Litigation, Real Estate, Tax, and Tech & Data – deliver holistic advice and work closely together.
 Our focus is on the legal support of entrepreneurial projects – from investments and transactions to the development of new business models, the structuring of complex commercial arrangements, and the legal enablement of digital innovation.
Our Tech & Data Team advises national and international clients on legal issues relating to data protection, IT law, AI, digital business models and the regulatory requirements of an increasingly digital economy. We help innovative companies navigate complex legal frameworks and enable technological progress through practical legal advice.
Are you looking for a position that allows you to pursue your legal career ambitions while benefiting from predictable working hours and more time for your personal life? 

We offer a great alternative.

To join our team, we are looking for a


Your mission

You are passionate about the intersection of law andtechnology and want to deepen your legal expertise in these areas.  
As a Legal Specialist in our Tech & Data team, you will work on a broad range of matters relating to data protection, IT law, artificial intelligence and digital business models and take ownership of legal tasks to actively contribute to the successful delivery of our client matters. Working closely with a highly specialized team, you will gain insight into some of the most dynamic developments at the intersection of law, technology and business. 
Unlike a traditional Associate role, your focus will not be on transactions. Instead, you will take ownership of clearly defined areas of responsibility and recurring legal matters that allow for a predictable and manageable workload while still offering work on champions league level.


What we offer

  • Flexible working time models (Full-time or Part-time, with adjustable weekly working days), clearly defined working hours to help you plan your life and ensure a steady, predictable workload 
  • Independent but clearly scoped areas of responsibility 
  • Involvement in client work from day one, supported by your team lead
  • A respectful and vibrant company culture (team-lunches, after-work events, many firm activities…)
  • A healthy balance between work, family, and personal life


Your profile

  • You have successfully completed both German State Examinations in Law (at least 18 points in total)
  • A genuine interest in Tech & Data – including data protection, IT and software law – ideally with first practical experience in these fields
  • Curiosity for technology (AI, software contracts, cloud computing, and digital business models) and enthusiasm for solving legal challenges around digital innovation
  • You have a quick mind, can think outside the box and enjoy working in a team
  • Excellent German and strong English skills complete your profile

title: Werkstudent*in Finance Projects & Systems (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at OXG Glasfaser GmbH
description_html:
Was diesen Job so besonders macht?

Du möchtest bereits während deines Studiums praktische Erfahrungen sammeln und an anspruchsvollen Finanzprojekten mitwirken? Dann werde Teil unseres Teams Finance Projects & Systems und unterstütze uns bei Projekten im Finanz- und SAP-Umfeld.
Je nach deinen Interessen, Kenntnissen und Fähigkeiten übernimmst du sowohl operative Aufgaben im SAP-Umfeld als auch Tätigkeiten im Projektmanagement. Gemeinsam finden wir Aufgaben, die zu dir passen und dir die Möglichkeit geben, dich fachlich und persönlich weiterzuentwickeln.
 
Deine Aufgaben:

  • Unterstützung unseres Teams bei der Umsetzung strategischer Finance-Projekte, z. B. bei der Weiterentwicklung unseres SAP S/4HANA-Systems
  • Eigenständige Mitarbeit in der Administration der SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud, insbesondere:
    • Benutzerverwaltung
    • Stammdatenmanagement
    • Prozessdokumentation
  • Unterstützung bei der Koordination und Kommunikation mit unseren SAP Key Usern, sowie weiteren Ansprechpersonen in unseren Fachabteilungen (z.B. Accounting, Controlling, Procurement, Treasury) und mit unseren externen Implementierungspartnern.


Wann passt Du zu uns?

  • Du bist immatrikuliert und studierst idealerweise Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Wirtschaftsinformatik, BWL oder einen vergleichbaren Studiengang. Themen wie Finanzprozesse, Digitalisierung/KI-Transformation und moderne ERP-Systeme (SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud Edition) interessieren dich.

title: Working Student System Administration (all genders)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Helpling
description_html:
YOUR IMPACT - YOUR ROLE

Show us how you rock IT!

You juggle bits and bytes while others are still looking for their coffee cups? Then join our dynamic and modern company, where innovation and agility are lived. With us, you will have the opportunity to develop your skills further and be part of an international team.

For this, we are looking for you as our Working Student System Administration (all genders).

Your mission in detail:

  • As our Working Student System Administration, you are the contact person for all hardware and software problems and support the Helpling team with questions regarding the IT infrastructure in our Berlin office.

  • You support the provisioning and maintenance of our Windows- and OSX-based environment and help provide your colleagues with high-speed, bugless equipment.

  • You help manage our local networks and support troubleshooting, analysis, and documentation.

  • You bring your own ideas to improve existing workflows through customized automation.

  • You help ward off cyber attacks, create backups, and contribute to our overall IT security.


WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED

A vocational training or degree is not the most important thing to us. We value your experience and are therefore looking for practically-versed, plug-and-play heroes with versatile IT knowledge who are currently enrolled at a university.

  • You are familiar with help desk user support, Google Workspace, setting up VLAN and VPN, as well as Windows and OSX systems, and ideally, you even bring first knowledge of a programming language.

  • You are reliable, motivated, and effortlessly juggle multiple inquiries at the same time.

  • You live in Berlin/Brandenburg and value our beautiful office in Berlin Mitte as your second 127.0.0.1

  • You are enrolled as a student throughout your time with us and can work up to 20 hours per week.

  • German language skills are a plus, very good English is a must.


WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM US

Flexibility: Flexible working & an office in Berlin Mitte for networking and socializing

Personal development: you work in a small team that gives you the opportunity to bring in your individual strengths and ideas and actively shape the future of Helpling.

Growth: define your individual growth path with the help of our feedback cycle, leadership workshops, book club, or lunch & learns

Vacation: up to 30 vacation days per year, depending on length of service. In addition, we give away up to 10 additional vacation days per year in cool campaigns, e.g., advent calendar or health challenges

Family & Career: we pay you 5 additional child sick days per year when your child needs you

Company Pension Scheme: with up to 20% employer contribution

Focus on the essentials, we'll take care of the rest: we offer you a discount for your own domestic help via Helpling.de


APPLY NOW

If this role sounds like you, then send us your application documents, including your availability and proof of current enrollment.

We would like to encourage you to apply even if you do not yet meet 100% of our expectations listed above. For us, your personality and motivation are just as important as your professional qualifications.

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, regardless of gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, national origin, migration history, marital status, age, or disability.

Das bringst du mit

Fachliche Kompetenz, Kommunikationsstärke und die Bereitschaft, dich in neue Themen einzuarbeiten, sind für uns genauso wichtig wie deine Freude an Zusammenarbeit und daran, gemeinsam gute Lösungen zu entwickeln. Dabei ist uns besonders wichtig:

So arbeiten wir

Du übernimmst Verantwortung und kannst dich aktiv einbringen. Gemeinsam mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen aus unterschiedlichen Fachrichtungen entwickelst du Lösungen für komplexe Fragestellungen und hast die Möglichkeit, dich fachlich und persönlich weiterzuentwickeln.

salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Tanso
description_html:
Become part of Tanso and decarbonize industries with us.

What if the impact of your role extended beyond a job title?

Not through marketing spin. Not through vague "purpose-driven" messaging. But through software that helps industrial companies understand, manage and actively reduce their environmental impact.

That's what Tanso is building. And it's one of the reasons people join us.


Why Tanso?

  • Take Action in a Fast-Moving, High-Impact Environment. We move fast on sustainability because the urgency is real. That means decisions that matter, transparent processes, and the agility to navigate change.
  • Challenge & Grow Through Ownership. Take ownership immediately, build expertise through hands-on experience, and leverage every available resource to achieve outsized impact.
  • Foster Trust with Mission-Driven Collaborators. You'll join a team that prioritizes impact and each other. We give honest feedback, share credit, support each other when it matters, and hold high standards together.
  • Embrace Responsibility & Drive Impact. Turn fragmented emissions data into actionable insights. Your work has immediate, visible impact - clearer decision-making and genuine momentum toward change.
  • AI First-Mindset. We embrace cutting-edge technology to solve sustainability challenges. Push the boundaries of innovation and stay ahead of what's possible.
  • Commitment to Performance & Excellence. We cultivate a high-performance culture where you thrive. Push yourself and others to excel, celebrate wins, learn from setbacks, and raise the bar.


Your role

To take real ownership of what you build and take own end-to-end feature responsibility, we are looking for a Software Engineer (f/m/x). 

As a Software Engineer (m/f/x)  you will work on meaningful customer-facing problems within one of our platform modules and collaborate closely with product, design, customer success, and other engineers.

At Tanso, engineers are responsible understanding the problem, challenging assumptions, shaping the solution, making technical trade-offs, shipping to production, and iterating based on what we learn. We care less about following a predefined playbook and more about making good decisions, moving with purpose, and building software that creates tangible value for our customers.


Key responsibilities

  • Own customer-facing features from problem definition through implementation, rollout, and iteration.
  • Turn ambiguous requirements and user needs into pragmatic, maintainable solutions. Challenge assumptions and help decide what is worth building
  • Collaborate closely with product designers and customer success to understand user needs and shape effective solutions.
  • Contribute to the quality of our codebase, engineering practices, and developer experience.


Your profile

  • You have 2+ years of professional software engineering experience building and shipping production software in Typescript.
  • Strong full-stack and product thinking, understanding systems end-to-end.
  • First experience with backend development, ideally with PostgreSQL and Azure.
  • Clear, precise communicator in English. 
  • Self-driven problem solver with strong ownership and execution mindset.
Nice to have
  • German language skills. 


What we offer

  • A highly competitive compensation package with an attractive equity package to participate in Tanso's growth. 
  • Hybrid working model that combines the benefits of onsite collaboration with the flexibility needed. 
  • A company-contributed pension plan to support long-term financial security. 
  • Yearly budget to support ongoing professional development. 
  • Sponsored access to EGYM Wellpass to prioritize your wellbeing with thousands of options. 
  • Exclusive discounts that help you save on a wide range of everyday brands, services, and experiences. 


Our team

We're a diverse group of people, and that diversity is what makes us great. We bring unique perspectives to everything we do and are always eager to learn from each other. We work in cross-functional teams to tackle ambitious challenges, actively seek feedback and be the best versions of ourselves.

description_html:
Tätigkeitsbereich

Du verantwortest die Akquise institutioneller Kunden und Mandate mit Schwerpunkt Brown-to-Green im Bereich Residential. Dies beinhaltet Partnerschaften und Asset Management Mandate für die Transformation bestehender Portfolios, als auch Einwerbung institutionellen Eigenkapitals für unsere Immobilienstrategien – von Club Deals und Separate Accounts über Joint Ventures bis hin zu Fondsvehikeln. Du bist die erste Anlaufstelle für Investoren, führst Gespräche eigenständig bis zum Abschluss und baust die Partner- und Kapitalseite unserer Plattform systematisch aus.


Dabei handelt es sich um keine reine Vertriebsrolle. Du arbeitest eng mit den Teams aus Transaktion, Asset Management und der Geschäftsführung zusammen und übersetzt zwischen den Erwartungen der Investoren und operativer Realität.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Aufbau und Pflege von Beziehungen zu Versorgungswerken, Pensionskassen, Versicherungen, Sparkassen, Stiftungen, Family Offices und Dachfonds

  • Eigenständige Ansprache, Qualifizierung und Betreuung von Investoren über den gesamten Zyklus – vom Erstkontakt bis zum Vertragsabschluss

  • Erstellung und Weiterentwicklung von Investorenunterlagen: Teaser, Pitch Decks, Track-Record-Darstellungen, Investment Memoranda

  • Pflege der Investoren-Pipeline im CRM, belastbares Reporting an die Geschäftsführung

Dein Profil

  • Belastbares, aktives Netzwerk zu deutschen institutionellen Investoren sowie nachweisbare eigene Abschlüsse

  • Tiefgehendes Verständnis von Immobilien-Kennzahlen und Strukturen (u.a IRR, Equity Multiple, Cash-on-Cash, Wasserfall, Leverage, Asset-Deal vs. Share-Deal)

  • Wünschenswert: 

    • Erfahrung mit Value-Add- oder opportunistischen Strategien, nicht nur Core wäre wünschenswert

    • Vorerfahrung auf Investorenseite (z. B. Kapitalanlage, Immobilienreferate)

    • Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit internationalen LPs oder Luxemburger Strukturen

    • Bestehende Beziehungen zu Platzierungsberatern und Consultants


Unsere Benefits, wir schaffen

  • Raum für Erholung: Erhole dich mit 30 Tagen Urlaub im Jahr. Der 24. und 31. Dezember sind zusätzlich arbeitsfrei. Für besondere Ereignisse (wie Umzug) bekommst du weiteren Sonderurlaub.

  • Raum für Absicherung: Mit unserer betrieblichen Altersvorsorge sorgen wir dafür, dass du langfristig gut abgesichert in die Zukunft blickst.
  • Raum für Ideen: Deine Meinung zählt! Wir fördern kreative Impulse und laden dich ein, aktiv an der Weiterentwicklung von Reneo mitzuwirken.

title: Platform Engineer (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Ecoplanet Green Operations Gmbh
description_html:
What we are building

ecoplanet builds the operating system for the energy transition. Our software helps European businesses cut energy costs, run more efficiently, and take the pain out of managing energy day to day. We are around 40 people and backed by EQT Ventures, HV Capital and others.


Why This Role Matters

You build and run the platform the whole product sits on: the event streams, the backend services and the cloud infrastructure everything else is built on. Meter readings arrive from industrial sites across Europe, through messages or us accessing APIs. Your job is to make sure that traffic lands reliably, moves through the system in a shape other teams can build on, and keeps doing so as the number of sites grows.
You join a team of 12 engineers in two squads. Small team, real ownership, and what you build reaches customers in weeks rather than quarters.

What you will work on

  • Event streaming. Kafka is the spine of the system. You own topic and schema design, partitioning, retention and delivery semantics  and the everyday reality behind them: consumers falling behind, replays, backfills, late and duplicated readings.
  • Backend services in TypeScript. The ingestion services, integrations and APIs around that stream. Every site is a little different, so a good part of the job is turning that variety into one consistent interface the product squads can rely on.
  • Cloud infrastructure on GCP. Compute, networking, IAM, infrastructure as code, CI/CD and observability. The goal is a paved road: other engineers ship and debug their own services without going through you.
  • Technical direction. You are senior enough to set it. Where we invest in the platform, what we standardise, what we deliberately leave rough for now  and bringing the rest of the team along with it.


What Sets You Up for Success

Must have:

  • At least 6–8 years building and running backend systems in production, including real time in a platform or infrastructure role that other engineers depended on
  • Strong backend engineering in TypeScript. You have designed, shipped and operated services and APIs in it — not just touched it around the edges of a frontend
  • Hands-on with Kafka in production. Topic design, consumer groups, ordering and delivery guarantees, and what you actually do at 3am when a consumer group is hours behind. A comparable streaming platform is fine if you know it at that depth
  • Solid on GCP or an equivalent cloud: containers, networking and IAM basics, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, monitoring and alerting. You have owned infrastructure, not just deployed onto it

title: Senior Unity Developer - Core Game Tech (f/m/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Kolibrigames
description_html:
We are Kolibri Games - a mobile games developer from Berlin. We believe that with the best people, we can make games that players will enjoy for years to come.

Our games have defined the idle genre, and bring enjoyment to hundreds of millions of players all around the world. This is possible due to the talented people who make us who we are. ‘Kolibris’, as we call ourselves, are on a mission to continue making great games and we're looking for new talent to join our team. We strive to offer you a fair recruitment process and a great candidate experience, as well as a friendly environment to work in, with plenty of opportunities to learn and grow.

Senior Unity Developer - Core Game Tech (f/m/d)

We are looking for a Senior Unity Developer to join our Core Game Tech (CGT) Team — the small, senior team behind the technology that every Kolibri game runs on.

Our work spans consulting game teams on technical decisions, investigating problems where nobody has defined the requirements yet, and building the systems and integrations that the games depend on. That ranges from compliance features and third-party SDKs to shared systems, standardization and keeping our engine and tooling current.

You'll work in a small specialized team alongside technical decision makers to have strong impact on all the games across our portfolio.

If you like being the person who takes on the technical problems other teams can't, and you don't shy away from constantly diving into new unknowns, learning new skills and driving topics forward, this role is for you.


Responsibilities
  • Design and build the shared systems multiple live games with dynamic events and scheduled content for millions of users run on
  • Drive third-party integrations and keep the portfolio current: evaluate and integrate SDKs, drive SDK and Unity version upgrades, and understand the impact across every game before it lands
  • Advise game teams as their technical counterpart, driving standardization and winning adoption of shared solutions on the strength of the work and the argument
  • Deliver compliance and privacy features across the portfolio, such as age assurance APIs, CMP implementations and GDPR data deletion flows
  • Investigate open-ended technical problems and turn regulations, vendor changes and internal needs into concrete technical requirements

    • Required skills
  • (Ideally 5+ years of professional) Software development experience in C# and Unity3D. Experience in non-gaming contexts is also relevant; we value your expertise, so do not hesitate to apply
  • You have a wide understanding of how Unity works, you are familiar with native implementations, understand backend interactions, and performance investigations are your bread and butter. The most important skill is to be able to jump into the unknown and get familiar
  • Strong written and spoken communication, and the credibility to make teams you don't sit with want to adopt your solutions
  • Experience building libraries, packages, APIs or tooling that other developers consume, and an instinct for what makes them adoptable
  • Ability to plan, communicate, and execute technical solutions in a way that is both understandable for other developers as well as non technical stakeholders
  • Ability to derive requirements yourself from ambiguous or external sources — regulation, platform policy, vendor documentation — rather than working from a written spec
  • A genuine appetite for constantly learning new areas of the stack

    • Desirable skills
  • Experience debugging below the C# layer into Android and iOS platform code, and profiling performance on mobile
  • Exposure to compliance, privacy or platform policy work — GDPR, CMP, age assurance, ATT or similar
  • Familiarity with reactive or async programming and dependency injection frameworks, e.g. UniRx, Zenject, UniTask
  • A passion for games and an understanding of the mobile market, like F2P and LiveOps
  • Strong familiarity with using LLMs in different areas of game development to support your efforts and achieve stronger results
  • Familiarity with Firebase Crashlytics and an understanding of ANRs.
    • Kolibri Games is an equal opportunity employer. We come from 40 different countries and many different backgrounds. We celebrate diversity and we are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees, regardless of their age, gender identity, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, physical appearance or disability.

    We are an international studio, so don’t forget to send in your application in English. Although it is not mandatory, we always appreciate a cover letter stating your motivation to join us.

    We look forward to hearing from you!

    Your Benefits – We’re game to support you

    Competitive Salary - We believe that top performers should receive top payment
    Learning Budget - We believe in learning. A generous personal learning budget to spend on learning and development, including books, workshops and attending conferences. We also offer in-house training such as coding and German classes
    Flexible Working Hours and Home Office – We believe in a good work-life balance
    Equipment - State-of-the-art technical equipment, including laptops and phones, which may also be used in your free time
    Kolicard - We offer you a monthly flexible budget of 50 euros that you can use for a gym membership, transportation, shopping etc.
    Mobility budget - We offer a monthly budget that will make your commuting to work easier
    Relocation - Relocation support to help you move to Berlin
    Pension - Opportunity to save for your pension tax-free

    Bonus Level – We love to have a good time, too

    Food and Drinks - Fresh fruits to keep you healthy and fresh coffee to keep you alert. We also have a fully stocked fridge with Smoothies, Coke, Club Mate, beer etc
    Parties and Team Events - Apart from our regular parties, BBQs and movie nights we also have a team event budget you can use to buy games or sports equipment to make working here even more fun
    Company Holidays - Every year we go on an amazing company holiday to relax and bond as a team
    Friday Celebrations - Company-provided dinner and drinks on Friday afternoons

description_html:
ResearchGate is the professional network for scientists and researchers. From climate change and emerging diseases to food security and the responsible development of AI, the challenges facing our world are complex. Still, we’re optimistic about the power of millions of scientists working together to tackle them. We provide scientists with the help and support they need by connecting them to the world’s most active scientific community.

We've built a platform that gives the world's scientists the tools and services they need to connect, collaborate, and advance their research. Over 25 million members from 193 countries use ResearchGate to share, discover, and discuss research.


Objective of the role

We're looking for an enthusiastic frontend engineer with the skills and ability to turn great ideas into reality. You should have an in-depth understanding of current web technologies and front-end development, and be passionate about creating a great user experience. Your input will help us grow and maintain our React front-end.

Join a team that encourages you to explore, learn, and go beyond, while seeing your work lead to actionable results. Put your creative problem-solving and development skills into action and make a positive impact on science and society. This is a full-time position based in Germany.


The team

You will be an integral part of the product team dedicated to enhancing ResearchGate's publisher-facing product. This role involves designing, constructing, and refining the platform to further our mission of facilitating global scientific connections and ensuring open access to research. At present, our team is working on making ResearchGate a great platform for publishers to connect with existing and future authors.

Your immediate colleagues will consist of JavaScript and PHP engineers, an Engineering Manager, a Product Manager, a UX Designer, and a UX Writer. Our team places great value on our collaborative and communicative work culture and we eagerly anticipate integrating a new Engineer into this environment.


Responsibilites

  • Create web interfaces using TypeScript and React for new products and features.

  • Seamlessly integrate our front-end with our back-end world using GraphQL and PHP.

  • Maintain and improve existing features and related infrastructure.

  • Collaborate with Product Managers, Designers, and Software Engineers to deliver compelling publisher-facing products.


    • Requirements

  • 5+ years frontend web development experience in TypeScript (React), CSS

  • Demonstrated ability to create code that is easily comprehensible, maintainable, and testable.

  • Eagerness to acquire new skills, delve into different technologies and programming languages, and a willingness to acknowledge areas where expertise may be lacking.

  • Approach problem-solving thoughtfully, embracing curiosity and maintaining an open-minded perspective.

  • You are comfortable incorporating AI-assisted development tools into your daily workflow and exercise strong engineering judgment when evaluating and refining their output.

  • Knowledge of GraphQL.

  • It would be a plus if you already had knowledge of relational and document-based databases (we use MongoDB and Postgres).


    • What we're looking for

  • You take responsibility over your own solutions and continuously improve them.

  • You engage in proactive and efficient communication within our distributed work environment.

  • You focus on building a great product.

  • You excel at designing and creating coherent, user-centric interfaces that display complex information.

    • The interview process

    • We start with a short call with HR or an Engineering Manager to align on the details of the job inquiry.

    • There will be a longer discussion about your technical and professional experience and expectations with an Engineering Manager and another colleague.

    • We’ll facilitate a technical interview with one or two engineers with some pair programming and technical discussion.

    • You'll have a conversation with our VP of Product, Mark, and our VP of Engineering, Frank, to learn more about our product and engineering organization and discuss how your experience aligns with our goals.

    • Last but not least, you will meet with our CEO, Ijad, and our VP of Finance & People team, Jess.

description_html:
Location: Remote, US-based
Team: Product & Design — IRL
Type: Full-Time, Employee
Compensation: $100K–$129K base
Target Start: January 2027 or earlier

Our Story

At Endear, we’re building the modern CRM for retail teams — starting with the frontline.

Our software helps retail teams build stronger customer relationships through thoughtful, intuitive technology. From clienteling and customer capture to appointments and in-store experiences, Endear gives brands the tools they need to create more personal interactions and drive measurable growth.

We work with brands like Allbirds, Reformation, and Alo Yoga, and we’re continuing to evolve Endear into an increasingly AI-first product built around how modern retail teams actually work.

Position Overview

We’re looking for a Product Designer to join our IRL (in real life) team, which owns the in-store side of Endear — including appointments, events, customer check-ins, and the administrative experiences behind those workflows.

You’ll design for store associates and managers running clienteling day to day, as well as admin users who help shape how those teams operate and manage their workflows.

In this role, you’ll own features and projects from understanding the problem through research, testing, iteration, and production-ready design, while partnering closely with our Head of Product Design on vision and direction.

The IRL roadmap is early. Many of these features don’t exist yet, so you’ll be defining problems through research before designing solutions.

This role is well suited for someone comfortable creating clarity when the solution isn’t obvious.

What You’ll Accomplish

In your first 6 months, you’ll…

  • Take ownership of IRL features from discovery through production-ready design

  • Build a strong understanding of how store associates, managers, and admin users work within Endear

  • Run research from early discovery through usability testing

  • Design complete, accessible product experiences, including loading, empty, error, permission, and other key states.

  • Partner closely with Product and Engineering to shape solutions early in the process

  • Use customer insight and data to inform design decisions and iteration

In your first year, you’ll…

  • Build deeper ownership across the IRL product

  • Deliver product experiences that improve how retail teams manage clienteling and in-store workflows

  • Build a strong rhythm of discovery, testing, and continuous learning

  • Strengthen your collaboration across Design, Product, and Engineering

  • Demonstrate clear user and business impact through the work you ship

You’ll Thrive in This Role If…

  • You enjoy taking ownership of a feature while collaborating closely on the broader vision and direction

  • You’re comfortable with ambiguity and zero-to-one product work

  • You naturally think beyond the happy path and account for edge cases and complete product states

  • You care about creating accessible experiences and solving the right problem, not just creating polished UI

  • You enjoy working closely with Product and Engineering throughout the design process

  • You’re comfortable using research, data, and customer feedback to guide decisions

  • You move quickly, seek feedback, and iterate based on what you learn

  • You’re curious about designing for AI

You Have Experience With

  • 2–5 years working in product design

  • Independently owning features from discovery through implementation, with support on vision and direction

  • Running user research from discovery through usability testing

  • Translating broad or ambiguous problems into clear product solutions

  • Working closely with Design, Product, and Engineering teams

  • Designing complex, accessible workflows and accounting for loading, empty, error, and permission states

  • Using qualitative and quantitative data to inform design decisions

  • Building within established design patterns while knowing when something needs to evolve

  • Using AI tools as part of your workflow and applying judgment to AI-generated output

  • A portfolio that demonstrates strong product thinking and execution, and where you can articulate the impact of your work, with data where you had access to it

Align With What We Value

At Endear, we live by five core principles. Here’s how they translate into what we’re looking for in this role:

  • Customer First: You start by understanding the people using the product, run thoughtful research, and use what you learn to shape better experiences.

  • Take Ownership: You take responsibility for your features, follow through on the details, and care about the quality of what ships.

  • Enable Autonomy: You communicate clearly, collaborate early, and give Product and Engineering the context they need to make strong decisions together.

  • Under Promise, Over Deliver: You set realistic expectations, think through the details, and deliver complete, production-ready work.

  • Innovate & Deliver Value Quickly: You’re comfortable experimenting, using AI and other tools thoughtfully, and moving quickly without sacrificing sound product judgment.

About the Team

Endear’s product organization is structured across three product teams: AI, IRL, and Core Flows, with one designer dedicated to each.

As the IRL designer, you’ll work closely with a Product Manager and 2–3 Engineers while also being part of Endear’s three-person design team. You’ll report to the Head of Product Design, who will provide vision, direction, mentorship, and support as you grow in the role.

You’ll partner most closely with:

  • Head of Product Design: vision, direction, mentorship, feedback, and design leadership

  • Product Team: roadmap alignment, priorities, customer needs, and business context

  • Engineering Team: feasibility, implementation, and iteration

You’ll have access to mentorship, an education budget, and support around Endear’s AI processes to help you continue developing your craft and expanding how you use AI in your work.

We’re a small team with big ambitions — collaborative, customer-obsessed, and deeply excited about the problems we’re solving in retail.

Our Hiring Process

  1. Recruiter Screen

  2. Behavioral Interview with the Hiring Manager

  3. Team Portfolio Review with Design, Product + Engineering

  4. Final leadership conversation

  5. Offer 🎉

Compensation & Benefits

  • Base Salary: $100K–$129K

  • Fully remote, US-based team

  • Comprehensive healthcare (medical, dental, vision)

  • Co-working or home office stipend

  • Flexible PTO and unlimited vacation

  • Education and learning support

  • Opportunity to shape foundational product work in a transformative industry

Location: This role is remote and US-based. Our full team comes together for an all-team standup every Monday at 8:00 AM Pacific, so you’ll need to be available at that time.

Apply Even If You Don’t Check Every Box

If this role excites you but you’re unsure if you meet every requirement, reach out anyway. No retail or e-commerce background is required. We care about your product thinking, skills, motivation, and how you approach problems more than we do about perfect resumes.

title: Founding Account Executive, New Business
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Fyxer
description_html:
About Fyxer

Fyxer launched in May 2024 and hit $1M in revenue across 3,000 paid users without spending a dollar on marketing. We've since gone from $1M to $30M ARR and raised a Series B led by Madrona, with Lakestar, 20VC and Marc Benioff behind us.

Far more people start using Fyxer every month than we can speak to. Nobody owns turning those users into paying teams. That's the biggest surface in the company, and it's this seat.

The role

You work accounts where someone is already using the product. One person trying Fyxer is often a door into a 500-person company. Spot those fast, get to the people who sign, prove out the pattern so it repeats.

You run the full cycle. First touch, discovery, demo, pricing, close. No handoffs.

You also write the first version of everything: the pitch, the sequences, the objection handling, the qualification bar. None of it exists yet. What you prove out is what the next reps get trained on.


What we're looking for

  • 30+ deals you closed yourself in the last 12 months, and quota hit in two of your last three measured periods

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build and maintain relationships with stakeholders at all levels of an organization

  • You've worked without a playbook, or built one where none existed

Three years in or twelve. We care what you've done, not where you did it.

How we work

Time with customers is the only thing that compounds. Everything else is overhead. We automate the research, the notes, the CRM and the follow-up with our own product.

We move fast and decide in the meeting. You own your outcomes. We challenge each other directly. It's intense and it isn't for everyone.


The Fyxer Reality: Why We Win

  • The Trajectory: We grew from $1M to $30M ARR with a team of just 32.

  • The Evidence: Ranked 7th in Andreessen Horowitz’s list of top AI apps. Every other company in that top 10 is valued at $10B+. We are the outlier.

  • The Culture of Agency: We hire exceptional people, give them total ownership, and get out of their way.

  • Zero Bureaucracy: No slow-motion decision-making. No "alignment" meetings for the sake of it.

 

This culture is intense; it requires focus and discipline. So we’ll do everything we can to remove distraction, support your wellbeing, and reward your impact

The basics

  • Remote, US

  • Compensation: $100K base / $200K OTE (plus equity, depending on location)

  • Uncapped with accelerators above 100%. Reports to Alec Kraft, VP of Sales

  • Travel: Occasional for enterprise customers

description_html:
🌍 We’re making security suck less for developers.

Security tools haven’t kept up with how software is built today. They interrupt teams, slow releases, and turn security into a bottleneck instead of a capability. We built Aikido to change that. Aikido builds developer-first security products that reduce real risk without getting in the way of shipping software. We focus on what actually matters and automate the rest.

We’re taking on legacy security tools teams have been stuck with, and we’re winning. If you want to help us take market share and build products developers actually enjoy using, you’re in the right place.

Founded in 2022 by third-time founders, Aikido has $85M in the bank and a long runway ahead. We’re building toward self-securing software. Join an all-star team. Take real ownership. Push boundaries. Build things that matter.

As a Solution Engineer at Aikido, you’ll play a key role in the sales process, partnering closely with Account Executives to help prospects understand, evaluate, and successfully adopt our platform. You’ll act as the technical counterpart in deals, running demos, guiding evaluations, and ensuring customers clearly see the value of Aikido. This role is heavily focused on pre-sales, helping drive deals forward by translating complex technical concepts into clear, actionable insights for developers, security teams, and technical stakeholders.

Responsibilities

  • Partner closely with Account Executives to drive the pre-sales process, leading technical demos and product walkthroughs tailored to customer use cases

  • Run proofs-of-concept (POCs) and guide prospects through technical evaluations

  • Help prospects understand how Aikido fits into their code → cloud → runtime environments

  • Debug and troubleshoot technical questions during the sales process

  • Act as a trusted technical advisor to developers, security teams, and engineering leaders

  • Collaborate with product and engineering to relay customer feedback and improve the platform


  • 3–7+ years in a Sales Engineer, Solutions Engineer, or Pre-Sales role

  • Strong technical foundation (cloud, DevOps, security, or developer tooling) and experience running demos, POCs, and technical evaluations

  • Comfortable engaging with both technical and business stakeholders

  • Ability to explain complex concepts in a simple, clear way

  • Hands-on mindset, able to troubleshoot and dig into technical workflows

  • Strong communication skills and a proactive, ownership-driven approach

  • Lives in Paris and speak French native

What you can expect

  • Short decision lines. Big ownership. Shape the projects that matter and ship fast.

  • Grow as fast as we do. Take on more, own more, and carve out your own path.

  • Top-tier tech pay and equity.

  • High trust, strong values, zero corporate BS.

  • Flexibility in working hours.

  • A company that sticks to its values in an open and informal atmosphere.

We hire for talent, drive, and potential. Everything else is noise.

title: Security Engineer Intern
salary_basis: Based on historical internship stipend records at Swile
description_html:
About the role

Our Security team protects Swile's products, data and engineering platform. We work with a simple principle: when something is recurring, we automate it, and when a security requirement can become code, we write the code.

As a Security Engineer Intern, you will not shadow the team, you will be part of it. You will handle real alerts, run your own audits and own projects end to end, with a dedicated mentor in the team throughout your internship.

What you will do

Detection and response

  • Handle day to day security alerts: triage, investigate, qualify, escalate when needed.
  • Improve what we detect: reduce noise, close detection gaps, propose new signals.
  • Automate the recurring: when an alert or a manual check keeps coming back, script it away. This is where we expect you to leave a mark.

Security audits

  • Run targeted audits, from a few days to a few weeks, on applications, configurations or third party providers.
  • Turn findings into a prioritised remediation plan rather than a list of tickets.

Projects you will own

  • Ad hoc security projects across the engineering platform.
  • Security review and hardening of the tools and integrations we rely on (Dust, third party providers, internal integrations).

Fraud

  • Support fraud investigations: dig, follow the trail, understand how an abuse pattern works and how we could detect it earlier.

What we are looking for

This is an internship, so how you think matters more than what you already know.

  • You learn fast and you are genuinely curious about security.
  • You are a doer: you answer quickly, you close loops, you do not let things sit.
  • You are pragmatic: you calibrate your response to the actual level of urgency and risk, and you know that not everything is a P1.
  • You are open minded and comfortable asking questions across engineering teams.
  • You are comfortable working in English, written and spoken.

description_html:
At Niologic, we are building the leading consultancy for Product Engineering for AI and Location Intelligence in Germany. Combining the megatrends AI and Location Intelligence, we want to strive for bringing the cutting-edge into production for our clients and make a difference in their daily lives.

Contrary to current industry trends and backed by the trust of leading brands, we want to grow from an extraordinary 15 people team to a dream team of 50 players dedicated to retail and public security.

IMPORTANT: This is an on-site position in Cologne (50354 Huerth). Please do not apply if you do not live nearby -> Google Maps VWG5+H7 Hürth

Tasks

As a working student, you will work on modern data products that rely on the latest cloud technology and API-driven frontends. Your tasks will be:

  • Implementation of SQL-based data structures
  • Planning and Implementation of data pipelines incl. data quality checks
  • Implementation of Infrastructure as Code for underlying components

Requirements

As a motivated team player with commitment and initiative, you should also have the following skills to fit into our team:

Benefits

At Niologic, we promote a culture of openness and diversity in which everyone can develop their individual talents. We ensure that we treat each other with appreciation and respect and are equally committed to our colleagues and society.

Note: In the application process, we use AI-powered systems and Google Gemini as a data processor (with a data center in Frankfurt).

description_html:
About Zip

Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement — built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before.

The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA.

Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups.

Your Role

  • You’re a closer, trusted advisor, product consultant – you’re working with prospects day-in-day-out to deliver immense ROI in an efficient, value-based sales cycle

  • You’re a hunter – you’ll get a healthy supply of BDR leads and marketing opportunities, but you’ll prospect and tap into your network to knock down doors and blockers

  • You’re a product evangelist – you’ll solution Zip to meet the pain points today, but also with an eye toward our product of the future

  • You’re a builder – at a startup, you’re not just a team member, but you help build the team culture and bring your best practice to the org

You Will

  • Become a product expert – learning the Zip platform through and through, so that you’re demo ready

  • Become a procurement expert – learning the ins and outs of the procurement market, which is deeply ready for change and new solutions

  • Use cutting-edge sales intelligence and engagement solutions to prospect, manage deal cycles, and ultimately bring on new customers

  • Be adaptable and flexible – as part of an early-stage hyper growth company, we are rapidly growing out our process but we want to you to help shape our sales process

Qualifications

  • 2+ years of closing experience in technology SaaS sales

  • Self driven – you don’t need someone to motivate you to put in your best every day

  • You’d describe yourself as organized, efficient with your time, and excellent communicator

  • Experience using tools like Salesforce, Zoominfo, LinkedIn SalesNav, and Outreach

  • Willing to go the extra mile to make sure our customers, company, team, and yourself succeed

  • a Bachelor’s degree is required (specifically in Finance, Technology, or a related field or experiential equivalent)

  • Able to come into our office 3 days per week

Nice to Haves

  • Experience selling to procurement, finance, IT, legal 

Perks & Benefits

At Zip, we’re committed to providing our employees with everything they need to do their best work.

  • 📈  Start-up equity

  • 🚠  Team building events & happy hours

  • 🌴  Flexible PTO

  • 💻  Apple equipment plus home office budget

We're looking to hire Zipsters and that means hiring people who take ownership, communicate openly, have an underdog mindset, and are excited to increase the pace of innovation for every business in the world. We encourage all candidates to apply even if your experience doesn't exactly match up to our job description. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workspace where everyone (regardless of age, religion, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, and more) feels like they belong. We look forward to hearing from you!

description_html:
Als Senior Machine Learning Engineer arbeitest du im Pricing & Revenue-Kontext an datengetriebenen Verbesserungen für Forecasting, Pricing-Logiken und Produkt-Insights. Du baust Analysen und Modelle, die im Produkt messbar Wirkung zeigen – mit sauberer Evaluation, solider Datenbasis und pragmatischer Umsetzung. Du arbeitest dabei eng mit Product & Engineering zusammen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Model Evolution: Du entwickelst und optimierst unsere Forecasting- und Pricing-Modelle sowie datengetriebene Decision-Logiken, immer methodisch pragmatisch und voll auf Impact ausgerichtet.

  • Signal Hunting: Du arbeitest mit Zeitreihen, Demand-Signalen und heterogenen Datenquellen. Du definierst Features und Labels so sauber, dass Leakage keine Chance hat.

  • Measurement & Guardrails: Du verantwortest die Evaluation durch Backtests, robuste Metriken und Segmentierungen. Du unterstützt bei Holdouts sowie A/B-Logiken und behältst den Check zwischen Offline- und Online-Performance.

  • Best Practices im ML Engineering: Du setzt neue Maßstäbe für Backtesting, Reproduzierbarkeit und Versionierung. Für uns zählt: Engineering-Qualität statt reiner Notebook-Lösungen.

  • Data Visibility: Du baust Dashboards und Reports aus, die Modell- und Business-KPIs transparent machen. Dein Fokus liegt dabei immer auf höchster Data Quality.

  • Smart Workflows: Du treibst reproduzierbare Workflows voran (Versionierung, saubere Pipelines, sinnvolle Tests) und automatisierst wiederkehrende Analysen sowie Evaluationsläufe.

Dein Profil

  • Track Record: Du hast 4+ Jahre Erfahrung in Data Science oder Applied ML Engineering gesammelt – idealerweise direkt im Produkt- oder Business-Kontext.

  • Data Intuition: Du besitzt extrem starke SQL-Skills und ein tiefes Gespür für Datenqualität, Debugging und konsistente Metriken.

  • Python Pro: Dein Python-Code ist sauber und deine Analysen sind nachvollziehbar. Erste Erfahrung mit produktnahen Setups ist ein großes Plus.

  • Experiment-Mindset: Du beherrscht die Grundlagen von Bias/Leakage-Awareness und weißt, wie man in Guardrails und Offline-vs-Online-Szenarien denkt.

  • Work Style: Du übernimmst volle Ownership für deine Themen. Du arbeitest nach dem 80/20-Prinzip (pragmatisch!), bist zuverlässig und kommunizierst glasklar.

  • Entrepreneurial Spirit: Du denkst unternehmerisch und willst Dinge wirklich bewegen.

  • Sprachkenntnisse: Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und bringst gute Englischkenntnisse mit.

Nice‑to‑haves – was die Besten auszeichnet

  • Domain Expertise: Du hast bereits Erfahrung im Revenue Management oder Dynamic Pricing (z. B. Hotel, Travel, eCommerce oder Mobility).

  • Demand Knowledge: Du kennst dich mit Saisonalität, Events, Lead Times und Segment-Mustern aus.

  • Modern Stack: Du hast schon mit Analytics Engineering oder Warehouse-Tools wie dbt, Snowflake oder Metabase gearbeitet.

  • Hands-on MLOps & Cloud: Ein Plus ist praktische Erfahrung im Umgang mit MLOps-Tools und Cloud-Infrastruktur, z. B. AWS.


Wir sind angetreten, um die Hotellerie nicht nur zu digitalisieren, sondern ihre technologische Basis auf ein neues Level zu heben. Wenn du Lust hast, die Verantwortung für das technische Rückgrat eines Millionen-Portfolios zu übernehmen und gemeinsam mit uns die nächste Generation des automatisierten Revenue Managements zu skalieren, dann lass uns reden!

Bewirb dich jetzt – wir freuen uns darauf, gemeinsam mit dir den nächsten Meilenstein von happyhotel zu setzen.

title: Werkstudent:in - Social Media / Content Creation
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at VF Nutrition GmbH
description_html:
Jobbeschreibung

Hey!

Wir sind vly – ein innovatives FoodTech-Startup aus Berlin, das die Lebensmittelindustrie revolutioniert. Unser Ziel: Gesunde, pflanzliche Milchalternativen, die nicht nur dir guttun, sondern auch unserem Planeten. Nach jahrelanger Forschung haben wir Produkte entwickelt, die deutlich weniger Zucker und mehr Protein enthalten, mit Preisen ausgezeichnet wurden und deutschlandweit erhältlich sind – wie unsere Milchalternativen aus Erbsenprotein und den allerersten Joghurt aus Ackerbohnenprotein. Um unserer Community noch näher zu kommen, brauchen wir Dich!

Deine Mission: Als Werkstudent:in im Social Media Bereich schaffst du echten Content-Impact für die Marke vly. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit unserer Social Media Manager:in sowie dem E-Commerce & Marketing Team unterstützt du dabei sowohl im organischen Bereich als auch für unsere Performance Ads.

Dein Profil:

  • Hands-on Content Creation: Du entwickelst zusammen mit dem Social Media Team kreative Ideen, stehst vor der Kamera und nimmst eigenen Content auf (Fokus auf IG Reels & TikTok).
  • Editing & Post-Production: Du schneidest deine gedrehten Videos eigenständig mit CapCut.
  • Format- & Grafik-Erstellung: Du erstellst ergänzende visuelle Assets mit Canva und nutzt moderne KI-Tools, um deinen Workflow zu beschleunigen.
  • Trend-Scouting & Testing: Social Media ist deine Leidenschaft. Du verfolgst aktuelle Trends täglich und identifizierst aktiv virale Formate für unsere Social Media Präsenz und hast Spaß dabei, diese vor der Kamera direkt umzusetzen.
  • Content-Skalierung & Assets: In Zusammenarbeit mit dem Performance Team drehst und schneidest du Performance Ads und kreierst neue Hooks für unsere Zielgruppen.

Deine Benefits:

  • Werde Teil unserer Mission: Sei dabei, den Wandel von tierischen zu pflanzlichen Proteinen voranzutreiben!
  • Eine faszinierende Branche - Milchprodukte sind in fast jedem Haushalt zu finden, Haferm*lch und Blutzucker ist in den sozialen Netzwerken allgegenwärtig und die Bedeutung von Gesundheit nimmt ständig zu.
  • Echtes Teamgefühl: Ein kreatives und motiviertes Team, das zusammenhält – inklusive regelmäßiger vly-Day- und Offsite-Events.
  • Teamlunch: Unser Highlight - jeden Tag frisch gekochtes Lunch von unserem eigener vly-Köchin!
  • Mobilität und Company Fitness: Zuschuss sowohl zum BVG / Deutschland-Ticket als auch zu deiner USC-Mitgliedschaft.
  • FoodTech-Community: Sei Teil einer wachsenden Bewegung, mit spannenden Events und Networking-Möglichkeiten.
  • vly-Flatrate: Genieße so viel vly, wie du willst!

Stellenanforderungen

Berufserfahrung: Du hast erste, nachweisbare Erfahrung damit gesammelt, Social Media Content zu erstellen und hast einen eigenen Account.

  • Ausbildung: Du studierst im Bereich Marketing, Design, Kommunikations- & Medienwissenschaften oder äquivalenten Bereichen und bist noch für mindestens 1 Jahr eingeschrieben.
  • Shooting & Cutting Skills: Du weißt, wie man ein Smartphone für gute Aufnahmen nutzt (Licht, Framing) und beherrschst das schnelle Schneiden von Kurzvideos (z. B. CapCut).
  • Kamera-Präsenz & Personality: Du stehst gerne selbst vor der Kamera, agierst natürlich und nahbar und hast Freude daran, unsere Marke mit deiner begeisternden Art persönlich zu verkörpern.
  • Gespür Social Media & Ästhetik: Du hast eine große Leidenschaft für Social Media (speziell für Instagram & TikTok), ein Gespür für digitale Trends sowie ein Auge für Ästhetik und Bildgestaltung.
  • Cultural Fit: Du brennst für eine gesundheitsorientierte Lebensmittelindustrie, fühlst dich in einer ambitionierten Scale-up-Kultur wohl, und lebst offene und proaktive Kommunikation.
  • Sprache: Du hast sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse auf C1 Level.
  • Verfügbarkeit: Du bist für 15-20 Stunden/Woche verfügbar.
  • Rahmenbedingungen: Deine Homebase ist Berlin oder die nähere Umgebung. Für den engen Austausch, gemeinsame Sparrings und die Team-Dynamik bist du mindestens 50 % deiner Arbeitszeit pro Woche bei uns im Office – die restliche Zeit arbeitest du flexibel.

Wenn du bis hierhin gelesen hast, sollten wir uns definitiv kennenlernen! Sende uns einfach deine Unterlagen - wir freuen uns schon sehr darauf, dich kennenzulernen!

description_html:
Du hast Spaß daran, mit Menschen zu arbeiten und möchtest neben Schule, Studium oder Ausbildung flexibel in der Gastronomie und bei Events arbeiten?

Dann könnte Prestige Service zu dir passen.

Wir unterstützen Veranstaltungen und Eventlocations in Berlin mit unserem Team.

Dabei ist uns wichtig, dass du dich bei uns wohlfühlst und weißt, mit wem du arbeitest. Deshalb lernst du uns persönlich kennen, wirst auf deine ersten Einsätze vorbereitet und bekommst eine Schulung. Danach entscheidest du selbst, welche Einsätze zu dir und deinem Alltag passen.

Aufgaben

Was dich bei uns erwartet:

  • 17 € / Stunde zum Einstieg
  • flexible Einsätze, die zu deinem Alltag passen
  • verschiedene Veranstaltungen und Locations in Berlin
  • persönliche Ansprechpartner
  • Schulung und Vorbereitung vor deinen ersten Einsätzen
  • ein junges Team, in dem man sich kennt und gegenseitig unterstützt
  • regelmäßige Teamevents
  • die Möglichkeit, mit der Zeit mehr Verantwortung zu übernehmen
  • Unterstützung bei der Logistik vor Ort, wie Auf- und Abbau sowie das Handling von Veranstaltungsmaterialien
  • Koordination und Organisation des reibungslosen Ablaufs der Events in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Team

Die Position kombiniert Direct Sales & Partner Management. Dein Fokus liegt zunächst klar auf Deutschland. Perspektivisch unterstützt du uns dabei, einen skalierbaren Partner-Channel für den gesamten DACH-Raum aufzubauen.

  • Präsentation und Weiterentwicklung des ORDERMONKEY Partner-Modells & Langfristiger Aufbau eines skalierbaren Partner-Channels für Deutschland und den DACH-Raum

Qualifikation

  • Mindestens 3–5 Jahre Erfahrung im B2B Sales, Business Development oder einer vergleichbaren VertriebsrolleErfahrung im POS-/Kassensystem-Umfeld ist für diese Position zwingend erforderlich
  • Gute Kenntnisse der Strukturen und Entscheidungsprozesse in der Gastronomie, idealerweise im Bereich Gastro-Tech, POS, Payment oder Hospitality Technology
  • Erfahrung in der aktiven Neukundengewinnung, Idealerweise Erfahrung im Partner-, Reseller- oder Channel Sales
  • Fähigkeit, SaaS- und Technologieprodukte verständlich und überzeugend zu präsentieren
  • Sehr gute Kommunikations- und Verhandlungsfähigkeiten sowie sicheres Auftreten gegenüber Entscheidern
  • Selbstständige, strukturierte und unternehmerische Arbeitsweise
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse
  • Bereitschaft zu regelmäßigen Kunden- und Partnerterminen innerhalb Deutschlands

Benefits

Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Management sowie unseren Sales-, Product- und Operations-Teams zusammen und hast direkten Einfluss darauf, wie wir unseren Direct-Sales- und Partner-Channel weiterentwickeln.

Dich erwartet ein internationales Tech-Umfeld mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen, viel Eigenverantwortung und großem Gestaltungsspielraum. Wir setzen auf selbstständiges Arbeiten und Vertrauen statt auf starre Strukturen.

Dank unseres Remote-/Hybrid-Modells kannst du deinen Arbeitsalltag weitgehend flexibel und eigenständig organisieren. Du planst deine Termine, Kundenbesuche und Sales-Aktivitäten selbst und hast die Freiheit, deine Arbeit so einzuteilen, wie sie für deine Ziele und deinen Markt am sinnvollsten ist.

Gleichzeitig bist du Teil eines internationalen Teams und arbeitest eng mit deinen Kolleginnen und Kollegen zusammen. Bei ORDERMONKEY hast du die Möglichkeit, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, eigene Ideen einzubringen und den nächsten Wachstumsschritt unseres Geschäfts in Deutschland aktiv mitzugestalten.

Du kennst den POS-Markt, bist stark im Vertrieb und möchtest nicht nur Deals abschließen, sondern aktiv etwas aufbauen und einen Markt mitentwickeln? Dann möchten wir dich kennenlernen.

Werde Teil von ORDERMONKEY und gestalte mit uns die Zukunft des Self-Orderings in der Gastronomie.

title: Medical Director (m/w/x)
salary_basis: Based on leadership compensation records at Doctorflix
description_html:
Role

Als Medical Director verantwortest du den medizinischen Themenkatalog einer der größten CME-Lernplattformen Deutschlands. Was wir zeigen, erreicht unzählige Ärzt:innen – deine inhaltlichen Entscheidungen haben unmittelbaren Einfluss darauf, welches medizinische Wissen in Deutschland ankommt.

Du führst unser siebenköpfiges Medical Team, hältst den Kontakt zu Chefärzt:innen und Meinungsbildner:innen, entwickelst neue Fortbildungsformate mit und baust die Prozesse, mit denen wir vom Startup zum Scale-up werden. Die Rolle ist bewusst breit: strategisch in der Katalog- und Formatentwicklung, operativ im Tagesgeschäft, und immer mit der ärztlichen Perspektive als Maßstab.


Your tasks

  • Verantwortung für den Themenkatalog: Du steuerst, welche medizinischen Themen wir abdecken – fachübergreifend, evidenzbasiert und mit einem klaren Blick für Versorgungsrelevanz und Lücken im Markt.

  • Referenten-Netzwerk: Du bist tagtäglich im Austausch mit Chefärzt:innen und KOLs, baust langfristige Beziehungen auf und gewinnst daraus kontinuierlich neue Fortbildungsideen.

  • Team-Leadership: Du führst und entwickelst unser Medical Team – zwei Vollzeitkolleg:innen und fünf Studierende. Die Medical Editors arbeiten inhaltlich und stimmen Projekte mit Sponsoren und Referent:innen ab; die Medical Students übernehmen Quality Control, erstellen Kursbeschreibungen und entwickeln neue Themenideen.

  • Formatentwicklung: Wir produzieren Videos, Panel-Diskussionen und E-Learnings – Form und Inhalt greifen ineinander. Bei neuen Formaten wie Kurzvideos oder der Gamification des Lernerlebnisses ist dein medizinischer Input und die ärztliche Perspektive der entscheidende Faktor.

  • Projekt- und Themensteuerung: Du managst die Themenideen laufender Projekte und stimmst dich eng mit Referent:innen ab, damit Projektanforderungen inhaltlich sauber umgesetzt werden.

  • Qualitätssicherung & Compliance: Du stellst sicher, dass unsere Fortbildungen den CME-Standards entsprechen, evidenzbasiert sind und die regulatorischen Anforderungen erfüllen.

  • Prozessverbesserung & Automatisierung: Auf unserem Weg zum Scale-up stehen Automatisierung und schlanke Prozesse im Mittelpunkt. Du streamlinest Workflows und Dokumentationstools im Team und teamübergreifend – als Director bist du dabei die Schlüsselrolle für funktionierende Cross-Department-Zusammenarbeit.


Your profile

  • Hintergrund: Abgeschlossenes Studium der Medizin.

  • Berufserfahrung: Idealerweise 5+ Jahre Berufserfahrung, gern klinisch, in der Industrie oder in der digitalen Gesundheitsbranche.

  • Führungserfahrung: Erste Erfahrung als Team Lead ist ein klarer Vorteil – entscheidend ist, dass du Menschen entwickeln und Prioritäten setzen kannst.

  • Anpack-Mindset: Wir skalieren. Du regelst Dinge selbst, statt sie nur zu delegieren, und scheust dich nicht davor, auch operativ mit reinzugehen.

  • Begeisterung für Prozesse: Du hast Freude an Projektmanagement, Strukturaufbau und medizinischem Content bzw. medizinischer Lehre – diese Kombination ist der Kern der Rolle.

  • Von Vorteil: Erfahrung in einem Startup sowie in der medizinischen Lehre.

  • Kommunikationsstärke: Sicheres Auftreten gegenüber führenden Mediziner:innen und Industriepartnern, professioneller Kommunikationsstil mündlich und schriftlich.

  • Sprachen: Deutsch auf Muttersprachenniveau und fließendes Englisch sind Voraussetzung.


Why us?

  • Echter Impact: Die Themen, die du verantwortest, erreichen über zig tausende Ärzt:innen. Durch die Verbreitung des neuesten medizinischen Wissens hast du direkten Einfluss auf die Versorgungsqualität in Deutschland.

  • Mitgestaltung: Du prägst neue Fortbildungsformate und den medizinischen Qualitätsanspruch der Plattform von Grund auf mit.

  • Wachstum & Perspektive: Wir wachsen schnell – entsprechend gibt es echte Aufstiegs- und Gestaltungschancen, die mit dem Unternehmen mitwachsen.

  • Ownership: Kurze Entscheidungswege, flache Hierarchien und die Freiheit, eigene Ideen umzusetzen.

  • Team: Ein junges, motiviertes und wirklich gutes Team in Prenzlauer Berg. Teamevents, Ausflüge sowie Bier und Wein im Kühlschrank gehören dazu.

  • Benefits: Attraktives Gehaltspaket inkl. Aktienpaket (VSOP) sowie ein Urban Sports Club Abo.

description_html:
Dein Ziel

Als Software Engineer Linux OS bist Du verantwortlich für das Betriebssystem unseres Gateways. Du gestaltest die Grundlage für ein sicheres, stabiles und skalierbares Ökosystem, das den Betrieb, die Überwachung und Aktualisierung unserer Geräteflotte ermöglicht. Damit legst du den Grundstein für unsere Anwendungen und trägst aktiv zur Digitalisierung der Energienetze bei!


Deine Aufgaben

  • Du entwickelst und wartest ein sicheres und modulares Linux-Betriebssystem für unsere Gateways.
  • Du konzipierst und implementierst Frameworks und Schnittstellen zur Überwachung und Aktualisierung der Geräteflotte.
  • Du integrierst Lösungen zur Geräteidentifikation, -authentifizierung und -autorisierung, um höchste Sicherheit zu gewährleisten.
  • Das Thema Linux OS treibst Du aktiv voran und bringst technische Weiterentwicklungen eigenständig von der Idee bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung.


Dein Profil

  • Du bringst fundierte Kenntnisse moderner Softwareentwicklungsworkflows mit, z. B. Versionskontrolle mit Git, CI/CD-Pipelines, automatisiertes Testing und Code Reviews.

title: Senior Talent Acquisition Manager (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Yoummday GmbH
description_html:
Your mission

You want to make things happen, take real ownership, and have a genuine drive for results. That's exactly what we live in our People & Culture team - and we're looking for reinforcement for our Munich HQ.As Senior Talent Acquisition Manager (mf/d), you guide our future Daymakers through the full recruiting lifecycle. With your authentic approach, you win talent for our vision and act as a strong brand ambassador externally.You take full ownership of your roles. You bring structure and process discipline to your funnel - and the ambition to actively shape our employer brand alongside it. Recruiting is the core. Employer Branding is the development path we'll build together. You know what it takes to connect both: consistent ATS hygiene, a strong candidate journey, and the instinct for what makes an employer brand genuinely believable.
What You'll Own

Full-Cycle Recruiting & Sourcing

  • End-to-end ownership. You manage your hiring processes independently across all departments and locations - from briefing session to offer close, including channel strategy, screening, and stakeholder sparring.
  • More than execution. You don't just manage process - you think alongside it. Your input on candidate profiles, job descriptions, and interview design gets heard and implemented directly.
  • Bias for action in sourcing. You go after talent proactively, think creatively across channels, and win candidates through outreach that actually feels individual.
  • Scalable process discipline. You keep your pipeline and candidate journey clean - ensuring the funnel stays stable and transparent even at high velocity.
Employer Branding (Your Development Path)
  • Instinct for what works. You identify which EB initiatives genuinely fit our culture, position yourself as a credible brand ambassador on LinkedIn, and know how to build real reach through authentic content.
  • Shape with perspective. You drive ideas for how yoummday shows up and is authentically positioned - taking on progressively more strategic responsibility for building our employer brand.
  • Candidate experience as a brand signal. You understand that every candidate interaction is a touchpoint with our employer brand, and you design the candidate journey to reflect that.


Your skillset

  • Builder mindset. Several years of successful full-cycle recruiting in a demanding hiring environment. You make decisions, think in solutions, and drive things forward - with one clear goal: winning the best talent for the team.
  • Sourcing as a craft. Active sourcing is your standard toolkit. You build precise boolean strings, find talent outside the standard channels, and win them through outreach that actually resonates.
  • Structure and accountability. You've owned recruiting processes independently - advised stakeholders, closed hires, and used process discipline and ATS hygiene as tools to protect your performance and make it visible.
  • Hiring manager sparring. You engage as a peer, challenge expectations constructively, and hold a high quality bar with both clarity and tact.
  • Genuine EB curiosity. You understand employer branding as a real recruiting lever and experiment pragmatically with what works in the market.
  • Communication that lands. Fluent in German and English. You convince through presence, clarity, and credibility. You build trust, bring people along toward shared goals, and leave a professional and positive impression.


Your winning deal

  • Your workplace. You work in a flexible hybrid model from one of our dog-friendly, modern offices - plus up to 2 weeks' workation anywhere in the EU per year (EU passport holders only).
  • The values. An open, authentic culture with a high-performing and genuinely fun team that's already looking forward to making bold decisions with you and finding new paths toward sustainable success.
  • Your footprint. A position at a profitable company where you have the freedom and trust to shape things - and build the future of work alongside us.
  • Your opportunity. From day one, you take ownership, drive innovation, and develop yourself and the company alongside a team of experts.
  • Your benefits. 30 days' vacation, Joblunch subsidy (€69/month), Givve Card (€50/month loaded monthly) or alternatively a subsidised Wellpass membership, discounts via Corporate Benefits, JobRad leasing, company pension contributions (bAV & VL), and outstanding team and company events.
