title: Senior Security Engineer (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Yoummday GmbH
description_html:
Your mission

Do you want to do more than just write security concepts - and put your decisions into practice directly? Do you see cloud security not as a compliance checklist, but as the combination of threat modeling, Infrastructure as Code, and genuine hands-on engineering? Then we are looking for you to join our CISO team as a Senior Security Engineer (m/f/d) in a hybrid working model in Munich, Berlin or Halle (Saale).
You will join a three-person team where responsibility is genuinely shared: no ticket queues and no “that’s not my area.” We plan together, cover for one another, and usually implement and operate the security controls we design ourselves. This means you will see the impact of your work immediately - not at some point in the distant future.
Your Responsibilities

  • Security Architecture & Cloud Guardrails: You will take technical ownership of the security architecture and controls across our Azure environment - from Defender for Cloud and Microsoft Sentinel to Log Analytics. You will build and maintain the corresponding guardrails directly in Terraform.
  • Detection Engineering: You will develop and continuously improve our detections in close collaboration with our Security Analyst, who is responsible for day-to-day SIEM monitoring and triage. You will work as a well-coordinated team rather than in separate silos.
  • Vulnerability Management: You will further develop our vulnerability management and monitoring across a hybrid environment. This includes our growing cloud landscape as well as the existing on-premises stack for as long as the migration is ongoing.
  • Security Beyond the Cloud: You will contribute your expertise beyond cloud security, including identity, endpoint security, application security, incident response, and AI. Using your security engineering skills, you will, for example, develop tooling for AI-assisted penetration testing within our team and translate it into practical, scalable processes.
  • AI-Assisted Engineering: You will use tools such as Claude Code to build and maintain internal security tools and automations. At the same time, you will help us identify AI-specific risks early—from the secure use of AI coding assistants to prompt injection.


Your skillset

  • Azure Security & Certifications: You have at least five years of experience in security engineering and several years of hands-on experience implementing Azure security. You hold an AZ-500 certification or have equivalent practical expertise. SC-100, CISSP, CCSP, or Security+ certifications are a plus.
  • Infrastructure & Automation: You can confidently read, write, and further develop security-related Terraform code. Experience with Python, Django, PowerShell, or AI-assisted development is a plus.
  • Identity & Detection: You have practical experience with Entra ID, RBAC, and PIM, as well as solid knowledge of network security, SIEM, and detection engineering.
  • Offensive Security & Vulnerability Management: Ideally, you have experience with traditional or AI-assisted penetration testing and with tools such as Tenable or Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management.
  • Hands-On Mindset: You do not just design security controls -you implement and operate them in practice. When you identify a problem, you do not wait for a ticket; you take ownership and develop a solution.
  • Collaboration & Communication: You share knowledge and responsibility and work closely with the team on areas of joint ownership. You communicate confidently and professionally in English. German is a plus, but not a requirement.
Experience with an ongoing cloud migration and AI/LLM security is welcome, but not essential. What matters to us is what you can genuinely do - substance beats buzzword bingo.


Your winning deal

  • Your benefits: In addition to 30 days of vacation, we also offer you a job lunch allowance (€69 per month), a “Givve” card (topped up with €50 per month) or a subsidized membership with Wellpass, discounts via “Corporate Benefits”, the option of leasing a JobRad, pension contributions (occupational pension & VL) and great team and company events.
  • Your workplace: You will work in a flexible, hybrid model from one of our dog-friendly and modern offices and will have the opportunity to do “work from abroad” within the EU for 2 weeks a year (*only applies to employees with an EU passport) 
  • Your footprint: A position in a profitable company where you have the freedom and confidence to help shape it and work with us on the “future of work”.
  • The values: We score highly with an open, authentic culture and a high-performing and humorous team that is already looking forward to making bold decisions with you and breaking new ground that will lead us to sustainable success.
  • Your opportunity: From day one, you will have the opportunity to take on responsibility, drive innovation and develop the company and yourself together with a team of experts.

description_html:
Your mission

No deck that ends up in a drawer. No next project. Real ownership.

YOUR MISSION

The global CX outsourcing market is worth more than 400 billion USD. yoummday has built a disruptive model to change this market: a technology-driven platform that combines AI automation with a global network of highly qualified freelance CX professionals. With 100 million euros in revenue, 150 customers worldwide, and a new office in Miami, we're just at the beginning of what's possible.

We're looking for you, starting now, as Senior Consultant/Manager Business Strategy (m/f/d) for our headquarters in Munich.

Our Business Strategy team (made up of former consultants from Bain, BCG, EY-Parthenon, and Roland Berger) in Munich and Berlin owns cross-functional, strategically critical projects end-to-end, from analysis to concept development to operational implementation within the organization.

You'll work closely with the leadership team and the Head of Strategy (ex-BCG) on the company's core strategic topics and see directly how your work creates measurable impact and drives real change in the business.

Unlike traditional consulting, your impact here doesn't end on a slide: you'll see firsthand how your analyses, decisions, and projects get implemented in the organization, and what difference they actually make.

  • Lead strategic projects & drive operational excellence: You'll take full ownership of projects with direct visibility to the leadership team, from analysis through to implementation support. You'll analyze existing processes, particularly in operations, identify levers for efficiency and quality, and implement concrete improvement measures.

  • Data-driven decision making & stakeholder communication: You'll conduct in-depth data analyses, derive clear recommendations, and prepare decision materials for the leadership team, which you'll present convincingly both internally and externally.

  • M&A, integration & ad-hoc topics: As needed, you'll support due diligence, financial models, and post-merger integration, as well as sales pitches and other strategic topics with business impact.


Your skillset

  • Academic background: Outstanding degree in a technical or management-oriented field from (a) renowned university/universities.

  • Experience & track record: You bring at least 4 years of experience at a top-tier management consultancy such as McKinsey, BCG, or Bain at (engagement) manager/project lead level or above, where you took full ownership of strategic and operational topics and independently led teams and projects.

  • Thinking & way of working: You structure complex topics clearly, think in a data-driven, hypothesis-led way, have a strong analytical understanding of operations processes, and combine strategic vision with a genuine hands-on mentality.

  • Presence & communication: You bring executive presence and confident demeanor, you're a true team player without ego, and you communicate confidently in both German and English (at least C1).

  • M&A/integration processes: You bring solid experience in M&A/integration processes (e.g., due diligence, financial modeling, PMI), in the tech/SaaS industry, and/or in change management projects.


Your winning deal

  • Your benefits: In addition to 30 days of vacation, we also offer you a job lunch allowance (€69 per month), a “Givve” card (topped up with €50 per month) or a subsidized membership with Wellpass, discounts via “Corporate Benefits”, the option of leasing a JobRad, pension contributions (occupational pension & VL) and great team and company events.
  • Your workplace: You will work in a flexible, hybrid model from one of our dog-friendly and modern offices and will have the opportunity to do “work from abroad” within the EU for 2 weeks a year (*only applies to employees with an EU passport) 
  • Your footprint: A position in a profitable company where you have the freedom and confidence to help shape it and work with us on the “future of work”.
  • The values: We score highly with an open, authentic culture and a high-performing and humorous team that is already looking forward to making bold decisions with you and breaking new ground that will lead us to sustainable success.
  • Your opportunity: From day one, you will have the opportunity to take on responsibility, drive innovation and develop the company and yourself together with a team of experts.

title: Senior Go Engineer, Full Stack
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Topi
description_html:
Your mission

We're looking for product-minded engineers to join our diverse and driven team. We really value collaboration, making an impact, and continuous learning. Our product development team is based in Berlin, but we have folks working all over Europe, and you'll work closely with an experienced and supportive team.


Your profile

We are looking for a Senior Fullstack Engineer with deep expertise in Go to join a diverse, product-minded team that values collaboration, impact, and continuous learning. 

We're a distributed engineering team working across Europe (within +/- 1 hour of CET); topi is headquartered in Berlin. Engineers are expected to be comfortable navigating the entire stack (both Frontend and Backend).

In this role, you will be architecting features from the database to the browser. Your center of gravity is the Go backend, APIs, data models, system design, but you'll move into the React/TypeScript frontend whenever the feature requires it. You'll join an experienced and supportive team where you'll have a significant voice in shaping both our technical direction and the product itself.
     About You
This is a role for an engineer who lives in the backend but enjoys reaching across the stack. You'll thrive here if you can:

  • Own the Full Lifecycle: Build, scale, and maintain modern web applications where the heavy lifting sits in our Go backend, with the willingness to ship in React/TypeScript on the frontend whenever a feature calls for it.    
  • Bridge the Gap: Design and implement clean APIs in Go while ensuring they are seamlessly integrated into a performant, accessible React frontend.
  • Architect for Scale: Maintain high standards for code quality and performance across the entire stack, from backend microservices to frontend component libraries.
  • Collaborate Broadly: Work closely with Product and Design to turn ambiguous requirements into polished features.
  • Agentic Engineering Mindset: You treat AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, and the like) as real collaborators, not autocomplete. You own every line that ships under your name, whether you typed it or an agent did. You're motivated to deep-dive into agent workflows and bring the judgment that turns agent output into production-grade code.

To Be Successful in This Role, You'll Need:
  • Experience: at least 6+ years of professional software engineering experience in a production environment.
  • The Backend: Proven experience architecting and maintaining high-scale web APIs. You've shipped Go in production for 2+ years and are comfortable owning backend system design end-to-end.
  • The Frontend: Motivated and willing to work in our React/TypeScript frontend, with enough baseline ability to ship features there when a story calls for it. Prior hands-on React/TypeScript experience is a plus, not a must.
  • System Ownership: A "DevOps" mindset, comfortable with CI/CD, automated testing, and version control.
  • Communication: Fluent English and the ability to explain complex technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders.
What we care about
  • Teamwork: collaborating and supporting each other within engineering and across functions
  • Inclusion: creating an environment where everybody can bring their whole self and do their best work
  • Ownership: empowering you to do the work that is most impactful
  • Sustainability: balancing work with family and personal hobbies so we can be at our best
  • Growth: supporting each other's learning and development


Why topi?

  • Impact from Day One - Your ideas are valued, and you actively shape our direction. No long feedback loops or complex hierarchies - you'll have a direct impact on what you do.
  • Trust - We believe in our mission and in our team, offering trust-based working hours, permanent contracts, flexibility for home-country working.
  • Flexibility - We offer flexible working hour arrangements to ensure a healthy work-life balance.
  • Team Spirit - Shared rituals connect us, whether online or offline. We have regular formats like all-hands 
  • meetings, demo sessions, quizzes, and offsites - perfect opportunities to spend time as a team.
  • Personal Growth - Learn from experienced colleagues and leverage the latest technologies and methodologies to succeed in your role.

title: (Senior) Sustainability Manager
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Eqs Group
description_html:
JOIN OUR TEAM

As a (Senior) Sustainability Manager in our Product Management team, you will play a key role in shaping the future of our Sustainability Cockpit. Working at the intersection of product, regulation, and customer needs, you will drive the continued development of solutions supporting organisations in meeting evolving sustainability reporting requirements.

In this role, you will collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Customer Success to translate regulatory developments and customer feedback into valuable product capabilities. If you enjoy combining sustainability expertise with product thinking and want to help customers navigate an evolving ESG landscape, we'd love to hear from you.

EQS Group is a leading international cloud software provider in the areas of Compliance & Ethics, Data Privacy, Sustainability Management, and Investor Relations. We help thousands of companies worldwide to cultivate trust by simplifying complex processes, ensuring transparency, and enabling clear communication with stakeholders.

Our success is built on our people. We bring together talented individuals who care about doing meaningful work, take pride in what they do, and support one another to achieve more together. We believe passion and trust aren’t just values — they’re at the core of how we operate, every day.

Our mission is to Create Trusted Companies. If you share our passion for our mission, we’d love to have you help us turn it into reality.


OUR CULTURE DRIVES OUR BENEFITS

  • You're important. We foster a trusting environment and lifelong learning to support your individual development. Set personal development goals, receive support and regular feedback — we give you the tools to succeed.
  • Living our values. Our values connect us. They shape how we work and collaborate across teams and cultures, creating belonging, trust, and an environment where everyone can thrive.
  • Great atmosphere. We cultivate a dynamic culture where shared goals bring us together. From unforgettable company events to volunteering initiatives, we inspire and empower each other to make a positive impact.
  • Work-life balance is a must. Enjoy a modern office with state-of-the-art equipment, flexible working hours, and a hybrid model — including the ability to work from abroad within the EU. Paid vacation is standard, and for longer breaks, we offer a sabbatical because your free time matters too.
  • Special perks just for you. We offer you other exciting benefits, such as salary optimization in the form of customized bonus and benefit programs, as well as corporate shopping benefits.
  • Health is a priority. We support your well-being with company-sponsored sports programs for the use of various fitness studios, bicycle leasing via JobRad, and mental health counseling.


YOUR IMPACT

  • Drive the further development of the EQS Sustainability Cockpit with a particular focus on CSRD, EU Taxonomy, and sustainability reporting capabilities.
  • Translate regulatory developments and market requirements into clear product priorities and requirements.
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Sales, Customer Success Management (CSM), Engineering, and other cross-functional stakeholders to deliver customer-centric product enhancements.
  • Act as a sustainability subject matter expert for internal stakeholders, particularly Product, Sales, and Customer Success.
  • Participate in Sales and customer meetings to answer domain-specific questions and guide prospects and customers in navigating sustainability reporting requirements.
  • Gather and evaluate customer and market feedback to continuously improve the Sustainability Cockpit.
  • Monitor developments in the European sustainability reporting landscape and assess their impact on the product roadmap.
Be part of an exciting journey and contribute to our success story of becoming the leading provider of digital compliance and governance solutions.


THIS IS YOU

Must have

  • Professional experience in sustainability, ESG reporting, or sustainable finance, ideally within a software or technology environment.
  • Strong knowledge of CSRD, EU Taxonomy, and the European sustainability reporting landscape, complemented by knowledge of additional reporting frameworks or emerging regulatory developments.
  • Experience working with cross-functional product development and customer-facing teams, supported by strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Ability to translate complex regulatory requirements into structured product requirements.
  • Excellent written and spoken communication skills in German (C2) and English (C1).
  • Experience with ESG or sustainability reporting software.
  • Practical experience using AI productivity tools (ChatGPT, Claude, etc.) and AI-enabled workflow automation to make sustainability research, regulatory analysis, and product documentation more efficient, with a responsible approach to data privacy and output quality.
  • Experience supporting customer conversations, product demonstrations, or go-to-market initiatives.
Nice to have
  • Familiarity with agile product development methodologies.

We are open to hiring remotely in Germany.

title: Working Student, Data & Analytics (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at KNIME AG
description_html:
Mission

Support the Data & Analytics team in its day-to-day work, from pipelines to Data Apps and Reports to answering business questions.


Role Overview

As a Working Student in the Data & Analytics team, you will work alongside our analysts on what the week actually needs: a pipeline that has to keep running, a Data App a team is waiting for, a question someone needs answered. You will work in Knime every day, on things people across the company use. This is a role with real ownership: you get clearly scoped tasks and regular check-ins, and between them you work independently.


Responsibilities

  • Support the team day to day: take on the analysis, Report, or fix the week calls for, and see it through

  • Build and maintain data ingestion workflows, and keep scheduled pipelines running as our data sources change

  • Build Data Apps and Reports that teams across Knime use to answer their own questions

  • Research questions other teams bring us, and come back with an answer they can act on

  • Improve existing workflows, Data Apps, and Reports: performance, cleanup, and documentation

  • Own your tasks end to end: ask the scoping questions up front, execute independently, and hand over results clearly


Requirements

  • Enrolled at a university or Hochschule in Berlin, based in Berlin, with at least 12 months of study remaining

  • Available at least 16 hours a week, and on site in our Kreuzberg office two days a week

  • Working knowledge of Knime and data science fundamentals

  • Solid SQL and database basics

  • You research on your own: you find the sources, judge what is relevant, and come back with an answer instead of a list of links

  • You draft Data Apps and Reports with AI support, and can explain the result

  • A high degree of independence: you structure your own work and unblock yourself with documentation and research, and you know when to ask

  • Care and reliability when working on things other people depend on

  • Fluent in English


How to Stand out

  • A Knime L3 certification

  • Experience with schedules, spaces, and deployments in Knime

  • Python or JavaScript for small snippets and custom visualizations

  • German alongside English


Leveling

This position sits in the Data & Analytics team within Operations and reports to Iris Adä, VP Data & Analytics. It is a working student position of at least 16 hours per week alongside your studies, with two days a week in our Kreuzberg office.


What Success Looks Like

  • The team hands you a request and stops worrying about it

  • Workflows you have touched are faster, cleaner, and documented well enough for the next person

description_html:
Your role and responsibilities

  • You will learn how to support and advise colleagues on IT and application-related issues as part of first-level support.

  • You will analyze hardware and software problems and contribute to resolving them, demonstrating your problem-solving skills.

  • You will learn how to plan system and network infrastructures and implement them as part of a team.

  • You will assist in coordinating external service providers in dealing with hardware and software issues as part of second- and third-level support.

  • You will contribute to various projects involving the design and implementation of IT systems.

  • As you gain experience, you will contribute to creating training materials and guides for your colleagues.


Your profile

  • You have a good intermediate school-leaving qualification; a university of applied sciences entrance qualification or university entrance qualification is an advantage.

  • You have a strong technical understanding and are enthusiastic about IT topics and modern technologies.

  • You enjoy handling and solving all kinds of user-related issues and value personal interaction.

  • You demonstrate strong communication skills, initiative, and analytical thinking and are willing to learn new things.

  • You have a valid driving licence or are willing to obtain one during your apprenticeship (for occasional trips between our two locations using a pool vehicle).


     Your Apprenticeship at a Glance     

  • 3-year dual apprenticeship starting in summer 2027, including block-based classroom instruction at Werner-von-Siemens-Schule in Frankfurt.

  • Dedicated contacts and trainers who will support and guide you throughout your entire apprenticeship.




Why us?

Attractive apprenticeship salary: 1st year: €1,100 per month /2nd year: €1,200 per month /3rd year: €1,300 per month

Other benefits: We want our employees to feel comfortable. That's why we also offer other benefits, such as employee events, corporate benefits or the restaurant in the St. Martin Tower.

Diversity is an important part of our global corporate culture. Therefore we are pleased to receive applications from severely disabled people, who are given preference if they have the same qualifications.


Your contact person

Derya Tanriverdi

description_html:
Über uns:

In der Welt des IT-Handels gehen wir neue Wege: Das größte Sortiment, persönliche Beratung und tiefgehende Lösungskompetenz – aus einer Hand.
 
Wir arbeiten mit über 300 Mitarbeitenden deutschlandweit und mit einem der größten Onlineshops in Deutschland. Unser umfassendes Hersteller-Portfolio und unsere gebündelte Fachexpertise stellen dabei sicher, dass wir immer die richtige Lösung für individuelle Anforderungen bieten können.
 
Seit der Gründung im Jahr 1990 ist JACOB weit gekommen: Im Laufe der Jahrzehnte haben wir uns von einem regionalen Ladengeschäft in Karlsruhe zu einem bedeutenden IT-Dienstleister für Unternehmen entwickelt. Unser fester Wille, immer wieder innovative Ansätze zu suchen, hat diese Entwicklung erst ermöglicht.
 
Und diese Kreativität, gepaart mit Fachkompetenz, nehmen wir in die Zukunft mit. Wir möchten uns weiterentwickeln und dabei beibehalten, was uns ausmacht. Gehst du diesen Weg mit uns?

Product Manager (m/w/d) - Data Center / Network

in Vollzeit (40h).

  • Du analysierst Beschaffungsmärkte und beobachtest diese hinsichtlich Verfügbarkeit und Preisentwicklungen

Dein Profil:

  • Du hast deine kaufmännische Ausbildung erfolgreich abgeschlossen
  • Du hast jahrelange Berufserfahrung im strategischen Einkauf / Product- bzw. Category-Management 
  • Du hast erste Erfahrung vorzugsweise im IT-Handel oder Systemhaus mit Fokus auf den Bereich Data Center (Netzwerk & Server Infrastruktur) sammeln können
  • Du hast Kenntnisse mit PowerBi, ERP-Systemen und MS-Office
  • Du bist offen für gelegentliche Dienstreisen

title: Buyer Development Sr Director DACH
salary_basis: Based on leadership compensation records at Openx
description_html:
Company at a Glance
OpenX is focused on unleashing the full economic potential of digital media companies. We do this by making digital advertising markets and technologies that are designed to deliver optimal value to publishers and advertisers on every ad served across all screens.

At OpenX, we have built a team that is uniquely experienced in designing and operating high-scale ad marketplaces, and we are constantly on the lookout for thoughtful, creative executors who are as fascinated as we are about finding new ways to apply a blend of market design, technical innovation, operational excellence, and empathetic partner service to the frontiers of digital advertising.

OpenX is looking for a senior, commercially driven Buyer Development leader to establish and grow our demand-side business across DACH.
This is the first dedicated Buyer Development role in-market. The role will be directly responsible for generating revenue across agencies, holdcos, and clients / brands, building senior relationships and commercial foundations required for long-term growth.

The successful candidate will open senior buyer relationships, build and manage pipeline, progress strategic opportunities, and convert demand-side engagement into measurable revenue outcomes.

This is a senior individual contributor role to begin with. As the DACH opportunity matures, the ambition is for this person to help build and potentially lead a broader regional Buyer Development function once clear market proof points have been established.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Own Revenue Growth

  • Take direct responsibility for generating and growing buyer-led revenue across agencies, holdcos, and clients / brands in DACH.

     

  • Build and manage a qualified pipeline across PMP, curation, SPO, CTV, data-led activation, OpenX Select, premium supply, AI-led solutions, and direct buyer partnerships.

     

  • Convert senior relationships into commercial outcomes through consultative selling, strategic account planning, business cases, QBRs, joint business plans, and deal progression.

  • Maintain strong commercial discipline around pipeline, forecasting, revenue progression, and opportunity prioritisation.

     

  • Build the Market
  • Establish OpenX’s Buyer Development presence in DACH as the first dedicated in-market hire.
  • Create a clear map of priority buyers, agencies, holdcos, brands, DSPs, data partners, senior decision-makers, trading models, and commercial pathways.
  • Identify where OpenX can create the most meaningful and scalable impact in the region.
  • Build the foundations for a future regional team, including account prioritisation, pipeline discipline, market feedback loops, and cross-functional ways of working.
  • Work Cross-Functionally
  • Work closely with Sales, Account Management, Product, Marketing, global Buyer Development, DSP Strategic Partnerships, and the Data Partner function to shape, activate, measure, and scale DACH opportunities.
  • Partner with DSP Strategic Partnerships to improve buyer access, support SPO conversations, and ensure agency and client demand can be activated efficiently through priority DSP routes.
  • Partner with the Data Partner function to identify relevant data-led opportunities for DACH buyers, including curated marketplaces, audience-led activation, and strategic client solutions.
  • Build OpenX’s Market Presence
  • Represent OpenX as a credible senior voice in the DACH programmatic market.
  • Support OpenX’s visibility through senior meetings, client education, industry events, roundtables, and thought leadership.
  • Position OpenX around key buyer priorities including transparency, sustainability, premium supply, curation, data quality, supply path optimisation, and a healthier digital advertising ecosystem.

    • Requirements:
  • 7+ years of experience as a senior commercial individual contributor with deep knowledge of the DACH programmatic advertising ecosystem and a strong network across agencies, holdcos, brands, DSPs, and strategic partners.
  • The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of revenue ownership, opening senior relationships, building pipeline, and converting strategic opportunities into commercial outcomes.
  • They should be credible with senior clients and partners, highly self-motivated, commercially disciplined, and comfortable building a market from an early-stage position.
  • Fluency in German and English is required.

    We stake our personal and professional reputations on the excellence of our work
    We are not interested in just "doing our jobs"; we take ownership to drive results

    WE ARE AN OPEN BOOK
    We understand and respect what each of us does. We are eager to teach and share what we know with others, both internally and externally. We are eager to learn from others and we ask questions internally and externally. 

    WE EVOLVE FAST
    We take responsible risks and own and learn from our mistakes. We recognize and repeat success. We actively seek out and provide constructive feedback. We adapt quickly and embrace change. We tackle growth and learning with real urgency. We are endlessly curious.

    Our three traits capture what makes a great team member at OpenX.

    HUMBLE
    Ideal team players are humble and demonstrate integrity. They put the team's success above their own, share credit generously, and value collective achievements. They are self-assured, open to coaching, and committed to continuous learning.

    Ideal team players are smart and possess the intellectual acumen to understand the complexities of our organization and industry. They are interpersonally intelligent, good communicators, and exemplify sound judgment in their interactions across the company to foster a collaborative environment.

title: Backend Developer - Laravel / AWS (m/f/x) in Berlin
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Konfetti GmbH
description_html:
konfetti is the booking platform and software for local workshops. Since our founding in April 2021, we have continuously developed our product and now work with more than 3,000 providers. In total, we offer over 13,000 experiences in Germany, Austria, and online.

Your next step → konfetti!

We are looking for a backend engineer to help us build the next generation of the konfetti platform. Our ambitions for the product have grown, and so has what we need from our backend and architecture. This is a hands-on role with real ownership of technical direction, not a ticket queue.

You will join a lean engineering team of four, working directly with our designer and product lead. Small team, short path from idea to production, and plenty of room to leave your mark.

Become part of a world-class team with an office-first culture in Berlin!

Tasks

  • You own backend features end to end, from initial analysis through deployment and monitoring, including our partner-facing booking software (Backoffice)
  • You shape our architecture: you identify what is holding the product back, propose a direction, and then build it
  • You work across service boundaries, data models, queues, integrations, and performance, and you improve monitoring and address technical debt without being asked
  • You use AI tooling as a core part of how you work, including on parts of the stack outside your specialization
  • You think critically about requirements and identify edge cases early, drawing on your experience of what can go wrong in production
  • You actively collaborate with our tight-knit team of engineers, designer, and product lead in daily standups, planning, and technical discussions: asking questions when something is unclear, sharing blockers early, and contributing your perspective

Requirements

  • Several years of production backend experience, ideally with PHP/Laravel, and a track record of systems you built that other people still run
  • Strong opinions about architecture, backed by reasons and by having lived with the consequences of your past decisions
  • Solid experience with AWS services such as Lambda, SQS, EC2, ECS/Fargate, CloudFront, and Bedrock, and comfort owning what you ship in production
  • Real fluency with AI-assisted development. We use Claude Code day to day and can also offer Cursor. We want someone who already works this way and can push the rest of the team forward
  • A maker mindset and a can-do attitude: you would rather build the thing than write a document about building the thing
  • The confidence to challenge how things are done today, the respect to understand why they were done that way first, and the honesty to say when you do not know something

Benefits

Compensation

  • Attractive Salary
  • Employee Stock Options: Become a true part of our success at konfetti!
  • Growing Vacation Policy: 25 days base holiday + 1 extra day for every year of tenure (up to 30 days)
  • Holiday Perks: You get a half-day off on both Christmas Eve and New Year’s Eve

Benefits

  • 50% Employee Discount on all konfetti workshops and experiences
  • Exclusive Corporate Benefits and discounts with numerous partners
  • Subsidized Deutschlandticket (public transport subsidy)
  • Discounted Urban Sports Club membership
  • Epic team events: we have thousands of great events at our disposal! 🎉

Learning curve & Impact

  • Structured Onboarding: with the help of our konfetti cannon and a personal buddy to guide you through your first steps with us
  • Learning & Development Program: Together, we master today’s challenges and tomorrow’s opportunities
  • Regular 1:1 Sessions and open feedback culture
  • Ownership from Day 1: Manage your own projects and enjoy the creative freedom to bring your ideas to life

Apply today! Please upload your resume, current references, and a short cover letter in one file (max. 20 MB total).

We look forward to receiving your application and getting to know you!

title: Fördermittelberater / Berater Forschungszulage (m/w/d) - 100 % remote
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at ENTWURFREICH GmbH
description_html:
Forschung im Mittelstand scheitert selten daran, dass die Ideen ausgehen. Sie endet dann, wenn das Budget ausgeht. Hier kommen Sie ins Spiel: Sie setzen sich mit den Entwicklern an den Tisch, hören zu und arbeiten aus ihrer Arbeit ein förderfähiges Vorhaben heraus. Sie kalkulieren es, formulieren es und bringen es durch die Prüfstelle. Das Mandat gehört Ihnen, die fachliche Entscheidung auch.

Genau dafür gibt es fundloop. Wir unterstützen mittelständische Unternehmen dabei, ihre Forschung und Entwicklung über die steuerliche Forschungszulage zu finanzieren, und haben dafür eine eigene Software gebaut, die Ihnen bei dieser Arbeit den Rücken freihält. Sie arbeiten zu 100 Prozent remote, ohne Beratungsapparat über sich und mit direktem Draht zur Geschäftsführung.

Aufgaben

Sie beraten Unternehmen bei der inhaltlichen Ausgestaltung und Strukturierung ihrer Förderprojekte in Forschung, Entwicklung und Innovation. Im Einzelnen heißt das:

  • Förderprojekte formen: Aus dem, was ein Unternehmen tatsächlich entwickelt, schneiden Sie ein sauber abgegrenztes Vorhaben zu - Technische Neuheit, wissenschaftliche und technische Unsicherheit und Arbeitspakete.
  • Fachlich bewerten: Sie beurteilen früh, ob ein Vorhaben förderfähig ist. Auch dann, wenn die Antwort Nein lautet.
  • Projektkosten selbstständig prüfen und kalkulieren: Personalaufwand, Auftragsforschung und Eigenleistungen, plausibel hergeleitet und GoBD-konform dokumentiert, mit Blick auf eine spätere Betriebsprüfung.
  • Mit der Prüfstelle kommunizieren: Sie führen den Austausch mit der Bescheinigungsstelle Forschungszulage in Stufe 1 und beantworten deren Rückfragen. Die steuerliche Einreichung in Stufe 2 verantwortet der Steuerberater des Mandanten, mit dem Sie eng zusammenarbeiten.
  • Mandate führen: Kickoff, Interviews mit Entwicklern und Technikern, Unterlagen einsammeln, Termine halten.

Qualifikation

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Naturwissenschaften, Technik oder Wirtschaft.
  • Forschungsbackground - Im Gespräch mit Technikern erkennen Sie, was wirklich neu ist und was gut gemachte Routine.
  • Mindestens drei Jahre Erfahrung mit Fördermittelanträgen, etwa Forschungszulage, ZIM, KMU-innovativ oder EU-Programme. Sie kennen den Unterschied zwischen einem schön geschriebenen Antrag und einem, der einer Prüfung standhält.
  • Sie sehen Chancen, gehen Herausforderungen aktiv an und arbeiten auf Lösungen hin, statt Probleme zu verwalten.
  • Selbstständige und verbindliche Arbeitsweise. Remote heißt bei uns Vertrauen, dafür strukturieren Sie Ihre Fälle eigenständig.
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, da Anträge, Projektbeschreibungen und Behördenkommunikation auf Deutsch entstehen. Englisch ist von Vorteil.

Benefits

  • 100 % remote - Vor Ort sehen wir uns nur gelegentlich, beim Mandanten oder bei uns in Düsseldorf.
  • Vollzeit mit 40 Stunden, unbefristet, Start ab sofort.
  • Eine Rolle zum Gestalten. Sie entscheiden mit, wie unsere Delivery aussieht, statt Prozesse zu erben, die jemand anders gebaut hat.
  • Werkzeuge, die Sie wirklich unterstützen. Unsere Software begleitet jeden Schritt eines Mandats, damit Ihre Zeit in die fachliche Beurteilung geht.
  • Kurze Wege und direkter Draht zur Geschäftsführung. Kein Beratungsapparat, keine Pyramide, keine Zwischenebenen.
  • Ein Thema mit Rückenwind. Die Forschungszulage wächst, der Beratungsbedarf im Mittelstand wächst mit.

Wenn Sie Förderanträge nicht als Formularübung verstehen, sondern als Fachfrage, dann passen Sie zu uns.

So geht es weiter: Wir melden uns innerhalb weniger Tage. Im ersten Gespräch lernen Sie die Geschäftsführung kennen, im zweiten sprechen wir über einen echten Fall aus der Praxis. Danach entscheiden wir zügig.

title: Director of Sales, ITS, Europe

description_html:
Who is Seyond? 

 
Seyond is a leading global provider of image-grade LiDAR technology, powering a safer, smarter and more mobile world across the automotive, intelligent transportation, robotics and industrial automation sectors. Founded in Silicon Valley with strategically placed research and manufacturing facilities across the globe, Seyond is crafting LiDAR solutions that elevate autonomous driving and fuel the advancement of smart infrastructure development. Our dynamic portfolio – including ultra-long range flagship LiDAR sensor Falcon, mid-to-short range LiDAR sensor Robin and perception service software platform OmniVidi – powers automotive and ITS solutions for partners like NIO, Faraday Future, Exwayz and Hexagon. Currently, over 200,000 Falcon units are in use, and the product continues to be mass-produced today. 

 

Senior Director of Sales, Europe

SIMPL Business Unit — Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS)

Seyond

Location: Germany preferred (open to strong candidates elsewhere in Europe)

Reports to: Philip Lassner, Head of Global ITS Business (ex-US/China)

Team: SIMPL Business Unit — LiDAR-based smart intersection and highway detection

Employment type: Full-time

About Seyond SIMPL

SIMPL is scaling its international footprint across Europe, APAC, and emerging markets, and is building out dedicated regional sales leadership to match the growth already underway in the Americas.

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Director of Sales to build and lead SIMPL's sales function across Europe — a role modeled on the regional sales leadership Seyond has already established in the Americas. You will report directly to Philip Lassner, Head of Global ITS Business, and will sit above SIMPL's country-level sales representatives across Europe, giving the region a single accountable sales leader for the first time.

This is a player-coach role. We need someone who has personally carried and exceeded a sales quota — not a candidate whose background is purely sales operations or account management — and who can also recruit, coach, and manage a small, distributed team of regional reps as the European organization scales.

What You'll Do

  • Build and lead SIMPL's European sales organization, recruiting, onboarding, and coaching country and regional sales representatives.
  • Personally own and close strategic opportunities while the regional team is being built out, transitioning toward a team-quota model as the organization scales.
  • Develop and execute go-to-market strategy across both SIMPL verticals: urban intersection management and inter-urban highway/tunnel/tolling detection.
  • Manage and grow relationships with European distributors, system integrators, and OEM partners, alongside direct engagement with end-user agencies and pilot customers.
  • Own the European sales pipeline and forecast in HubSpot, maintaining accurate deal ownership, stage progression, and close-date discipline.
  • Represent SIMPL at European trade shows, industry events, and customer meetings.
  • Partner with SIMPL's European engineering team on technical qualification and solution scoping for major opportunities.
  • Collaborate with the Head of Global ITS Business and BU leadership on regional pricing, deal structuring, and strategic account planning.
  • Establish clear rep-level KPIs that balance new-business generation with existing-account growth, supported by weekly activity tracking.

What We're Looking For

  • 8+ years of B2B sales experience, ideally in ITS, smart infrastructure, industrial IoT/sensors, or another technical, tender-driven market.
  • A proven personal quota-carrying track record as an individual contributor — a genuine "hunter," not primarily an account manager or sales-ops leader.
  • Experience building or leading a distributed regional sales team, ideally spanning multiple European countries.
  • Comfort managing both channel relationships (distributors, OEMs, system integrators) and direct end-user/agency sales cycles.
  • Experience navigating public-sector or government tender processes is a strong plus.
  • Fluent English required; German or another major European language is a plus.
  • Willingness to travel extensively across Europe.

Nice to Have

  • An existing network in European traffic management, tolling, or highway agencies.
  • Experience selling LiDAR, radar, or other sensor-based detection technologies.
  • Familiarity with HubSpot or a comparable CRM.

Compensation

Competitive base and incentive package, benchmarked to Director-level sales leadership roles in the European technology/industrial sector. Final compensation band to be confirmed following market benchmarking.

title: Senior Engineering Manager - Marketplace
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Mirakl - Labs
description_html:
About Mirakl:

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl's operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy's, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information: www.mirakl.com.

Mirakl in Numbers:

  • 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40
  • 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo
  • 🇫🇷 350+ Mirakl Tech teams members mainly based in France
  • ⚙️ 5 Saas Solutions

Our Values:

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

  • 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success
  • 🏆 Get Things Done:  We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results
  • 🚀 Go Above & Beyond:  We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence
  • 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture
  • 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

The Team You'll Join

You'll be part of our Mirakl Connect Engineering team lead by Jean-Yves Cazac, Engineering Director. The team consists of approximately 50 engineers covering the full Mirakl Connect product scope, from seller onboarding and experience to marketplace integrations and channel management. Together, you'll be shaping how sellers and brands connect, operate, and grow across multiple marketplaces worldwide.

In this role, you will directly lead 2 squads — Seller Experience and Channel Integration — representing approximately 12 engineers based between Paris, & Bordeaux, with close collaboration with colleagues based in the US.

Location: Based in Paris or Bordeaux office with one day of remote work per week.

 

Your Impact

  • Lead and develop two engineering squads responsible for the seller journey on Mirakl Connect and integrations with external marketplaces such as Amazon, Walmart, and Zalando, ensuring reliable delivery and a high engineering bar across both teams.
  • Partner closely with Product and Design to define priorities, translate business needs into execution plans, and make trade-offs that balance delivery speed, quality, and technical sustainability.
  • Drive the technical direction of your scope — challenging architectural choices, ensuring solutions are scalable and maintainable, and raising best practices in testing, observability, and incident management.
  • Develop your people: coach engineers and tech leads, identify growth opportunities, run performance and career conversations, and contribute to attracting strong talent into the organization.
  • Build a strong operating model for your teams — improving ways of working pragmatically, protecting team focus, fostering ownership, and enabling effective collaboration with distributed and international stakeholders.

 

What You'll Bring to the Role

Experience:

  • At least 4 to 5 years of experience managing engineering teams, with a track record of leading teams of 5 to 6 engineers or more, ideally across multiple squads.
  • Proven experience in e-commerce, marketplaces, channel management, feed management, catalog or order management — or a closely related domain.
  • A solid Java background — you may no longer be hands-on today, but you have the depth to challenge architectural decisions, assess technical trade-offs, and manage a team of Java engineers with credibility.
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver in a demanding and fast-moving environment, while protecting team focus and adapting your management approach to the existing context.
  • Experience collaborating with international and cross-functional stakeholders across time zones.

Skills:

  • Engineering leadership: ability to set direction, delegate effectively, and develop people at all levels.
  • Execution in complexity: capable of managing delivery, priorities, and trade-offs across multiple teams simultaneously.
  • Technical judgment: able to engage in Java architecture discussions, challenge integration design choices, and guide engineers on complex distributed systems.
  • Fluent English: able to lead discussions, challenge decisions, and collaborate autonomously with US-based and international partners.

 

Tech Stack

  • Java (recent versions)
  • Spring Framework
  • SQL
  • Cloud platforms
  • Microservices architecture

 

Languages

  • French: Full professional proficiency
  • English mandatory: Full professional proficiency — approximately 50% of your working time will be in English

 

Our Hiring Process

We warmly encourage you to apply to any of our roles, even if you think you're not an exact match.
Please click the "Apply" button to submit your application — this helps us make the best possible assessment and get back to you as quickly as possible.

  1. 30/45 min call with a Talent Acquisition to discuss your key projects, ask technical questions, and present the position in details
  2. 1 hour Hiring Manager interview 
  3. 2x45 min STAR interviews to assess your alignment with our values and meet other stakeholders

We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. If you're ready to join a global leader powering digital transformation for 450+ of the world's most innovative retailers and B2B organizations.

As part of our recruitment process, Mirakl processes your personal data to review and manage your application and, where appropriate, to consider your profile for future opportunities. You can exercise your data protection rights at any time, and as further detailed in our policies. For more information about how we process your personal data and your rights, please consult our Recruitment Privacy Notice, here in English and here in French. 

We may use Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions to help streamline our hiring process, including screening applications, analyzing resumes, and assessing responses. While AI helps us work efficiently, all final hiring decisions are made by humans. For more information, visit our AI Guidelines for Candidates and Interviews.

Together, you'll be shaping how sellers and brands connect, operate, and grow across multiple marketplaces worldwide.

In this role, you will directly lead 2 squads — Seller Experience and Channel Integration — representing approximately 12 engineers based between Paris, & Bordeaux, with close collaboration with colleagues based in the US.

Location: Based in Paris or Bordeaux office with one day of remote work per week.

 

Your Impact

  • Lead and develop two engineering squads responsible for the seller journey on Mirakl Connect and integrations with external marketplaces such as Amazon, Walmart, and Zalando, ensuring reliable delivery and a high engineering bar across both teams.
  • Partner closely with Product and Design to define priorities, translate business needs into execution plans, and make trade-offs that balance delivery speed, quality, and technical sustainability.
  • Drive the technical direction of your scope — challenging architectural choices, ensuring solutions are scalable and maintainable, and raising best practices in testing, observability, and incident management.
  • Develop your people: coach engineers and tech leads, identify growth opportunities, run performance and career conversations, and contribute to attracting strong talent into the organization.
  • Build a strong operating model for your teams — improving ways of working pragmatically, protecting team focus, fostering ownership, and enabling effective collaboration with distributed and international stakeholders.

 

What You'll Bring to the Role

Experience:

  • At least 4 to 5 years of experience managing engineering teams, with a track record of leading teams of 5 to 6 engineers or more, ideally across multiple squads.

  • A solid Java background — you may no longer be hands-on today, but you have the depth to challenge architectural decisions, assess technical trade-offs, and manage a team of Java engineers with credibility.
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver in a demanding and fast-moving environment, while protecting team focus and adapting your management approach to the existing context.
  • Experience collaborating with international and cross-functional stakeholders across time zones.

Skills:

  • Engineering leadership: ability to set direction, delegate effectively, and develop people at all levels.
  • Execution in complexity: capable of managing delivery, priorities, and trade-offs across multiple teams simultaneously.
  • Technical judgment: able to engage in Java architecture discussions, challenge integration design choices, and guide engineers on complex distributed systems.
  • Fluent English: able to lead discussions, challenge decisions, and collaborate autonomously with US-based and international partners.

 

Tech Stack

  • Java (recent versions)
  • Spring Framework
  • SQL

  • Microservices architecture

 

Languages

Location: Based in Paris or Bordeaux office with one day of remote work per week.

Skills:

Tech Stack

Languages

title: Edge Functions Engineer
description_html:
About Supabase

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

Edge Functions are server-side TypeScript functions, distributed globally at the edge - close to your users. They power use cases such as webhook receivers, AI inferences, OG image generation and real-time bots (Slack, Discord, etc). Built on top of Supabase Edge Runtime: an open-source, Deno-based runtime written in Rust that runs JavaScript, TypeScript, and WASM services.

We want developers to be able to build truly global applications by distributing both compute and data globally. Infrastructure concerns like regions, cold starts, CPU and memory provisioning should fade into the background so developers can focus on iterating on business logic.

We are looking for experienced and passionate engineers to help us go further in this vision.

What You’ll Own

  • Evolving Supabase Edge Runtime - an Open-sourced Rust-based host that runs the Deno isolate, manages the main/user runtime split, and enforces per-request memory and CPU limits.

  • Implementing monitoring, alerting, and OpenTelemetry tracing across the runtime, then using that visibility to drive optimizations that improve latency and reliability of the service.

  • Working closely with the Deno and other open-source teams, contributing to upstream and relaying our users' requirements.

  • Participating in an on-call rotation to keep Edge Functions healthy in production.

  • Help manage and improve features like scheduled functions, background tasks, WebSockets streaming, ephemeral file storage, and custom routing.

  • Integrating functions more tightly with the rest of the Supabase stack - Auth, Postgres, Storage, and Realtime.

  • Expanding functions to support more use cases (AI inference, MCP servers, hosting simple websites, URL shorteners).

  • Improving the DX of developing and debugging functions locally through the Supabase CLI, including DevTools integration, logging, and production parity.

What You’ll Bring

  • At least 5 years of backend or systems engineering experience, with strong fluency in Rust and TypeScript.

  • Experience with V8 Isolates, Deno and the JavaScript runtimes in general.

  • Experience operating infrastructure at scale - Kubernetes, AWS, Cloudflare Workers, Redis, or comparable systems.

  • A strong vision for how compute and data can be pushed to the edge.

  • Bonus: experience building developer-facing CLIs or front-end tooling that sits on top of an infrastructure product.

What We Offer

  • Fully Remote

    We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

  • ESOP

    Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

  • Tech Allowance

    Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

  • Health Benefits

    Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

  • Annual Off-Sites

    Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

  • Flexible Work

    We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

  • Professional Development

    Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.

About the Team

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

  • ~400 team members

  • 60+ countries

  • 20+ languages spoken

  • Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

  • 540,000+ community members

We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

title: Product Lead - Infrastructure
description_html:
Supabase is the open-source Postgres development platform that 10M+ developers and thousands of enterprises depend on every day. Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime and Vector Search all run on one platform: the same compute, the same disks, the same network and control plane, in every region we operate.

Supabase's hardest problems live in that platform. Millions of databases, growth that compounds every quarter, and a customer base running from a developer on a free project to a regulated enterprise routing traffic through PrivateLink. Reliability, capacity, cost and the enterprise features that close deals all come back to the same primitives. We're hiring a Product Lead to own them.

About the role

You own the platform primitives every Supabase product runs on: compute, disks, networking, the API gateway, capacity and regions. You own the enterprise surfaces built on top of them too, including read replicas, custom domains, PrivateLink and Bring Your Own Cloud. You report to the Head of Product and set direction for the whole area alongside the leads for our other product lines. You're the only product person on the platform today, and the team grows under you as the area does.

What you'll be responsible for:

  • You talk to customers across the full spectrum. Developers running a single small project, growing startups whose bill is mostly compute and disk, enterprises walking through a network architecture review, and partners building on top of Supabase.

  • You own the problem statement and requirements behind every platform bet. You define what we're building and why before engineering starts, name the cost, capacity and reliability constraints, and keep that clarity current through execution.

  • You decide what gets built, what gets deferred, and what gets cut. Every quarter you're choosing between enterprise unlocks that open new markets, cost and performance wins for the long tail of projects, and net-new capabilities that change what Supabase can run. The priorities are yours, and so is defending them.

  • You own reliability as a product surface. You set service levels that track what customers experience, hold teams to them, and show customers what it takes to run millions of databases.

  • You define how each launch is measured before it ships. The metric, the threshold and the read afterwards are yours: whether a launch moved enterprise deal velocity, project economics, or platform reliability.

  • You keep engineering, design and leadership aligned. The platform touches every other Supabase product, every region and every customer tier. You write down what's coming, why, and in what order, and you surface dependencies before they become blockers.

You might be a good fit if you:

  • Have 8+ years of product management experience on developer tools, or are an ex-founder who has built in this space. You're technical enough to read an architecture doc and follow a design discussion.

  • Have shipped cloud infrastructure as a product. You've owned at least one of compute, networking, storage, or multi-region and multi-tenant systems at a cloud, infrastructure or PaaS company, as the owner rather than a neighbouring team. You can judge the tradeoffs: instance sizing and capacity, disk and storage economics, scale-to-zero versus always-on, single-tenant versus shared, and the distance between "works in one region" and "works in twenty." Familiarity with how enterprises buy infrastructure (PrivateLink, BYOC, procurement) is a bonus.

  • Have grown with an infrastructure product. You've owned infrastructure small enough to hold in your head, and stayed with it until capacity, regions and cost became the real constraints.

  • Are biased toward speed. You'd rather ship something imperfect and learn from it.

  • Build with what you own. You stand up a read replica, put a custom domain in front of a project, terminate traffic through PrivateLink, deploy onto BYOC. You develop opinions through first-hand use.

  • Use AI to move faster. You lean on AI for the slow parts of the job (research, drafting, synthesising feedback) so you spend more time on judgment calls.

  • Work async by default. We're fully remote. You make decisions in writing and move work forward without meetings.

What We Offer

  • Fully Remote

    We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

  • ESOP

    Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

  • Tech Allowance

    Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

  • Health Benefits

    Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

  • Annual Off-Sites

    Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

  • Flexible Work

    We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

  • Professional Development

    Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.

About the Team

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

  • ~400 team members

  • 60+ countries

  • 20+ languages spoken

  • Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

  • 540,000+ community members

We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

title: Mantle Squad - Global
description_html:
Mantle Squad

Role Overview

Mantle Squad Members are community ambassadors who extend the Mantle team by bridging the ecosystem with global Web3 communities through engagement, activations, and localized storytelling.

We are searching for talents who are strong in one or more of the skill areas below and can contribute meaningfully while collaborating with the broader Mantle Squad.

Job Responsibilities

Community Building & Ecosystem Engagement

  • Represent Mantle as a community ambassador across global Web3 ecosystems

  • Build and actively engage local and online communities

  • Engage builders, students, and early-stage founders to support ecosystem growth

  • Drive awareness and adoption of Mantle’s RWA & AI ecosystem

  • Maintain post-event relationships and convert engagement into long-term ecosystem participation

Events & Offline Activations

  • Support, co-host, and participate in meetups, panels, and industry events

  • Collaborate with the Mantle team on community-led activations and campaigns

  • Identify partnership, media, and collaboration opportunities across the RWA/AI space

  • Support outreach that helps amplify Mantle’s brand, updates, and ecosystem stories

  • Strengthen Mantle’s presence through grassroots and community-led activations

  • Act as a connector between communities and Mantle to unlock long-term opportunities

Content, Distribution & Localization

  • Distribute ecosystem updates and campaigns across community channels and social platforms

  • Localize and adapt content for different cultural and regional audiences

  • Amplify Mantle narratives across Discord, Telegram, X, and other platforms

  • Ensure consistent communication of ecosystem updates across communities

Ecosystem Growth & Feedback

  • Provide structured feedback from community sentiment to Mantle

  • Surface opportunities for partnerships, collaborations, and ecosystem growth

  • Support improvement of community initiatives through real user insights

  • Act as a bridge between local communities and the core Mantle team

Requirements

  • 2+ years of experience in crypto/Web3 marketing, community, or ecosystem roles

  • Strong understanding of Web3 ecosystems, crypto culture, and community-driven growth models

  • Proven ability to engage, grow, and activate online and offline communities

  • Strong ownership mindset with the ability to execute independently in fast-paced, distributed teams

  • Excellent communication, storytelling, and relationship-building skills

  • Comfortable working across community platforms such as Discord, Telegram, and X

  • Ability to adapt messaging and engage across diverse cultural and regional audiences

  • Strongly connected within Web3 ecosystems (founders, creators, communities, or partners is a plus)

Why Join Mantle Squad

  • Be part of Mantle’s early global expansion efforts with real ownership and impact

  • Work closely with core teams and ecosystem contributors, with opportunities for direct collaboration

  • Gain exposure to major industry events and ecosystem activations (including sponsored participation opportunities)

  • Opportunity to grow into expanded regional leadership or full-time roles based on performance

  • Build and accelerate your personal brand within the Web3 ecosystem

About Supabase

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

About the role

Auth, written in Go (server) and with client libraries for TypeScript, SSR and for other frameworks and technologies, is one of the most popular products in the Supabase stack. We are seeking someone to help us build new and maintain existing Auth features.

What you’ll be responsible for

  • Designing and implementing secure, scalable authentication features in Go and TypeScript.

title: Senior Product Manager, Digital Risk Protection Takedowns
description_html:
With 1,000+ intelligence professionals serving over 1,900 clients worldwide, Recorded Future is the world’s most advanced, and largest, intelligence company!

Recorded Future is seeking a Senior Product Manager to own and advance takedown capabilities within our Digital Risk Protection portfolio. This is a high-impact individual contributor role with broad ownership and visibility across a critical area of the business.

The work sits at the intersection of cybersecurity, product development, automation, external partnerships, and business strategy, with the opportunity to shape how Recorded Future delivers and scales takedown outcomes globally.

What You’ll Do:

  • Own the strategy and roadmap: Define the vision, priorities, and operating model for takedown capabilities within Digital Risk Protection.
  • Strengthen service delivery: Assess current workflows, performance, escalations, and customer pain points, then drive immediate and sustained improvements.
  • Scale the capability: Prioritize the highest-impact takedown types and translate complex operational requirements into scalable product workflows.
  • Design the operating model: Partner with Engineering and AI teams to improve validation, evidence collection, authorization, submission, monitoring, escalation, verification, and reporting, including where automation or human review is required.
  • Establish safeguards: Work with Legal and external experts to address authorization, false positives, liability, policy requirements, and regional differences.
  • Build the external ecosystem: Develop relationships with registrars, hosting providers, platforms, and other disruption partners to improve speed and success.
  • Measure and grow impact: Establish meaningful performance metrics and partner with Product Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success on packaging, monetization, adoption, retention, and growth.

What You’ll Bring:

  • Deep, direct experience executing, designing, or leading digital takedown services, with meaningful ownership of the takedown lifecycle.
  • Strong understanding of how requirements and execution vary by threat type, provider, platform, geography, evidence standard, and legal or policy basis.
  • Experience across relevant use cases such as phishing, malicious sites, domain abuse, impersonation, trademark or copyright infringement, social media abuse, or exposed code and data.
  • Experience turning complex, manual operations into product strategy, requirements, workflows, and scalable technology.
  • Technical fluency with APIs, automation, AI-assisted workflows, integrations, and human-in-the-loop controls.
  • Strong judgment around customer impact, false positives, liability, and when to involve legal or other subject-matter experts.
  • Demonstrated ability to align Product, Engineering, Legal, Support, and commercial teams without relying on a large dedicated organization.
  • A hands-on, curious, and collaborative approach, with the ability to solve immediate problems while building the longer-term model.
  • Existing relationships with registrars, hosting providers, platforms, or disruption partners are valuable. The ability and willingness to build them is essential.

The base salary range for this full-time position is $152,000- $228,500. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The salary displayed reflects the range for new hire salaries for the position across all US locations. Within the range, individual pay is determined by state, work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. This position may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, and medical, dental, vision, life insurance and 401K. Your recruiter can share more about the specific details of the compensation and benefit package during the hiring process.

#LI-Remote

Why should you join Recorded Future?
Recorded Future employees (or “Futurists”), represent over 40 nationalities and embody our core values of having high standards, practicing inclusion, and acting ethically. Our dedication to empowering clients with intelligence to disrupt adversaries has earned us a 4.6-star user rating on G2 and more than 50% of Fortune 100 companies as customers.

Want more info?
Blog & Podcast: Learn everything you want to know (and maybe some things you’d rather not know) about the world of cyber threat intelligence
Linkedin, Instagram & Twitter: What’s happening at Recorded Future
The Record: The Record is a cybersecurity news publication that explores the untold stories in this rapidly changing field
Timeline: History of Recorded Future
Recognition: Check out our awards and announcements

We are committed to maintaining an environment that attracts and retains talent from a diverse range of experiences, backgrounds and lifestyles. By ensuring all feel included and respected for being unique and bringing their whole selves to work, Recorded Future is made a better place every day.

If you need any accommodation or special assistance to navigate our website or to complete your application, please send an e-mail with your request to our recruiting team at careers@recordedfuture.com

Recorded Future is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer and we encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. Recorded Future does not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender including pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, disability or any other characteristic protected by law.

Recorded Future will not discharge, discipline or in any other manner discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because such employee or applicant has inquired about, discussed, or disclosed the compensation of the employee or applicant or another employee or applicant.

Recorded Future does not administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. This is in compliance with the law of the Commonwealth of Massachusetts, and in alignment with our hiring practices across all jurisdictions.

Recorded Future maintains a drug-free workplace.

Note: Our interview process for all final-round candidates requires a mandatory in-person interview or a live, scheduled video conference with the hiring manager. We do not conduct interviews via instant messaging or text. All communications during the application process will come from individuals within our HR department via their Recorded Future email address.

Notice to Agency and Search Firm Representatives: Recorded Future will not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than directly from a candidate. Any unsolicited resumes sent to Recorded Future, including those sent to our employees or through our website, will become the property of Recorded Future. Recorded Future will not be liable for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Agencies must have a valid written agreement in place with Recorded Future's recruitment team and must receive written authorization before submitting resumes. Submissions made without such agreements and authorization will not be accepted and no fees will be paid.
