title: B2B Marketing Manager (ASEAN)
description_html:
Ajax Systems is an international tech company and the largest manufacturer of security systems in Europe, with over 4.5 million end users and 330K PRO users in more than 180 countries worldwide. The company offers end-to-end solutions for protecting homes and businesses оf any scale. To date, Ajax product portfolio includes 280 devices for intrusion protection, video surveillance, fire and life safety, and comfort and automation. The company employs 5,000 specialists.

We develop local teams because we understand local experts best comprehend market specifics. The company has sales representatives worldwide, including Italy, Spain, Germany, France, the United Kingdom, the USA, Australia, South Africa and other regions.

The Global Business Development team is like-minded people who share the ambitious goals of Ajax Systems. The best software combined with powerful hardware has forever changed the perception of security systems for users and industry professionals. Being recognized at the biggest specialized exhibitions such as IFSEC, Expoprotection and Intersec, as well as winning prestigious awards from industry-leading media like PSI magazine and GIT SECURITY, today Ajax is one of the most awarded security systems in Europe.

Ajax Systems production includes four factories, two of which are located in Ukraine, one in Turkey and one in Vietnam. At the same time, the company's certification according to the ISO 14001 standard ensures a minimal impact of production on the environment. The selection of components for Ajax device manufacturing is determined by the presence of manufacturer declarations confirming compliance with RoHS requirements.

The company emerged against the backdrop of revolution and war. That's why resilience is the cornerstone of the brand's DNA, and the fight against evil by creating the best security and automation devices is Ajax's unwavering mission.

Ajax Systems is a Ukrainian success story, a place of incredible strength and energy.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute regional marketing strategies to drive B2B sales growth and strengthen partnerships within the assigned region.
  • Plan, manage, and execute targeted marketing campaigns aligned with the Regional Business Plan and overall company strategy, focusing on expanding and accelerating sales opportunities.
  • Lead all B2B marketing initiatives in close collaboration with the Business Development Team — including promotions, trade shows, seminars, webinars, certification programs, case studies, presentations, trade marketing, professional media publications, and partner motivation programs.
  • Exercise strategic decision-making on regional marketing activities to support sales objectives and ensure alignment with business goals.
  • Monitor, analyze, and report on marketing campaign performance and financial outcomes, recommending improvements to enhance efficiency and ROI.
  • Develop, localize, and maintain marketing materials and tools, while contributing to the creation of partner development resources by representing regional market needs and specificities.
  • Oversee the implementation of marketing policies within the distribution network, ensuring all partners receive and effectively utilize marketing assets and materials provided by Ajax HQ.
  • Act as a regional ambassador, sharing local market insights and partner feedback with the global marketing team to influence strategic direction.
  • Conduct in-depth analysis of partner performance and market dynamics to identify growth opportunities and strategies for increasing Ajax’s market share.
  • Collaborate closely with partner marketing, product, and sales teams to strengthen Ajax’s brand presence and drive sustainable sales growth.
  • Coordinate effectively across internal and external stakeholders, ensuring consistent communication and seamless execution of all marketing initiatives.

Requirements:

  • 5+ years of experience in B2B marketing, ideally in a fast-paced or growth-oriented environment
  • Fluent English (both written and spoken)
  • Background in the security industry is a strong advantage
  • Proven track record in planning and executing successful product, service, or market launches, with strong cross-functional collaboration and leadership skills
  • Deep understanding of multichannel marketing strategies and the full marketing mix
  • Demonstrated success in delivering commercially impactful marketing projects
  • Proactive, open-minded, and results-driven professional with an ambitious yet easy-going approach
  • Willingness to travel across ASEAN countries

We offer:

  • Opportunity to be part of a fast-paced and dynamic environment that encourages creativity, critical thinking, and the exploration of new ideas.
  • Opportunity to take on new challenges, advance your career, and make a meaningful impact.
  • Opportunity to work in one of the most recognized and innovative security manufacturers.

Compensation

Additional Information

title: Cobalt Core Pentester
description_html:
Who We Are

The Cobalt Core is a community of highly skilled security pentesters who are passionate about what they do and who are always striving to be at the top of their game. This curated community is made up by security professionals with many years of experience as well as talented pentesters who are eager to learn the trade and show their skills. They all have a strong drive to keep up to date on the latest vulnerabilities and exploits, and the tools and methodologies to find them.

A member of the Cobalt Core believes that sharing ideas and collaborating with peers is the best way to achieve good results.

If you believe you would be a good fit to join the Cobalt Core, and you are eager to contribute to the community and participate in the Pentests running on Cobalt please apply.

If you are currently residing in the USA, please apply here.

Who You Are

  • 4+ years of Pentesting or similar experience (mid-level).
  • Professional demeanor
  • Respectful towards others
  • Take pride in the work you produce
  • Strong work ethic with attention to detail
  • Desire to be an expert within your field
  • Deep understanding of application security
  • Ability to communicate effectively
  • Collaborative spirit

What You'll Do

  • Perform manual penetration testing of web applications, APIs, internal and external networks, iOS and Android mobile applications
  • Work as a member of a pentest team, collaborating and engaging directly with the client
  • Document in detail the results of assessments, audits, tests, and verification activities
  • Perform manual validation of vulnerabilities
  • Perform mobile and web app pentesting for OWASP top 10 vulnerabilities.
  • The following certifications are a plus:
    • CREST, PenTest+, GPEN, CEH, OSCP, AWS, CISSP, eCPPT, eWAPT, OSCE, OSWE
  • Please note that this is a freelance, part-time position.

Application Process: Applicants need only apply once and may not receive a response from our team. We review applications on a rolling basis and will reach out to a candidate should there be a mutual alignment. Repeated inquiries after applying and across social media is not favorable.

  1. Application - Becoming part of the Cobalt Core is a highly selective process, and only the best applicants will be invited to next steps in the on boarding process. Preference will be given to applicants who come referred by other Cobalt Core pentesters.
  2. Chat with a Cobalt representative - Get to know about Cobalt and how we work. We will also want to know about you, your experience, strengths and what drives you. If we all think it's a great fit, we will explore how we can work together!
  3. Technical Skills Assessment to demonstrate your technical acumen and reporting.
  4. Getting setup on the Cobalt platform + Background Check & ID Verification - In this step we will make sure you are all set up for success, and we will also ask you to pass a Background Check & ID Verification.
  5. Start working on cool projects!

Please note that this is not an entry level position.

About This Role

Dutchie is looking for a Senior Financial Analyst to help drive the financial operating rhythm of the company.

You’ll partner across Finance, Accounting, and business leaders to build forecasts, evaluate performance, improve planning processes, and deliver insights that influence executive decision-making. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys building scalable financial infrastructure, automating manual work, and using data to tell compelling business stories.

You’ll report to the Senior Director of FP&A while helping establish the next generation of planning capabilities across Dutchie.

What You’ll Do

Financial Planning & Forecasting

  • Own portions of the annual operating plan, quarterly forecasts, and long-range financial planning process.
  • Develop financial models that improve visibility into company performance and future investment decisions.
  • Analyze monthly results, identify business drivers, and communicate actionable insights to leadership.
  • Partner closely with Accounting to ensure accurate reporting and alignment between actuals, forecasts, and KPIs.

Operational Excellence

  • Improve and automate planning workflows using AI, modern financial tooling, and scalable processes.

  • Help evolve executive reporting and dashboards that improve decision-making across the organization.
  • Support board materials, leadership presentations, and strategic planning initiatives.

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Collaborate across R&D, G&A, and Operations to understand business performance and financial impact.
  • Become a trusted finance partner capable of simplifying complex business questions into clear financial recommendations.
  • Help establish consistent planning disciplines as Dutchie continues to scale.

What You’ll Bring

  • 3–5 years of experience in FP&A, investment banking, consulting, or corporate finance.
  • Advanced financial modeling and Excel skills with experience building dynamic forecasting models.
  • Experience working in high-growth SaaS or technology environments preferred.
  • Strong analytical curiosity and comfort working through ambiguity.
  • Experience leveraging AI tools to automate analysis, improve workflows, and increase productivity.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate complex analyses into executive-ready recommendations.

title: Partnerships Manager
description_html:
About Enode

The grid was built for predictable, centralised power. Today it's absorbing intermittent supply from grid scale solar and wind, alongside dynamic demand from EVs, heat pumps, and home batteries. The missing piece is software that can connect and orchestrate these devices at scale.

Enode provides the infrastructure layer that makes this possible. Our Connect API gives energy companies a single integration to 1000+ devices across 80+ brands. Our optimisation tooling gives energy companies the building blocks to manage those devices locally - think smart charging for EVs. Our Flex product turns those connected devices into a flexible, controllable asset for energy companies.

We work with device manufacturers across the energy hardware ecosystem - from EV brands to heat pump and solar inverter producers. Our customers are energy retailers, utilities, and traders building the next generation of energy services. We're backed by Y Combinator, Lowercarbon Capital, and Creandum.

The decisions made now will shape how the energy system gets built. We're looking for people who take ownership, move fast, and care deeply about the role technology can play in the energy transition.

AI is fundamental to how we work

AI is how a team our size keeps rewiring the way we work, fast enough to match what our mission demands. We look for people who reach for AI as a reflex and who can drop a habit that used to work. People who care about unblocking others, not just about what they ship themselves. If that's not quite how you work yet but it's the direction you're heading, we'd still like to hear from you. We assess this in our interview process, alongside everything else we look at.

What we’re looking for:

We're hiring a Partnerships Manager to work closely with the manufacturers (OEMs) whose devices are optimised by Enode. OEM partners are a vital part of Enode’s platform, and how we work with them determines how fast we scale as a company. Enode is partnering with leading automotive, EV charger and solar & storage companies, e.g. VW Group, Zaptec and Solis. You'll sign new partners, succeed with existing ones, improve our product, and shape the playbook we use to do it. This is a high-impact role for someone who thrives in early-stage ambiguity and problem solving.

You’ll be working directly with Henrik, Enode’s Head of Partnerships, and work closely with our CEO and leaders across GTM and Product. Partnerships is a small senior team of four people, and you will directly shape how we operate.

In this role, you will:

  • Source, negotiate, and close new OEM partnerships end-to-end, from first conversation to signed agreement

  • Grow and retain existing OEM partners, making sure they see real value from working with Enode

  • Identify and sell new products to OEMs, opening up new revenue streams

  • Develop and improve the partnerships playbook, including redesigning processes using AI

  • Build with AI as a normal part of how you work, from partner research through to scoping and recaps, and turn what you learn into tools, skills and processes the rest of the team picks up, so the leverage is shared rather than personal.

  • Represent Enode at industry events, conferences, and on panels

  • Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, Sales, Customer Success, and Operations to deliver on partner commitments and improve our platform

This role will be right for you, if:

To thrive at Enode, you believe the energy transition is the defining infrastructure problem of the next decade. And you want to be the person who unblocks it commercially and technically, not the person who reads about it. You’re motivated by the opportunity of using millions of residential energy devices to stabilise the grid.

To succeed as Partnership Manager you are a person who easily builds trust and relationships with a range of stakeholders, from technical product managers to senior business leaders in large, multi-national companies like VW and BMW Group. You should be excited about the opportunity to identify and understand their needs, help the partner and Enode to realise value and high quality integrations. The role will be right if:

  • You have drive, ambition and passion to build a globally important climate tech business

  • You are a natural relationship builder and can work with broad range of stakeholders

  • You use AI day to day, you understand where it helps and where it falls short, and you think about your work in terms of what AI can take on. If you're not fully there yet, you're eager to get there fast.

  • You are an excellent problem solver and strategic thinker, with the ability to manage complex projects

  • You have strong negotiation and diplomatic skills

  • You are comfortable navigating technical, commercial, and legal conversations with a range of stakeholders

  • You are well-organised and independent

  • You have at least 5 years of experience in business development/partnerships, ideally in B2B software or energy. We are also open to backgrounds from other high-performing environments (e.g. top-tier consulting)

  • You are ready to get your hands dirty, ideally with startup or scale-up experience

  • You have excellent communication skills, written and oral (English)

  • You are based in Europe and able to work in the CET time zone +-3 hours

Nice-to-haves

  • You have closed and grown multi-year strategic partnerships with enterprise counterparts

  • You have experience with (or high interest in) renewable energy, electric vehicles, smart energy hardware and/or demand response

  • You actively use AI to improve the efficiency and quality of your work

  • You are familiar with API-based, B2B software

What we offer:

  • Opportunity to join and impact an early-stage climate tech startup with global aspirations as we scale.

  • A mission-driven, fun and caring environment with high drive and ambition.

  • Competitive compensation, including a very attractive employee option program - you’re part of our journey.

  • Access to best in class AI tooling, we think the ceiling on what a small team can do has fundamentally shifted, and we want you to feel that.

  • Real investment in your AI fluency. Dedicated time to build the skill, an internal skills library you can contribute to, and the tooling budget to work properly.

  • Remote-first in Europe, with the option of attending an office in Oslo or receiving a co-working pass on demand.

  • Three annual off-sites to connect with the team in exciting & fun places.

  • Flexible, human-first culture.

  • Stipend for setting up your home office.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

A few things to note:

  • Enode is an equal opportunities employer. Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of colour are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may just be the right candidate for this or other roles.

  • Our values are integral to the way we work and are embedded into all our hiring processes. You can read more about our values here.

title: Junior Software Engineer – Early Career (Strong Problem solving & Coding Focus) – 100% Remote within Poland
description_html:
Welcome to the good side of tech

You might know us as ZnanyLekarz in Poland or Doctoralia in Spain. Globally, we are Docplanner.

We build technology that helps people live longer, healthier lives. Our products connect patients with doctors, power clinical workflows, and support healthcare systems used by millions of people every month.

Engineering at Docplanner is about building reliable, scalable systems with real human impact. What we ship affects patients, doctors, and clinics in everyday, high-stakes situations - which means quality, judgment, and long-term thinking matter.

In 2026, we are accelerating delivery across multiple product areas by changing how we build - leveraging AI-assisted development to increase engineering effectiveness and raise the bar on how we design, ship, and evolve systems.

And why should you join us?

Because it feels good to tell your family and your friends how you made the world a little bit better. You go to bed knowing that what you do matters, and that your talents align with your beliefs.

We want to help people live longer, healthier lives, and that starts with you being you. We believe that taking the diversity of human experience into account makes a better healthcare experience for all . We’re not just different: we embrace diversity. We will encourage you to come to work your whole self. You can decide to work fully remote, or work hybrid with our offices located in Barcelona or Warsaw. This will be dependent on the final team allocation.

Our challenges

Our Engineers may join teams working on these areas and challenges:

Marketplace & Search

Build the next-generation marketplace system by owning the end-to-end journey from agentic discovery to rebooking. You’ll leverage AI search and AI onboarding funnels to unlock new demand and transform one-off bookings into continuous care loops.

Practice Management Systems (PMS)

Build the next generation of software to help doctors globally. Unify the current fragmented reality and leverage AI to reinvent the way to help doctors focus on what matters most: treating the patient.

AI-powered Clinical Tools (Noa Medic)

Design AI-native clinical workflows that move beyond simple scribing to replace end-to-end administrative tasks. You'll build deep PMS/EHR embeddings that become an indispensable daily habit for medical professionals.

Patient & Data Integrations (Noa Patient)

Move beyond the booking button to build a proactive healthcare partner. You'll create the smart connections that blend someone's medical past with their live health data, crafting an AI experience that actually keeps patients coming back. Turn raw data into advice people can use, making Docplanner the one health app they can't live without.

Internally, these challenges map to some of our most ambitious and high-impact initiatives.

How we build software

  • We build systems that matter and we optimize for clarity, speed, and long-term maintainability.

  • Small autonomous teams that own real product surfaces end-to-end

  • High trust and high ownership from day one

  • Production impact early - even as a junior engineer

  • AI-assisted development as a default workflow

  • Strong engineering culture focused on simplicity, correctness, and measurable outcomes

  • We prefer solving problems well over adding unnecessary complexity.

  • Good ideas win regardless of tenure or hierarchy.

What we value

Strong problem solving ability. The ability to break down complex systems and find elegant solutions.

Builder mindset. You like creating things that people use.

Intellectual curiosity. You enjoy understanding how systems really work.

Ownership. You treat problems as yours until they are solved.

Pragmatism. You know when to optimize and when to ship.

We value signals over credentials.

Competition programming, open-source work, research, side projects or anything else that shows how you think.

Technical Environment

  • Our stack evolves continuously, but currently includes technologies such as:

  • Backend: Node.js, TypeScript

  • Frontend: React, TypeScript

  • Mobile: React Native

  • Infrastructure: AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform

  • Developer tooling: modern CI/CD, observability

  • AI-assisted coding environments built to scale (guardrails, rules, skills, subagents, spec-driven development)

We invest heavily in developer productivity and continuously improve how we design and ship systems.

Collaboration Model

• Open source internal culture - contribute across different services and teams

• Maintainer guidance rather than gatekeeping from senior developers

• Cross-functional ownership of features from conception to deployment

• Living documentation shared across all team members

Why Junior Devs Love It Here

  • Some reasons engineers choose to stay at Docplanner:

  • Real scale. Millions of users and thousands of healthcare providers across multiple countries.

  • Interesting problems. Distributed systems, search relevance, AI-assisted workflows, complex integrations.

  • Exceptional teammates. Work with talented people across disciplines who raise the bar for everyone.

  • Fast learning curve. You will work on real production systems very early.

  • Meaningful mission. Helping people live longer, healthier lives.

Qualifications

Required

  • Strong foundations in computer science

  • Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, complexity, and core software engineering principles.

  • Ability to build real software

  • Comfortable working across the stack to design, implement, and ship features that solve real user problems.

  • Strong problem-solving skills

  • You enjoy breaking down complex problems and finding simple, effective solutions.

  • Builder mindset

  • You like turning ideas into working products and taking ownership of outcomes, not just tasks.

  • Curiosity about users and problems

  • You’re comfortable talking to users, understanding their needs, and iterating on solutions.

  • High learning velocity

  • You pick up new technologies, tools, and domains quickly and continuously improve your craft.

  • AI-first engineering mindset

  • You actively experiment with AI coding tools, agents, and new workflows, and are excited about reinventing how software is built.

Preferred

  • Academic background in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or another rigorous technical discipline.

  • Competitive programming experience

  • Participation in ICPC, Google Code Jam, national olympiads, Codeforces, or similar competitions.

  • Evidence of building things

  • Side projects, startups, open-source contributions, hackathons, or shipped products.

  • Exposure to modern engineering workflows

  • Experience working with collaborative development, continuous delivery, strong observability, and AI-assisted development practices.

Let’s talk money

  • A salary adequate to your experience and skills.

True flexibility and work-life balance

  • Remote or hybrid work model with or hub in Warsaw;

  • Flexible working hours (fully flexible, as in most cases you only have to be on a couple of meetings weekly);

  • 20/26 days of paid time off (depending on your contract);

  • Additional paid day off on your birthday or work anniversary (you choose what you want to celebrate).

Health comes first

  • Private healthcare plan with Signal Iduna for you and subsidized for your family.

  • Multisport card co-financing for you to have access to sports facilities across Poland.

  • Access to iFeel, a technological platform for mental wellness offering online psychological support and counseling.

Keep growing with us

  • Free English and Spanish classes.

We promote and embrace equal opportunities in our hiring process, and also every day at work. When you apply for our roles you receive equal treatment regardless of age, disabilities, gender reassignment, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or parental status, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation or any other dimension of human difference. If you require additional support in your recruitment process, we kindly encourage you to let us know. Behind those words you’re reading, there’s a person (hi!) who already helped a candidate by adapting the interviews, and now we’re lucky to have this person with us. So, even if you’ve never asked for it before, may this serve as a sign that, now, you can do so. We can only truly be equal if we adapt to each other.

“We believe all humans, in all their beautiful diversity, should have equal rights, dignity and respect. Period.” Mariusz Gralewski, CEO

title: Senior Performance Marketing Manager
description_html:
About Us
Fieldguide is establishing a new state of trust for global commerce and capital markets through automating and streamlining the work of assurance and audit practitioners specifically within cybersecurity, privacy, and financial audit. Put simply, we build software for the people who enable trust between businesses.

We’re based in San Francisco, CA, but built as a remote-first company that enables you to do your best work from anywhere. We're backed by top investors including Growth Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives, Bessemer Venture Partners, 8VC, Floodgate, Y Combinator, DNX Ventures, Global Founders Capital, Justin Kan, Elad Gil, and more.

We value diversity — in backgrounds and in experiences. We need people from all backgrounds and walks of life to help build the future of audit and advisory. Fieldguide’s team is inclusive, driven, humble and supportive. We are deliberate and self-reflective about the kind of team and culture that we are building, seeking teammates that are not only strong in their own aptitudes but care deeply about supporting each other's growth.

As an early stage start-up employee, you’ll have the opportunity to build out the future of business trust. We make audit practitioners’ lives easier by bringing together up to 50% of their work and giving them better work-life balance. If you share our values and enthusiasm for building a great culture and product, you will find a home at Fieldguide.

About the Role

We are looking for a performance marketer who is still in the accounts.

You will own paid as a growth engine at Fieldguide: paid search, paid social, third-party media, landing page conversion, and the website as a demand tool. You will own the budget, the tests, the measurement, and the number. Our ambition is for paid to deliver 30 to 50% of high-quality MQLs and 30% of total pipeline. Today it delivers a fraction of that, which means the upside here is unusually clear.

This is a hands-to-keyboard seat at a senior level. You will build and optimize, not brief an agency and report back. You will work alongside a peer who owns campaign demand (webinars, nurture, email), so you can go deep on performance rather than spreading thin.

Two things we will be honest about. Our attribution is mid-rebuild, so part of this job is closing the measurement gap rather than inheriting a clean dashboard. And conversion optimization is coming back in-house, which means the testing program is yours to build rather than inherit. If either of those reads as a problem rather than an opportunity, this is not the seat.

You are also someone who uses AI daily. Not as a novelty, but because you have built workflows that let one person do what a team used to.

What You'll Do

Own paid search. Google Ads and Microsoft Ads end to end: keyword and query strategy, bid management, ad copy, negatives hygiene, and landing page pairing. Drive CPA down and pipeline efficiency up, and be able to name the changes that did it.

Own paid social. LinkedIn Ads end to end: audiences, creative testing, bidding, conversion tracking, and lead handoff. Build into emerging paid surfaces where the ICP actually is.

Own third-party media and paid distribution. Programmatic display, native, OLV, DOOH, and content syndication, including the agency and trading desk relationships behind them.

Own the conversion surface. Landing page performance, CRO test roadmap, the demo request path, form and gating strategy, and the website as a demand gen tool. Run the testing program in-house.

Own the budget. Allocation across channels, in-quarter reallocation on a two-week read, monthly forecast versus actual, and agency spend management. Bring a kill-or-scale recommendation per channel and per vendor every quarter.

Close the measurement gap. Build full-funnel paid measurement: attribution model, event-based tracking, and a clean line from spend to pipeline to revenue, in partnership with our RevOps and Marketing Ops teams.

Use AI to multiply output. Ask whether AI can do the first 80% of every task. Build agentic monitoring that catches a spend or performance anomaly before a human notices. Share the workflows so the leverage compounds.

Who You Are

  • You have 5+ years in B2B performance or growth marketing, with clear ownership of a paid budget and a pipeline number.

  • You have experience at the scale we are operating at: monthly paid spend and pipeline contribution in the range we are scaling into, not a few thousand dollars a month.

  • You have hands-on, hands-to-keyboard paid experience. You have personally built, structured, and optimized paid search and paid social campaigns recently. You can walk someone into your account and explain the last three changes you made and why.

  • You have full-funnel and revenue thinking. You can trace a paid dollar to MQL, SQL, SQO, and closed revenue, and you argue about efficiency rather than volume.

  • You have real experience with attribution models and event-based tracking, ideally in an environment where the data was not clean.

  • You have in-house CRO and landing page testing experience: cadence, backlog prioritization, and an honest win rate.

  • You have HubSpot fluency, plus the ad platforms: Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, and LinkedIn Campaign Manager.

  • You have vendor and agency management with teeth. You can hold an agency to a hypothesis and a metric, and end an engagement that isn't earning it.

  • You have a specific, demonstrable AI practice in paid execution. You can show us the workflow, the inputs, and what it replaced.

  • You hold yourself to a high bar. You are the first quality check on your own work, and you measure it against the best in the category, not against your last campaign.

  • You have B2B experience with a considered, multi-stakeholder sale. Professional services, accounting, audit, or fintech is a plus. B2C or PLG-only is not a fit.

What Great Looks Like Here

We measure ourselves by outcomes, not effort. Opinions start the conversation; data ends it. Every program has a hypothesis, a metric, and an honest read, and we kill or scale on evidence.

If that sounds like the way you already work, we should talk.

More about Fieldguide:

  • Fieldguide is a values-based company. Our values are:

  • Fearless - Inspire & break down seemingly impossible walls.

  • Fast - Launch fast with excellence, iterate to perfection.

  • Lovable - ​​Deliver happiness & 11 star experiences.

  • Owners - Execute & run the business with ownership.

  • Win-win - Create mutual value & earn trust for life.

  • Inclusive - Scale the best ideas with inclusive teams.

Some of our benefits include:

  • Competitive compensation packages with meaningful ownership

  • Unlimited PTO

  • 401k

  • Wellness benefits starting your first day

  • Technology & Work from Home reimbursement

  • Flexible work schedules

title: Demand Generation Manager - 4 Day Week + Remote
description_html:
We have a full marketing production team. Content, design, web, video, product marketing. We have a sales team sitting ready to take meetings. What we don't have is anyone whose entire job is filling the funnel.

So the pipeline gets built the hard way, one cold call at a time, while the inbound machine that should be feeding it doesn't exist yet.

We want one person to build it, own it, and be measured on what comes out of the end: qualified demos landing in the sales team's calendar.

This isn't a run-some-ads role. You'll own the whole journey, from people who've never heard of us, through people who know the name, all the way to a booked meeting. Paid, events, webinars, trade media, conversion, the handoff to sales, the budget and every number in between.

If you've built a demand gen engine before and want to do it again somewhere it will actually make the difference, keep reading.

Read on!

(this will be a long write up but we like to give you all the details before you spend your time applying)

_________________________________________________________________________________________

We are Shape.Construction!

We are digitising the largest and most fundamental industry in the world, the industry that literally builds the foundations of the civilisation we all depend on to spare us from a brutal hunter-gatherer life: CONSTRUCTION

It is one of the least digitised industries in the world but also the largest – 1 in 9 people globally work in the construction industry and it constitutes 11% of global GDP.

Improving construction strengthens the very foundation of human civilisation. (Watch our short film about it).

We got our start as a high-end construction project management consultancy. As a consultancy, we are focused on genuinely upgrading the way construction projects are delivered. We then take the deep understanding of the projects we work on to develop construction management software products that anyone can use to deliver their projects better.

We are building a full suite of products one module at a time – kind of like office 365 but for construction management - Check out Shape, our construction management tech

The core of all this is our true secret sauce; people. We only recruit the very best both in capability and personality. We are deeply focused on designing a new type of organisation that is optimised for the flourishing of the people in the team first and foremost. People that join us develop fast as a whole person in ways they never imagined.

This approach has allowed us to grow from just 2 people in 2017 to over 220 today (including consultancy) and we are still very much at the beginning! Joining us isn't just some "job", it is a transformative educational experience. We challenge you to be your best self in all aspects of life.

4 core values for a good life

We believe a life of human flourishing is all about meaningful relationships with others and challenging yourself to create a positive impact. So our values reflect the 4 levels of relationships that each of us has:

  • Grow yourself – Your relationship with yourself
  • Care about people – Your relationship with others around you
  • Execute to greatness – Your relationship with your team
  • Build civilisation – Your relationship with humanity and the world

This goes much deeper but for the sake of brevity, we will keep the summary version!

We enshrined our values in our vision

We exist so that everyone in our team can thrive in a high-impact community that:

  • Connects us with meaningful relationships
  • Inspires us to develop ourselves to become better humans
  • Empowers us to pursue our own learning adventures

We believe that, by first doing this, we can achieve the highest levels of value for the world.

And enable the achievement of our vision through our dual missions:

  1. To fully digitise the construction of human civilisation
  2. To create a new type of organisation that enables human flourishing while delivering a huge positive impact on society

_________________________________________________________________________________________

The Role

Purpose of the role

Shape has a full marketing production team (content, design, web, video, product marketing) and a sales team ready to take meetings. What we don't have is someone whose entire job is filling the funnel. You'll own one number, qualified demos booked for the sales team, and everything that feeds it.

This isn't a run-some-ads role. You'll build and own the complete journey from cold audiences who've never heard of us, through "Shape Aware" (people who've engaged with the brand: visited the website, engaged with content or ads), all the way to a booked demo. You own the funnel, the numbers at every stage of it, and how those leads land with the sales team.

Team

You'll sit in Shape's marketing team and your leader will be the Head of Marketing. You'll work daily with the SDR and sales teams, who receive everything you generate.

The team already has content, design, web, video and product marketing covered, so you won't be writing the copy or building the pages yourself. You'll brief and direct that output toward campaigns. You'll also work alongside our GTM Engineer, who owns the data and signals layer you'll use to target the right accounts at the right time.

What's missing is someone pointing all of that at a number. That's you.

Your top six objectives

  1. Own inbound lead generation end to end, with qualified demos booked for the sales team as your core KPI.
  2. Build a full funnel we can see into at every stage, from cold audiences through Shape Aware to booked demo.
  3. Run paid as your fastest route to volume: advertising is your primary engine.
  4. Build events, webinars, trade media and syndication into a second engine, so we're not dependent on ad spend alone.
  5. Own conversion and the handoff, so no lead ever goes stale in a form somewhere.
  6. Own the budget: recommend what spend is needed to hit the number, then justify, track and report on it.

Your top six responsibilities

Your remit splits into two activity streams, Paid and Events, and you decide the right mix between them based on what's actually producing demos. Beyond those two, you own the full channel mix. If you see an opportunity in SEO, partnerships, referral, PR or review sites that gets us to the number faster, that's yours to pursue too.

  1. Advertising. LinkedIn, Google, Meta, Reddit, Insta and any other channel worth running, both cold acquisition and retargeting to warm Shape Aware audiences.
  2. Paid media and syndication. Trade publications and industry media placements that put us in front of the right audience.
  3. Events coordination. Choosing and running the industry events and conferences worth being at, from planning through to the follow-up that turns attendees into demos.
  4. Webinars, in two formats. One-to-many webinars on product demos and industry topics for top and mid-funnel, building the Shape Aware audience and warming people up. And one-to-few "lunch and learn" style sessions for a small group of target accounts at the bottom of the funnel, run in support of sales to help move specific deals forward.
  5. Funnel, conversion and handoff. Build and report on funnel-stage metrics, not just the demo number: how many people are Shape Aware, how they move between stages, where they drop off and what it costs to move them. Own conversion, so landing pages, forms and follow-up journeys, testing and iterating relentlessly. Own the handoff, so when a demo is booked you define how the sales team is notified, what context they get and how fast it happens.
  6. Budget, briefing and lead quality. Recommend what spend is needed across channels to hit the number and justify it, then track and manage it, reporting on cost per demo, cost per stage and pipeline generated. Direct our content and design teams' output toward campaigns with briefs for ad copy, landing pages, lead magnets and nurture assets. Work with the SDR team on lead quality, so demos are ones sales actually wants. Use our data and signals layer, built by our GTM Engineer, to target the right accounts at the right time.

Your Capabilities

You are a demand gen operator who has done this before and can do it again from a standing start. You think in funnels and unit economics rather than campaigns and impressions, and you'd rather bring a playbook you've already proven than experiment your way into one on our budget.

Must-Have (The fundamentals)

  • Mastery: A track record building full-funnel B2B demand generation, not just managing ad spend. You will show how you took cold audiences through to booked meetings and the numbers at each stage. Hands-on paid media experience (LinkedIn Ads and Google Ads as a minimum) and a strong grasp of conversion optimisation across landing pages, forms and follow-up journeys. Ideally some experience with events, webinars or trade media as lead sources. HubSpot experience a strong plus.
  • Communication: Proficient communicator in written and verbal English. Able to brief and direct creative teams without doing the design or copy yourself, and to report honestly upward on what's working and what isn't.
  • Leadership: Strong critical thinking. You work out why something isn't converting and fix the right problem, rather than turning dials and hoping. You're comfortable owning a number and being measured on it, and you lead yourself proactively.
  • Impact: AI-native in how you work. You use AI (we run on Claude, including Claude Cowork) to handle the admin, reporting and grunt work so your time goes on strategy and optimisation. If you're still doing manually what an AI can do, this isn't the role for you.

Nice to Have (If you don't have it now you will after joining)

  • Mastery: Marketing automation and nurture design in HubSpot, account-based marketing into named accounts, SEO and organic as a lead source, and construction or built-environment industry knowledge (a bonus, not a requirement).
  • Communication: The confidence to influence a sales team on lead quality and definitions, rather than just handing leads over and hoping.
  • Leadership: Experience being the first demand gen hire somewhere, building the function from nothing rather than inheriting one.
  • Impact: A repeatable playbook you've run more than once, at more than one company, with the numbers to show it worked both times.

Shape isn't the place for you if any of the following is true:

  • You want an easy role without much challenge
  • You like to be the smartest person in the room
  • You don't like continuously receiving honest candid feedback
  • You prefer to do your own thing rather than work with a team
  • You'd rather report on activity than be measured on an outcome

_________________________________________________________________________________________

Frequently Asked Questions

Can you tell me more about what the role is like?

We are in scale up mode so it will be a full-on role with more things to do than time available.

This is why it will be important to prioritise ruthlessly. We don't like to mess about so you will need to be a very high performer who only wants to work with others of your ilk.

This role is unusually clear about what success means, because it comes down to one number. That's a good thing if you like owning an outcome and having the autonomy to decide how you hit it. We are growing rapidly so that means your role will grow rapidly too. You will need to keep up and constantly be looking 1-2 years ahead.

What does success look like?

Within 3 months: a measurable funnel we can see into at every stage. How many people are Shape Aware, what it costs to create them, how they convert, and a predictable flow of demos landing with sales, with the team notified instantly and properly every time one books.

As for a tangible target, you are generating 30 qualified demos a month via inbound activity, with the months leading up showing a clearly defined path to that number and significant, visible improvement week on week.

Realistically we expect paid to be the fastest route there, but how you hit the number is your call. Beyond that, we want events and webinars contributing properly so the number keeps growing and we aren't dependent on ad spend alone.

What have you already got in place?

A full production team for content, design, web and video, so you have people to build what you brief. HubSpot as our CRM and marketing platform. A GTM Engineer building out our data and signals layer, so you'll have account and intent data to target with rather than guessing. What we haven't had is anyone owning the funnel itself, which is why the channels are underused and the reporting doesn't yet exist.

Where would I be working?

All our roles are 100% remote and home-based. However, if you would like to work in a co-work space to get out of the house we may be able to arrange that. If you are in one of our locations with offices, you can come as often as you like.

_________________________________________________________________________________________

Benefits

The Standard Stuff

  • Health Insurance Scheme. Comprehensive private health coverage - for you and your family. Because your well-being is our priority
  • Bonus Scheme. As a permanent member of the team, you’ll share in our success. Our annual bonus is designed to reward both the now and the future - with a flexible mix of cash and high-growth equity that you choose. Bonuses are discretionary and based on performance
  • Professional body membership. One fee covered per year - so you can stay connected to your field and develop your craft

The Life-Changing Stuff

  • In-house coaching: Regular 1:1 coaching sessions, fully confidential, to help you navigate challenges, build self-awareness, and grow intentionally - professionally and as a human being
  • Flexibility: Getting things done is what really matters, not what time of day you do it. That means you don’t have to ask permission for things like picking up your kids or going to the doctor, just keep your team in the loop if you think they will be affected.
  • Grow your whole self: Our leaders are more like coaches and one of our main objectives is to give 5 years’ worth of learning and development for every 1 year with us. You have a coach, mentor, well-being therapist and a development-orientated environment: That’s literally what our vision is all about and the primary reason Laminar exists.
  • Be surrounded by the best: We only hire and retain the very best people. You might be used to being the smartest in the room but that won’t be the case in Laminar. You will be surrounded by people you can learn from. We are 100% meritocratic so fast progression is the norm. You will be supported to excel in whichever areas you are most interested in! With Laminar, development is unbounded
  • Long-term impact: We are focused on solving the biggest issues in construction project delivery in a way that can spread and outlast us

_________________________________________________________________________________________

Important! Applying properly

We get thousands of applications so please write us a letter as part of your application explaining:

  • Why do you want to join us?
  • What do you think you bring to the team?
  • Tell us about a demand gen playbook you've run that worked, and the numbers it produced

We aren't a giant faceless corporation; we really care about the people who want to join our team so all letters will be read thoroughly.

After that, we will reach out to you to schedule a casual conversation to help you to know us a bit better and tell us a bit about yourself.

After that, we will schedule a couple of technical and personal assessments to understand what your level of capability is based on our own development matrix. This is to ensure that when you join you are starting at the right level of responsibility based on your capability not just based on experience.

Compensation

Additional Information

title: Senior Software Engineer (Home Energy)
description_html:
About Enode

The grid was built for predictable, centralised power. Today it's absorbing intermittent supply from grid scale solar and wind, alongside dynamic demand from EVs, heat pumps, and home batteries. The missing piece is software that can connect and orchestrate these devices at scale.

Enode provides the infrastructure layer that makes this possible. Our Connect API gives energy companies a single integration to 1000+ devices across 80+ brands. Our optimisation tooling gives energy companies the building blocks to manage those devices locally - think smart charging for EVs. Our Flex product turns those connected devices into a flexible, controllable asset for energy companies.

We work with device manufacturers across the energy hardware ecosystem - from EV brands to heat pump and solar inverter producers. Our customers are energy retailers, utilities, and traders building the next generation of energy services. We're backed by Y Combinator, Lowercarbon Capital, and Creandum.

The decisions made now will shape how the energy system gets built. We're looking for people who take ownership, move fast, and care deeply about the role technology can play in the energy transition.

AI is fundamental to how we work

AI is how a team our size keeps rewiring the way we work, fast enough to match what our mission demands. We look for people who reach for AI as a reflex and who can drop a habit that used to work. People who care about unblocking others, not just about what they ship themselves. If that's not quite how you work yet but it's the direction you're heading, we'd still like to hear from you. We assess this in our interview process, alongside everything else we look at.

What we're looking for:

We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer to help build the software layer that makes home energy devices work as one system. The Home Energy team owns Enode's integrations and APIs for batteries, solar inverters, HVAC, and smart meters, along with the home energy management (HEM) system and statistics that customers build on. You'll build integrations with leading OEMs and help mature our API surface into the unified control layer for the home, at a moment when customer demand for battery and home energy optimization is accelerating.

You'll join the Home Energy team, reporting to the team's Engineering Manager. You'll collaborate closely with your PM, fellow backend engineers, and our partnership and commercial teams, from assessing OEM API feasibility to shaping how customers control energy assets through our platform.

In this role, you will:

  • Build and maintain integrations with OEM cloud platforms across batteries, solar, smart meters, and HVAC.

  • Design and evolve our home energy APIs, unifying telemetry and controls across HEM system, batteries, and curtailment into a product surface customers can build optimizations on.

  • Build with AI as a normal part of how you work, and turn what you learn into tools, skills and processes the rest of the team picks up, so the leverage is shared rather than personal.

  • Improve observability and vendor performance across our integrations, and take part in the team's triage rotation.

  • Work with partnership and commercial teams on API feasibility for new OEM integrations.

  • Build strong relationships with the customers who rely on our platform, working alongside your PM and commercial partners, and let what you learn from them shape what we build.

  • Debug and ship production features in Node/TypeScript on our AWS-based stack.

  • Take a product-engineer mindset, balancing speed, quality, and customer impact in your day-to-day decisions.

Curious what you'd actually be building? Explore our API docs and the Enode Tech Blog to see what we ship and how we think about it.

This role will be right for you, if:

You're an ambitious backend engineer who likes to own things end to end: from an ambiguous problem, through design and integration work, to something shipped and running in production. You find integration challenges satisfying rather than frustrating, including working with third-party APIs of varying maturity, and you're energized by tough technical problems.

You're comfortable navigating ambiguity and bringing clarity and structure that help a team move forward. You collaborate naturally with engineers, PMs, and commercial partners, and you like being close enough to the product to influence where it goes.

Above all, you care about building software with real-world impact that supports the shift toward a cleaner, more flexible energy system. You bring:

  • Experience building and maintaining backend services in production, ideally in API or integration-heavy systems.

  • AI is a real part of how our engineers work, and we expect a senior engineer to be fluent with it. You use AI day to day, you understand where it helps and where it falls short, and you think about your work in terms of what AI can take on. If you're not fully there yet, you're eager to get there fast.

  • Strong skills in designing for reliability, scalability, and performance.

  • Ability to own work from initial scoping to production rollout, including iterating based on customer or usage insights.

  • Comfort in fast-moving, sometimes ambiguous environments where teams create clarity together.

  • Clear, thoughtful communication across engineering, product, and customer-facing teams.

  • A product mindset: you care about solving the right problem and making life easier for customers and teammates.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with TypeScript/Node, AWS services, PostgreSQL, TimescaleDB, or similar production tooling.

  • Familiarity with home energy assets (batteries, solar/inverters, HVAC, smart meters), energy markets, or IoT/device ecosystems.

  • Prior exposure to API-first products or integration platforms.

  • On-call or incident response experience.

What we offer:

  • Opportunity to join and impact an early-stage climate tech startup with global aspirations as we scale.

  • A mission-driven, fun and caring environment with high drive and ambition.

  • Competitive compensation, including a very attractive employee option program - you’re part of our journey.

  • Access to best in class AI tooling, we think the ceiling on what a small team can do has fundamentally shifted, and we want you to feel that.

  • Real investment in your AI fluency. Dedicated time to build the skill, an internal skills library you can contribute to, and the tooling budget to work properly.

  • Remote-first in Europe, with the option of attending an office in Oslo or receiving a co-working pass on demand.

  • Three annual off-sites to connect with the team in exciting & fun places.

  • Flexible, human-first culture.

  • Stipend for setting up your home office.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

A few things to note:

  • Enode is an equal opportunities employer. Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of colour are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may just be the right candidate for this or other roles.

  • Our values are integral to the way we work and are embedded into all our hiring processes. You can read more about our values here.

title: Vigilant IT Security Manager - Portugal/Poland
description_html:
This is not an offshoring back-office job for an international company. You will be a key player in our globally distributed team.

We’re searching for a Vigilant IT Security Manager to help us get our IT security systems up to spec, secure our networks and keep the vital organs of our team working! If you like solving complex business problems, and are experienced in all things IT security, we need you!

Read on!

(this will be a long write up but we like to give you all the details before you spend your time applying)

___________________________________________________________

We are Laminar Projects!

We are an award winning consultancy that implements technology to improve the delivery of complex construction projects. Improving construction strengthens the very foundation of human civilisation. (Watch our short film about it)

We also have a separate product team, Shape Construction, that takes the deep understanding of the projects we work on to develop construction management software products.

The core of all this is our true secret sauce; people. We only recruit kind and authentic people who are fast learners. We are deeply focused on designing a new type of place that is optimised for the flourishing of the people in the team first and foremost. This approach has allowed us to grow from just 2 people in 2017 to over 170 today and we are still very much at the beginning! Joining us isn’t just some “job,” we challenge you to be your best self in all aspects of life.

Our vision is designed to align how we operate with the fundamental aspects that enable anyone to have a fulfilled life: 

  • Connects us with meaningful relationships
  • Inspires us to develop ourselves to become better humans
  • Empowers us to pursue our own learning adventures

4 core values for a good life

We believe a life of human flourishing is all about meaningful relationships with others and challenging yourself to create a positive impact. Our four core values are grow yourself, care about people, execute to greatness and build civilisation. This philosophy goes much deeper and you can see more on our website.

We are achieving this vision through the following two missions:  

  1. To fully digitise the construction of human civilisation
  2. To create a new type of organisation that enables human flourishing while delivering a huge positive impact on society

___________________________________________________________

The Role

Purpose of the role

As the IT Security Manager at Laminar, you will play a pivotal role in managing our IT security systems, identifying and closing any cybersecurity risk we hold, whilst also ensuring the smooth operation and development of the IT function. Your primary focus will be on maturing our security systems, ensuring adherence to industry standards, regulatory requirements, and best practices, particularly in alignment with relevant accreditations such as ISO 27001 and SOC2. Additionally, you will be responsible for all Laminar’s IT related policy and business rules, the managing of software, hardware and infrastructure management, and establishing SLAs for user support.

Team

Our IT team is the first port of call when things go wrong, and the first to spot trouble before it does. From fixing the everyday snags to keeping systems, networks, and data running securely behind the scenes, they keep the business moving so everyone else can get on with their work. Your leadership and coordination will ensure that the IT team continues to deliver high quality support for all departments within Laminar.

Your top three objectives

  1. Identify and mitigate IT security risks and close gaps in our systems.
  2. Ensure compliance with ISO 27001 and SOC2 standards and regulations.
  3. Develop and maintain a high-performing IT department.

Your top five responsibilities

  1. Lead strategic IT projects: Drive critical initiatives to ensure we proactively identify and close any security system risks whilst remaining compliant with ISO 27001 standards, regulations, and audit compliance.
  2. General IT Management: Including responsibility for and oversight of software, hardware and infrastructure management.
  3. Develop and enforce policies: Create and implement robust IT policies, procedures, and controls.
  4. Collaborate across teams: Align IT efforts with our goals through close collaboration with diverse teams and stakeholders, ensuring effective support and product ownership for core applications.
  5. Functional Leadership and promoting culture: Offer leadership on IT security, risk management, and compliance, fostering a culture of excellence and accountability, while also optimizing tools for support and ensuring efficient tech support across Laminar.

Your Capabilities

You will be a proven IT operations leader who knows how to switch between being a project manager, leader, communicator, researcher and doer, to make things better.

As a candidate, who should have:

Must-Have

  • Mastery: Strong understanding of IT security systems, where vulnerabilities are and how to close those gaps. You should have experience across both Microsoft and Google environments. You should also understand ISO 27001 standards, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices, along with proficiency in risk management, compliance management, and audit processes.
  • Communication: Precise and structured communicator, both written and verbal, in English.
  • Leadership: Ability to effectively manage teams and projects simultaneously, prioritize tasks effectively, and collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
  • Impact: A track record of making workplaces better beyond just doing the basics.

Nice to Have

  • Mastery: Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, or CISA and knowledge of IT governance frameworks such as COBIT or ITIL is desirable.
  • Communication: Precise and structured communicator both written and verbal
  • Leadership: A proven leader, coach or developer of teams.
  • Impact: A track record of implementing scalable and repeatable solutions in projects and teams that had a significant positive impact on support desk operations, software/tech support, and IT infrastructure management.

Laminar isn’t the place for you if any of the following is true:

  • You want an easy, chilled-out role without much challenge
  • You like to be the smartest person in the room
  • You don’t like continuously receiving honest candid feedback
  • You prefer to do your own thing rather than work with a team

The Standard Stuff

  • Health Insurance Scheme. Comprehensive private health coverage - for you and your family. Because your well-being is our priority
  • Pension Scheme. A competitive plan to help you plan for the long term - plus salary sacrifice options available to maximize your savings
  • Bonus Scheme. As a permanent member of the team, you’ll share in our success. Our annual bonus is designed to reward both the now and the future - with a flexible mix of cash and high-growth equity that you choose. Bonuses are discretionary and based on performance
  • Professional body membership. One fee covered per year - so you can stay connected to your field and develop your craft

You will be surrounded by people you can learn from. We are 100% meritocratic so fast progression is the norm. You will be supported to excel in whichever areas you are most interested in! With Laminar, development is unbounded
  • Long-term impact: We are focused on solving the biggest issues in construction project delivery in a way that can spread and outlast us

title: Account Executive, Commercial (Nagoya)
description_html:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange™️ platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 160+ public exchanges globally and thousands of private exchanges at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

役割

セールスと市場開拓（Go-to-Market）部門の一員としてご活躍いただける、アカウント エグゼクティブを募集しています。この職務は日本を拠点とし、リージョナルディレクター直属となります。

世界中のプロフェッショナルと連携しながら、お客様の期待を超える価値提供を実現し、安全でクラウドを前提としたデジタルの未来を推進していくポジションです。
また、Customer Success／Enablement／Architecture各チームと密に協働し、Zscalerが実現するクラウド・トランスフォーメーションの力を提案・体現することで、クラウドセキュリティ分野のグローバルリーダーとしての当社のポジションをさらに強固なものにしていただきます。

業務内容 (役割と期待されること)

・顧客の経営幹部を含む主要な関係者との信頼関係を構築すること。

・顧客の目標に基づく長期的なアカウント戦略を設計すること。

・社内関係者との連携による顧客ニーズを反映したアカウント計画を策定すること。

・ 顧客のビジネスを理解し、具体的な目標を掲げ、Zscalerソリューションを提案し、信頼できるパートナーとしての役割を発揮すること。

求める人物像 (成功のための資質)

不確実さを力に変えられる人：正解が見えない状況でも前に進むことが出来る方。歩きながら道をつくることに前向きで、曖昧さを「障害」ではなく、価値あるものを生み出すための素材として捉えられる方。

オーナーシップを持って動ける人：ミッションへの熱意が行動力につながり、自ら意思決定し、最後までやり切ることが出来る方。成果に本気で向き合うからこそ誠実にふるまい、戦略の議論から現場の実行まで、必要に応じて自在に行き来できる方。

課題解決を楽しめる人：難しい課題ほど熱意をもって取り組める方。課題に集中し、解決までやり抜くことで最大のインパクトを生み出せると知っている方。

信頼をつくるコラボレーター：自分の成功だけでなく、チームの成功にコミットできる方。明確さと敬意のある率直さを大切にし、フィードバックを「与える・受け取る」を継続できる方。これこそが最高のチームワークであり、信頼を最速で築く方法だと理解している方。

学び続ける人：学び続ける姿勢を持っている方。真の成長志向を持ち、自己啓発に情熱を注ぎ、より良いパートナー、より強力なチームメイトになるために積極的にフィードバックを求める方。仕事を心から楽しみ、目的意識を持って取り組める方。

応募資格(必須条件)

・ソフトウェアまたはセキュリティ業界における5年以上のフルサイクルセールス経験

・学士号またはそれに相当する実務経験

・法人顧客との関与および経営幹部への販売を含む戦略的営業の経験

・ビジネスレベルの日本語力(読み書き、会話)

・AI／機械学習（ML）技術の基礎的な理解を有し、自身の担当領域における成果を最大化するために、AIを活用したソリューションの活用・提案・セキュリティ確保のいずれかに携わった経験を有すること

他の候補者との差別化要素(歓迎条件)

・既存顧客や見込み客との確立されたネットワークを活かし、持続的な成果を生み出すスキル

・顧客の目的や課題を深く理解し、テクノロジーによるデジタルトランスフォーメーションの促進についての深い理解

・戦略的な営業計画に関する知識と新規顧客を獲得した実績

#LI-TY2 #LI-Hybrid

title: Senior Product Designer
description_html:
About Us

Fieldguide is establishing a new state of trust for global commerce and capital markets by automating and streamlining the work of assurance and audit practitioners, specifically in cybersecurity, privacy, and financial audits. Put simply, we build software for the people who enable trust between businesses.

We’re based in San Francisco, CA, but built as a remote-first company that enables you to do your best work from anywhere. We’re backed by top investors, including Growth Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives, Bessemer Venture Partners, 8VC, Floodgate, Y Combinator, DNX Ventures, Global Founders Capital, Justin Kan, Elad Gil, and more.

We value diversity—in backgrounds and experiences. We need people from all backgrounds and walks of life to help build the future of audit and advisory. Fieldguide’s team is inclusive, driven, humble, and supportive. We are deliberate and self-reflective about the kind of team and culture we are building, seeking teammates who are not only strong in their own aptitudes, but who also care deeply about supporting each other’s growth.

As an early-stage startup employee, you’ll have the opportunity to help build the future of business trust. We make audit practitioners’ lives easier by consolidating up to 50% of their work and improving work-life balance. If you share our values and enthusiasm for building a great culture and product, you’ll find a home at Fieldguide.

About the Role

We’re hiring a Senior Product Designer to join our Audit product team. Reporting to the Director, Product Design, you’ll own complex, ambiguous problem spaces end-to-end, partner deeply with Product and Engineering and help shape the design direction of a core Fieldguide product.

We move incredibly fast at Fieldguide and are looking for designers who can operate at that cadence. This team ships frequently, iterates in tight loops and makes progress amid ambiguity. The hire should be comfortable balancing speed with craft, incorporating AI into their daily design practice, and designing AI-assisted workflows directly into the product. This is a high-impact role for someone excited to own unclear problems, drive momentum and help modernize audit workflows that customers depend on every day.

What You’ll Do:

  • Lead end-to-end design for complex, ambiguous audit workflows, from problem definition through shipped solutions

  • Partner closely with Product and Engineering to shape strategy, influence roadmaps, and deliver high-quality, scalable implementations

  • Drive design execution with minimal direction, operating effectively in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment

  • Translate customer needs, research insights, and business goals into clear user journeys, interaction models, and polished UI

  • Balance speed and iteration with usability, consistency, and long-term product quality

  • Advocate for users while accounting for technical, regulatory, and business constraints

  • Own a significant product area or customer journey, anticipating downstream impacts across workflows and personas

  • Set a high bar for craft and influence by contributing to the design system, mentoring peers, and serving as a trusted design voice.

Who You Are:

  • 6+ year of experience in a Product Design role, ideally focused on complex, B2B SaaS products

  • Previously thrived in fast-moving environments and can operate effectively at high velocity without sacrificing judgment or craft

  • Have owned complex, ambiguous problem spaces end-to-end with minimal direction

  • An ability to think in systems and anticipate downstream impacts across workflows, personas, and adjacent product areas

  • Experience working alongside or designing AI-assisted workflows (e.g., review, summarization, guidance)

  • Have incorporated AI into your daily design practice — from research and synthesis to prototyping and iteration

  • Excited to design AI-assisted workflows that meaningfully support auditors in their work

  • Proven ability for usability, polish, and consistency in shipped work

  • You’ve proven to elevate previous teams through mentorship, feedback, and thoughtful critique
