title: Customer Director
salary_basis: Based on leadership compensation records at Faculty
description_html:
Why Faculty?


We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

About the team

Bringing medicine to patients is complex, expensive and high-risk. Faculty’s Life Science’s team is concentrated on building AI solutions which optimise the research and commercialisation of life-changing therapies.

We partner with major pharma firms, academic research centres and MedTech start-ups to design and deliver solutions which address critical healthcare challenges, and help to democratize health for all.

About the role

As a Customer Director, you’ll play an influential role in growing our most impactful accounts.

You will act as a strategic partner to our Life Sciences clients, helping them supercharge their operations and end-user engagement through AI-powered decision-making. Leading a high-performing team of delivery and engagement specialists, you’ll oversee complex commercial negotiations, ensure the successful delivery of cutting-edge Applied AI solutions, and build key relationships which position Faculty as the global leader in AI-driven transformation.

#LI-PRIO

What you'll be doing

  • Driving revenue growth; identifying strategic opportunities to expand current accounts and onboarding new clients within your sector

  • Developing and implementing robust strategic account plans that align Faculty’s AI solutions with client business objectives

  • Leading commercial negotiations and partnering with the Business Unit Director on accurate sales planning and forecasting

  • Building trusted relationships with senior budget holders and C-suite stakeholders to ensure high levels of client satisfaction and retention

  • Managing and mentoring cross-functional commercial teams

  • Representing Faculty at industry events and networking forums to build a reputation as a thought leader in AI-driven transformation

  • Collaborating with technical teams to translate complex data concepts into innovative use cases that solve real-world client problems


Who we're looking for

  • You’ve managed senior, complex stakeholder relationships in the Life Sciences industry - some experience in consulting preferred

  • You have experience leading large-scale AI/digital transformation projects

  • You possess a strong business development mindset with experience in sales methodologies and the end-to-end management of deal processes

  • You are a practical problem solver with the forensic skills to scope a problem, identify client needs and implement effective solutions

  • You are a compelling communicator - comfortable collaborating with technical experts and translating data-oriented concepts for non-technical audiences.

  • You bring experience in team mentorship and coaching

  • You have demonstrated capability to balance multiple strategic projects simultaneously, while maintaining a focus on quality and commercial impact

Our interview process

  1. Talent Team Screen: 40 mins

  2. Introduction Interview: 60 mins

  3. Commercial Interview: 60 mins

  4. Leadership and Principles interview: 60 mins

  5. Meet the MD, Commercial: 30 mins

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours.

A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI.

title: Tech Lead
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at MyEdSpace
description_html:
MyEdSpace is an education technology platform that connects the best teachers on the planet with the students who need them the most - wherever they are, whatever their means.

Backed by $15m in Series A funding from some of the leading investors in the space, we're ready to scale - and we want you to help us build and scale MyEdSpace as part of a collaborative and ambitious team.

We're on a mission to make a world-class education accessible to all.

We believe that every child deserves access to quality education, regardless of geography or socioeconomic background, to achieve their dreams and build a brighter future.

If you’re motivated by solving meaningful problems and creating real impact through your work on a societal level and make a real impact on the world - we’d love to hear from you!

Job Title: Tech Lead

Experience: 8+ years commercial experience as a Software Engineer

Location: Remote / Flexible (UK timezone overlap required)

Compensation: Competitive + bonus upside

Your Impact at MyEdSpace

We’re looking for a Tech Lead who cares deeply about building great products and well-structured systems — whether your strengths lie in backend, frontend, or across the stack. You’ll guide technical decisions, help navigate trade-offs, and support engineers in delivering high-quality work.

The role spans three key areas of responsibility:

  • Technical leadership — coding, pair programming, peer reviews, and driving software and architecture design.

  • People management — running 1:1s, supporting career progression, and ensuring a strong feedback loop.

  • Product collaboration — working closely with product and design to shape scope, prioritise effectively, and align on outcomes.

We're building both the system and the team that will take us to the next stage — and you'll have real influence on how we scale, structure, and evolve our technology.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Lead and mentor a globally distributed team of engineers, fostering a high-performance, inclusive, and collaborative culture.

  • Set the bar for technical excellence, promoting best practices across architecture, CI/CD, testing, and code quality.

  • Drive a DevOps mindset — engineers own what they build, from design to deployment and beyond.

  • Architect and deliver scalable, maintainable systems and features with measurable impact on learners.

  • Collaborate with AI specialists to integrate adaptive, personalized learning into our platform.

  • Partner cross-functionally with product, design, and data to shape roadmap, scope work, and align on outcomes.

  • Continuously improve how we build software — from delivery speed and reliability to team workflows and technical decision-making.

What We’re Looking For

  • Senior engineering experience in product-led, fast-paced environments — ideally with time spent leading teams or large projects.

  • Strong software architecture skills — API-first, modular design, async comms, scaling patterns.

  • You work AI-first: LLMs and agentic tools are part of your daily workflow, not an experiment.

  • Experience across the stack — deep backend expertise and comfort navigating modern frontend frameworks (React.js preferred).

  • Fluency in Agile and Lean methodologies, you think in terms of shipping value in small increments, not running ceremonies.

  • Comfortable working in Docker-based, cloud-native environments (we use AWS).

  • A track record of shipping user-facing products that are performant, elegant, and thoughtfully engineered.

  • Excellent communication skills and collaborative mindset — you're comfortable working across disciplines and time zones.

Perks & Benefits

  • Flexible working hours

  • Competitive compensation with significant upside

  • Access to the latest AI tools & productivity software

  • Global, mission-driven team with a strong sense of purpose

Our Hiring Process

We aim to keep the process efficient, transparent, and focused on mutual fit:

  1. CV Screening

    We review your experience, technical foundation, and alignment with the role.

  2. Introductory Call with Hiring Manager

    A 60 minute conversation to discuss your background, what you're looking for, and how we work.

  3. Coding Exercise

    A take-home designed to assess practical skills — architecture, clean code, testing, and problem-solving.

  4. Technical Interview

    A deep dive into your engineering approach — we’ll explore past projects, technical decisions, and systems thinking.

  5. Culture & Collaboration Interview

    A final conversation to assess team fit, communication style, and alignment with our values and ways of working with the Product Manager of the squad

✨ Our values

PUT INTEGRITY FIRST Honesty matters. Tell the truth, and be straight-up. Be transparent and do the right thing. This builds respect and reliability for our students, families and team members.

KNOW YOUR COORDINATES Understand where you are and where you want to get to. Know your strengths and acknowledge your gaps. Think from first principles. Question things, and never pretend to know what you don't.

RAISE THE BAR Own it and get it done. Do better. Iterate quickly and seek feedback. Deliver real value. Be excellent and lift others up. Share learnings and help your teammates improve.

LOVE TO BE WRONG Push boundaries. Be outside your comfort zone. Naturally you'll get some things wrong and that's okay. Embrace feedback. Learn from it and get closer to excellence.

WIN TOGETHER To achieve our mission, we have to work together. We all have a role to play, so help each other get there. We’re stronger as a team so inspire, support and respect each other.

🙋 Why you’ll love working here

We’re a team on a mission to transform education for the better. Joining MES means you’ll be part of something ambitious, fast-moving, and full of purpose. Here’s what you can expect:

  • The chance to make a real impact: your work directly shapes the future of education.

  • A fast-paced and high-growth environment where ideas move quickly and careers accelerate.

  • A collaborative, supportive culture: we’re head quartered in the UK, but we’re a global team with colleagues in 15+ countries, bringing a rich mix of perspectives and energy.

We are committed to building a diverse team and strongly encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds. We believe diverse perspectives make us stronger and help us build a better product for students around the world.

title: Staff Product Manager
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at V7Labs.com
description_html:
V7

At V7, we’re building AI platforms that help humans do their best work, at incredible scale and speed. Our mission is to turn human knowledge into trustworthy AI, making complex tasks faster, smarter, and more accurate. We’re growing fast, backed by leading investors and AI pioneers (including the minds behind Transformers and Gemini).

The product

V7 Go is a set of tools for the document-heavy work that finance and insurance teams do every day. Workflow automation for the processes that used to eat whole afternoons. A Context Graph that makes everything a team knows (across workflows, documents and integrations) queryable in one place. Chat for the questions that don’t fit a process. It takes multi-modal data and returns verifiable outputs with transparent logic, so accuracy and compliance come built in, and it runs on the latest models including GPT, Claude and Gemini.

The point isn’t the AI. It’s that an analyst who used to spend three days on something gets it back in an hour, with citations and an audit trail, and can show their working to anyone who asks. Have a look at what we’re building for finance and insurance.

The team you’ll be joining and the impact you’ll have

  • You’ll own V7 Go. That’s the whole product, not a corner of it, working with [X] engineers and [X] designers and with the founders close by.

  • Go 4x-ed revenue last year with 160%+ upsell, and we’re running tens of millions of documents through it for customers in finance, insurance and real estate. What you choose to build next is what decides where that goes.

  • The product does a lot of different things for a lot of different teams. A big part of the job is having a view on what it should be, and being willing to say no to the rest.

  • It’s a small product team, so there’s not much process to hide behind. If something’s broken or missing, it’s yours to sort out.

What you’ll be doing from day one

  • Owning the roadmap. Deciding what gets built, killing the stuff that doesn’t matter, and shipping continuously rather than in quarterly chunks.

  • Working out which problems are actually worth solving. Sales wants one thing, the loudest customer wants another, and the interesting bet is usually neither.

  • Defining what good looks like before anything gets built, then checking afterwards whether it landed. Adoption, not shipped tickets.

  • Making the trade-off calls. What’s in, what’s out, what’s deliberately a bit rubbish for now, and being able to explain why to whoever asks.

  • Writing things down clearly. Decisions, trade-offs, why we said no to something. It’s how a small team stays pointed the same way.

  • Keeping the whole thing coherent. Workflows, Context Graph and chat need to feel like one product rather than three that happen to share a login. Most of the features are self-serve, so if it needs explaining, that's a product problem.

Who you are

  • You’ve owned a product properly, at a startup or somewhere with a serious product culture. Not running a backlog someone else set.

  • You've owned a real product area end to end at a startup or a company with a serious product culture. Discovery through launch, not backlog management.

  • You've built for expert users who know their domain better than you do. B2B SaaS, fintech, insurtech, developer tools, data platforms.

  • You're genuinely hands-on with LLMs and agents. You build with them, you have views on what they're good and bad at, and you can tell a demo from a product.

  • You can hold a conversation with engineers about trade-offs without needing everything translated.

  • You’re happy without much certainty. Priorities move here more than they would somewhere bigger.

  • Opinionated but not precious about it.

V7 champions equality and inclusion because diverse teams build better products. Don't check every box? Apply anyway — we value what makes you unique and will support you through the process, just let our Talent team know how they can help.

Compensation: £100K – £140K • Offers Equity

title: Finance Analyst
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at loveholidays
description_html:
Why loveholidays?

We’re on a mission to open the world to everyone, giving our customers unlimited choice, unmatched ease and unmissable value for their next getaway.

Our trailblaze together culture is what drives our success, powered by our people and the way they work. Using progressive technology, we drive cutting-edge innovation and improve how our customers discover, book and experience their holidays. You’ll have the opportunity to accelerate your growth through meaningful challenges, new experiences and the freedom to shape your own path. You’ll create impact for our future by taking ownership, contributing to shared goals and helping shape what comes next, all as part of our enhanced international community of talented, collaborative and passionate teams.


The difference you’ll make:

You’ll sit in the Finance team, reporting to the Assistant Treasurer. You’ll work closely with Commercial Finance, FP&A, Reporting, and Finance Ops. Our Finance team plays a crucial role in driving the success of the business by managing budgets and liquidity, forecasting performance, and providing strategic insights. We ensure financial stability and support our business partners in decision-making.


Finance sits within our Enablement function, providing the expertise, structure and challenge that help loveholidays operate at its best. Through clear frameworks, trusted partnerships and practical guidance, we support better decisions, manage risk and create strong foundations for sustainable growth.

Your day-to-day:

  • Financial Planning & Commercial Strategy: Own key components of the annual budget and forecasting cycles, leveraging Anaplan to build robust models. Partner with wider business stakeholders to drive strategic insights, identify variance drivers for working capital, and provide data-driven recommendations that influence decision-making.

  • Cash & Liquidity Management: Manage daily cash operations, including liquidity monitoring, and investment activities to maximise returns and reduce idle cash. Drive the end-to-end process for the 13-week cash flow forecast - from gathering inputs and analysing variances to refining assumptions, ensuring high-confidence projections for senior management.

  • Risk Exposure: Actively manage financial risk in the business, including FX, counterparty, and interest rates.

  • Process Innovation & Automation: Champion continuous improvement by identifying manual tasks across Finance and Treasury. Drive automation projects — to streamline processes, improve data integrity, and create scalable workflows, while training our shared service centre to take on operational day to day responsibilities.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Serve as a bridge between your team and the wider Finance team, ensuring seamless communication and supporting ad-hoc financial projects that align with company-wide business and growth goals.


Your skillset:

  • Qualified Accountant (minimum 2+ years post qual)

  • You have: a background in commercial finance with interest in developing Treasury exposure, or a background in Treasury and interest in wider commercial finance

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

  • Proven experience using AI to accelerate delivery and improve efficiency

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

  • Proficient in financial modelling, budgeting and forecasting

  • Excellent stakeholder management experience

  • Organised, task focused and will go the extra mile to get things done

The interview journey:

  1. Intro with a member of the Talent Acquisition team - 30 mins

  2. 1st Stage with Assistant Treasurer - 45mins

  3. 2nd Stage with Head of Treasury and a member of Finance Leadership Team - with case study and presentation - 1 hour

  4. 3rd Stage with VP of Commercial Finance / VP of Group Finance - 30 mins

Perks of joining us:

  • Company pension contributions at 5%

  • Individualised training budget for you to learn on the job and level yourself up

  • Discounted holidays for you, your family and friends

  • 25 days of holidays per annum (plus 8 public holidays) increases by 1 day for every second year of service, up to a maximum 30 days per annum

  • Ability to buy and sell annual leave

  • Access to our electric vehicle salary sacrifice scheme

  • Cycle to work scheme, season ticket loan and eye care vouchers

 

Our commitment to inclusion:

At loveholidays, we focus on creating an inclusive environment where everyone can contribute, grow and succeed. We value the different perspectives, experiences and ideas each person brings, because they help us work better together, challenge our thinking and make stronger decisions.

As we continue to grow and evolve, we want everyone to feel supported and able to do their best work. We’re also committed to making our hiring process accessible, so please let our Talent Acquisition team know if you need any adjustments at any stage.

🚀 EverAI — Building the Future of AI Companionship

Your Role

We are looking for a Mid/Senior AI Cinematic Video Editor who is deeply embedded in generative video workflows and can independently craft high-quality, narrative-driven content from concept to final output.

You are a sharp-eyed video editor comfortable operating at the intersection of creativity and emerging technology, building visually compelling long-form videos using AI-first pipelines. Hard Skills

Soft Skills

🗣 Strong communication & collaboration skills (fluent in English)

🎯 High ownership — able to take ideas from concept to completion independently

⚡️ Experimental mindset — comfortable navigating ambiguity and evolving tools

⏱️ Fast iteration cycles — able to test, fail, refine, and improve quickly

🧠 Curious and self-driven — constantly exploring new AI capabilities and workflows

🧢 Open to feedback and continuous improvement

🍭 #NSFW — Comfortable working with uncensored models and explicit adult content


Bonus Points

  • Experience in AI-native storytelling or filmmaking

  • Background in 3D, VFX, technical art or as a colourist

  • Familiarity with training/customizing models (LoRAs, embeddings, fine-tuning)

  • Prior experience in adult, dating, or adjacent creative industries a huge bonus

  • Experience with ComfyUI

  • Experience with Stable Diffusion / AUTOMATIC1111 and related tooling (Advanced prompting, working with trained LoRAs, refining, upscaling, inpainting etc.)

🛡️ Ethical Core: Our AI ecosystem is governed by EverGuard, our proprietary AI moderation technology, ensuring responsible development at scale

What We Offer

✍️ Contract Type: We prefer B2B, but we’re flexible, what matters is long-term commitment and impact
📍 Work From Anywhere: Fully remote. Choose the environment where you do your best work
🏝️ Paid Time Off: 4 weeks (20 working days) of PTO per year to recharge and reset

We’re a fully remote group of A-players from Tier 1 tech, led by an exec team who’ve launched, scaled, and exited multiple companies. We move fast, and care deeply about what we build — and who we build it with.

title: Customer Success Intern (d/f/m)
salary_basis: Based on historical internship stipend records at Taxfix
description_html:
Our story:

Every year millions of people are either filing their taxes in fear or giving up on their tax refund altogether. We're working on fixing that. Our intuitive app enables anyone, regardless of education or background, to file their taxes with newfound confidence.

Spread across Germany, Spain and the UK, the team at Taxfix Group with its brands Taxfix, Steuerbot and TaxScouts, is a compassionate group of solution-finders. We speak our minds openly, and with over 400 professionals, including tax experts, developers, and IT security experts, we're rich in ideas and voices. The group has facilitated more than 3.5 billion euros in tax refunds for its customers since its founding in 2016.

Your challenge:

As a Customer Success Intern at Taxfix, you'll be at the heart of our mission to simplify taxes and empower people to feel confident about their finances. You’ll provide world-class support to customers and accountant partners alike, ensuring their needs are met with empathy, precision, and speed. During our peak season, you’ll play a key role in helping us scale our operations while maintaining our high standards of service.

This internship is not just about answering tickets — it’s an opportunity to develop deep product and tax knowledge, influence how we improve the customer journey, and work cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, and Ops teams. If you're eager to grow your skills in a fast-paced, impact-driven environment while supporting real people through complex processes, we’d love to hear from you.

Your responsibilities:

  • Respond to customer inquiries via live chat, email, and phone with empathy and accuracy, consistently achieving a first response time of under 2 minutes and a CSAT score of 85% or higher.

  • Troubleshoot customer and accountant issues effectively, resolving the majority on the first contact and ensuring resolution within 24 hours.

  • Identify and share feedback trends with internal teams to improve customer experience and retention, delivering at least 10 actionable insights per quarter.

  • Support our accountant partners with clarity and care, maintaining satisfaction ratings of 90% or higher.

  • Develop subject-matter expertise in UK tax processes and our product features, contributing to 5–10 help-centre articles each quarter to enhance self-service options.

  • Collaborate closely with Product and Engineering to raise and track technical issues, ensuring critical bugs are clearly documented and resolved.

  • Conduct inbound and outbound sales calls with prospective customers, clearly explaining how our service works and what to expect from the tax filing process.

  • Track key performance data using spreadsheets and internal tools, and support the Ops team in compiling quarterly reports on team performance.

  • Stay agile during our seasonal peaks (Nov–Jan), managing a 30–40% increase in support volume without compromising on quality or speed.

  • Guide customers through the onboarding journey over the phone, answering questions with confidence and tailoring your explanation to their level of tax knowledge.

  • Follow up with leads who have shown interest but not yet completed sign-up, using calls as an opportunity to address concerns and convert them into active users.

Your profile:

  • You have 1–2 years of experience in a customer-facing support role, ideally across live chat, email, or phone, and feel confident resolving issues independently within service-level targets.

  • You’re a clear, empathetic communicator who can simplify tax-heavy topics into friendly and accessible guidance for customers.

  • You’re technically comfortable navigating multiple platforms (like Intercom, Zendesk, Slack, or Notion) and pick up new tools quickly.

  • You approach problems analytically — spotting patterns, troubleshooting effectively, and escalating issues with the right context.

  • You enjoy collaborating across functions and have worked with Ops, Product, or Engineering teams to get customer issues resolved.

  • You’re confident using spreadsheets (Google Sheets or Excel) for basic analysis and reporting, and you're keen to use data to improve support processes.

  • You’re curious and proactive about learning — especially when it comes to understanding UK tax processes and how our product works.

  • Bonus: You’ve worked in a fintech or seasonal environment before, contributed to help centre content, or bring multilingual skills to the table.

  • You thrive in fast-paced, evolving environments where you can make a meaningful impact and help shape how we support our users.

  • Familiarity with generative AI tools

Why Taxfix?

  • A chance to do meaningful, people-centric work with an international team of passionate professionals.

  • Plenty of opportunities to socialise as a team. In addition to internal meetups, our international team hosts regular get-togethers—virtually and in person when possible.

  • Have a four-legged friend in your life? We’re happy to have dogs join us in the office.


Excited? So are we. Learn more about Team Taxfix on our blog and get a glimpse of our culture.

At Taxfix, we believe that incredible things happen when you have a wealth of perspectives and experiences. We're proudly committed to equal employment and development opportunities no matter your gender, race, religion, age, sexual orientation, colour, disability, or place of origin. To help mitigate any potential unconscious biases, we ask that you refrain from including your picture, age, or marital status on your CV. Let your experiences speak for themselves.

Not sure if you meet all the requirements for this role? Please apply anyway. You might bring something special to the team that we hadn't considered previously.

title: Data Analyst / Controller (w/m/d) - BI & Finance
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at enua Pharma GmbH
description_html:
enua ist ein ganzheitlicher Hersteller für medizinisches Cannabis in Deutschland und gehört zu den Top 3 Anbietern im Markt. Unsere Vision ist es, Patienten und Menschen einen nachhaltigen Zugang zu Cannabis zu verschaffen.

Dafür brauchen wir Menschen, die ein schnell wachsendes, profitables Unternehmen in einem Pioniermarkt mitgestalten wollen. Wenn du dazugehörst, bewirb dich gerne bei enua!

Aufgaben

Deine Rolle

enua ist in der Hyper-Scale-up-Phase: 50 Millionen Umsatz, über 1.000 Apotheken, und wir wachsen aus den Systemen heraus, die uns hierhergebracht haben. Du bist Teil des Data Teams, das diesen Wechsel vornimmt und bist dort die Schnittstelle zu Controlling und Finance: Du übersetzt betriebswirtschaftliche Fragestellungen in Datenanforderungen und Datenmodelle – mit klarem Fokus auf interne Zahlen und Unternehmenssteuerung.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Fundament ausbauen: Du treibst die ständige Professionalisierung unserer internen Datenquellen aus Reporting-Sicht: Welche Daten brauchen wir, wie kommen sie ins Datenmodell, was bedeutet das für unsere Kennzahlen – auch beim bevorstehenden Wechsel unseres ERP-Systems auf Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central
  • Reporting bauen: Du baust, pflegst und entwickelst unsere Reports und Dashboards weiter – von der Datenquelle über das Datenmodell bis zur Visualisierung
  • Manuelles abschaffen: Du ersetzt manuelle Excel-Strecken durch robuste, standardisierte Reporting-Prozesse und automatisierst wiederkehrende Auswertungen und Datenflüsse – mit KI als Co-Worker
  • Steuerungslogik verantworten: Du übersetzt betriebswirtschaftliche Fragestellungen in Kennzahlen, Dashboards und Datenmodelle und verantwortest, dass die Kennzahlen dahinter stimmen: Definition, Berechnungslogik, Qualitätssicherung und konsistente Bereitstellung über alle Bereiche hinweg
  • Entscheidungen vorbereiten: Du lieferst Analysen und Ad-hoc-Auswertungen für Geschäftsführung und Fachbereiche – inkl. Interpretation, Ursachenanalyse und Handlungsempfehlung
  • Gruppe zusammenführen: Du baust das Reporting auf Gruppenebene aus: Anbindung und Harmonisierung der Kennzahlen unserer Schwestergesellschaften
  • Sparringspartner*in sein: Du bist Sparringspartner*in für die Fachbereiche von Procurement bis Sales bei der Frage: Welche Zahl brauchen wir, woher kommt sie und was sagt sie uns?

Qualifikation

Dein Profil

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium in Wirtschaftswissenschaften, (Wirtschafts-) Informatik, Data Analytics oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
  • Berufserfahrung im Business-Intelligence-/Reporting-Umfeld, als Data Analyst (w/m/d) oder im Controlling – ob zwei oder zehn Jahre ist uns weniger wichtig als das, was du damit gebaut hast
  • Verständnis für betriebswirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge und die Fähigkeit, Zahlen in Aussagen und Entscheidungsgrundlagen zu übersetzen
  • Sehr gute Erfahrung mit Excel und Power Query,
  • Erfahrung mit Power BI/DAX oder SQL wünschenswert
  • Ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten und Freude daran, heterogene Daten systematisch aufzubereiten und zu strukturieren
  • Wünschenswert: Du hast KI schon im Unternehmenskontext eingesetzt, zum Beispiel einen wiederkehrenden Workflow automatisiert, Daten damit geprüft oder einen kleinen Agenten gebaut, und kannst erzählen, was dabei funktioniert hat und was nicht
  • Hohe Eigeninitiative, Hands-on-Mentalität und Lust, Reporting-Strukturen in einem wachsenden Unternehmen aktiv mitaufzubauen
  • Kommunikationsstärke im Austausch mit Fachbereichen und Management
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse

Benefits

Was wir bieten

  • Gestaltungsspielraum pur – bei uns gibt es keine starren Hierarchien, jede gute Idee ist willkommen, egal von wem sie kommt. Smarte Ideen sind das, was uns voranbringt!
  • Grundlegende Mitgestaltung eines expandierenden Scale-Up-Unternehmens, unterstützt durch ein erfahrenes Management und einer Menge Energie aus dem Team
  • Databricks im Aufbau: Das Data Team zieht enuas Datenplattform gerade um. Du baust das nicht, aber du bist die erste Person, die ihre Reports darauf stellt
  • KI ist bei uns Tagesgeschäft, nicht Pilotprojekt – für Datenqualität, Analyse und Dokumentation. Du bekommst die Tools und die Freiheit, sie zu nutzen
  • Sei Teil eines starken Teams mit einer positiven und hochmotivierten Unternehmenskultur
  • Regelmäßige Team-Events & Lunches mit dem gesamten Team
  • Moderner Office Komplex in Köln inkl. Kantine, die von uns bezuschusst wird (Warme Gerichte, Salatbar, Bowls of the Day, uvm.)
  • Benefit Portal "Hrmony", in dem du dir monatlich individuell Gutscheine aussuchen kannst (z.B. Urban Sports, DB, Ikea oder REWE)
  • Starkes Wachstum in deiner Karriere und Persönlichkeit
  • In dieser ganzheitlichen Rolle erhältst du einen 360-Grad-Einblick in enua und arbeitest interdisziplinär

Bist du bereit, die deutsche Cannabis-Geschichte mitzuschreiben?

Wir sind auf der Suche nach leidenschaftlichen und talentierten Menschen, die unsere Mission teilen, Menschen ein besseres Lebensgefühl zu verleihen.

Stellst du genauso sehr wie wir den Status quo von Cannabis in Frage, denkst agil und möchtest unserem Unternehmenswachstum einen zusätzlichen Boost geben?

Bei uns, einem etablierten Scale-up-Unternehmen auf einem disruptiven Markt, wird deine Leistung gesehen und belohnt.

Du möchtest dich unserer Mission anschließen?

Dann bewirb dich bei uns, werde ein Teil unseres hoch ambitionierten Teams und revolutioniere mit uns eine gesamte Industrie!

description_html:
Zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt suchen wir Sie als

Leiter Finanzbuchhaltung (w/m/d) mit Erfahrung in der Prozessoptimierung

für ein kleineres Unternehmen mit zahlreichen Tochtergesellschaften in einem nachhaltigen Branchenumfeld und Stuttgarter Innenstadt-Lage.

Die Vollzeitstelle bietet Ihnen Homeoffice-Anteil von einem Tag pro Woche nach erfolgreicher Einarbeitung. Dazu kommen 30 Urlaubstage.

In Abhängigkeit von Ihren Kenntnissen und Ihrer Berufserfahrung können Sie hier bis zu 90.000 € p.a. verdienen.

Die Stelle ist im Rahmen der Personalvermittlung zu besetzen. Bedeutet also: Sie haben von Anfang an ein festes Anstellungsverhältnis mit Ihrem neuen Arbeitgeber, der Sie gerne viele Jahre beschäftigen möchte.

Der besseren Lesbarkeit wegen richten sich alle folgenden Bezeichnungen an alle Geschlechter.

Aufgaben

Voilà, so sieht Ihr neuer Job aus!

  • Sie leiten die Finanzbuchhaltung für die Hauptgesellschaft sowie für Untergesellschaften
  • Dabei führen Sie ein Team von fünf Mitarbeitenden, für das Sie ein kompetenter Ansprechpartner sind
  • Unter anderem haben Sie die Verantwortung für die Monats-, Quartals- und Jahresabschlüsse nach HGB
  • Sie unterstützen Ihr Team im laufenden Tagesgeschäft durch Ihre Mitarbeit
  • Für die weitere Prozessoptimierung bringen Sie Ihre Erfahrung ein, u.a. mittels K.I.-Nutzung
  • Weitere Aufgaben können entsprechend Ihrer Erfahrungen, Kenntnisse und Wünsche dazukommen (formulieren Sie in einem Bewerbungsgespräch vor Ort gerne Ihre entsprechenden Erwartungen).

Qualifikation

Das bringen Sie mit:

  • Sie verfügen über mindestens vier Jahre Berufserfahrung in einer vergleichbaren Rolle inkl. der selbstständigen Abschlusserstellung, egal ob Sie ein Team bisher disziplinarisch oder fachlich geführt haben
  • Ergänzend haben Sie bereits Erfahrung in der Prozessoptimierung gesammelt in Verbindung mit der Nutzung von K.I.
  • Sie kommunizieren mündlich und schriftlich in sehr gutem Deutsch
  • Wir verzichten gerne auf die an dieser Stelle üblichen persönlichen Attribute und möchten Sie als Person kennenlernen. Wichtig ist zunächst, dass Sie Lust auf nette Kollegen haben und ein absoluter Teamplayer sind, der sich fachlich gerne weiter entwickeln möchte.
  • Uns ist klar, dass kaum jemand alle Anforderungen erfüllen wird. Auch solche Bewerbungen sind herzlich willkommen!

Benefits

Das bietet Ihnen Ihr neuer Arbeitgeber:

  • Einen Homeoffice-Anteil von einem Tag pro Woche nach erfolgreicher Einarbeitung
  • Kernarbeitszeiten montags bis donnerstags von 9 bis 16 Uhr, freitags nur bis 13 Uhr!
  • Deutschland-Ticket
  • Top Innenstadt-Lage mit sehr gutem ÖPNV-Anschluss
  • Betriebliche Krankenversicherung
  • Gruppenunfallversicherung
  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge
  • 30 Urlaubstage.

In 3 einfachen Schritten zu Ihrer neuen Anstellung:

1.) Bewerbungsunterlagen als PDF abspeichern (Verzichten Sie gerne auf ein Anschreiben).

2.) Bewerbung absenden

3.) Wir setzen uns sehr zeitnah mit Ihnen in Verbindung.

Bei Fragen steht Ihnen unsere Personalberater Uli Davidsson unter der Rufnummer 0711 / 528 509 - 16 jederzeit gerne zur Verfügung.

Kann man uns vertrauen? Wir meinen JA!

Fischer & Partner ist zum besten Personalvermittler der DACH-Region (Deutschland, Österreich, Schweiz) ausgezeichnet worden. Weiterempfehlungsrate: glatte 100%. Weitere Informationen unter:

https://www.kununu.com/de/fischer-partner-gesellschaft-fuer-personal-mbh/bewerbung?sort=newest

Was Sie sonst noch über uns wissen sollten:

Falls diese Stelle nicht zu Ihnen passen sollte, bewerben Sie sich bitte trotzdem: Wir können Ihnen Stellen als Finanzbuchhalter und Bilanzbuchhalter in der Region Stuttgart immer wieder vorschlagen, ebenso als Entgeltabrechner und Controller.

Finden Sie weitere attraktive Stellenangebote auf unserer Homepage.

Für Sie als Bewerber arbeiten wir kostenfrei und mit höchster Diskretion. Bevor wir Sie bei potenziellen Arbeitgebern in anonymisierter Form vorschlagen, sprechen wir immer zuerst mit Ihnen über die jeweilige Stelle! Ohne Ihre Zustimmung unternehmen wir keinen Schritt. Ihre Daten sind bei uns sicher!

Unser Qualitätsversprechen: Wir beantworten jede Bewerbung sehr zuverlässig innerhalb von max. drei Werktagen, i.d.R. schneller. Wenn Sie also nach drei Werktagen nichts von uns gehört haben, kann es technische Gründe dafür geben. Bitte haken Sie in diesem Fall bei uns nach.

title: Head of Brand & Marketing (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on leadership compensation records at Jordan Olivenöl Gmbh
description_html:
Wir besetzen diese Stelle nur einmal richtig – oder gar nicht.

Jordan Olivenöl ist ein Familienunternehmen aus Solingen, seit 1989 und in dritter Generation. Unser Öl kommt von der Insel Lesbos – aus eigenem Anbau und von Familien aus der Bergregion, die wir persönlich kennen. Es ist über 240-mal international ausgezeichnet, Bestseller bei Amazon und steht im deutschen Lebensmittelhandel, in führenden Feinkostgeschäften und in der Spitzengastronomie. Mit Bambatsa führen wir ein wildes Olivenöl, mit PHENORA bauen wir eine zweite Marke für hochphenolisches Öl auf. Das Produkt setzt den Maßstab. Die Marke soll ihn erreichen. Das ist dein Job.

Aufgaben

Der Auftrag

Du führst unsere Marken – Jordan, Bambatsa und PHENORA. Positionierung, Optik, Tonalität, Geschichte: eine Handschrift, überall, wo Menschen uns begegnen. Du gibst die Richtung vor und steuerst die Umsetzung, im Haus und mit externen Partnern. Du verantwortest das Marketingbudget und entscheidest darin selbst. Du berichtest direkt an den Geschäftsführer – und du bist dafür da, ihm zu widersprechen, wenn du es besser weißt. Mit Belegen.

Dein Feld ist die ganze Marke: Etikett und Regal, Shop und Marktplätze, Social und Newsletter, Print, Messen und Presse – und die Stimme des Unternehmens auf LinkedIn. Woran wir uns messen, ist nicht Reichweite, sondern Umsatz und Wiederkauf. Und ob unser Name fällt, wenn jemand nach dem besten Olivenöl fragt – in einer Redaktion, einem Podcast oder einer KI.

Was du nicht tun musst

Alles selbst. Marktplätze bedienen, filmen und schneiden – dafür gibt es bei uns und um uns herum Menschen, die genau das können. Du musst wissen, was gut ist, es einfordern und die Zahlen lesen. Und du fasst überall dort selbst an, wo es schneller geht, als es zu erklären – mit Design- und KI-Werkzeugen geht das heute schnell.

Das ist keine Vertriebsstelle. Vertriebsdenken brauchst du, weil Marketing bei uns verkauft – Außendienst und Kundenbesuche gehören nicht dazu.

Qualifikation

Was du mitbringst

  • Du hast eine Marke geführt, aufgebaut oder neu aufgestellt und kannst zeigen, was daraus geworden ist. Ob im Unternehmen, in der Agentur oder mit einer eigenen Marke, ist uns egal. Die Branche auch.
  • Du hast eine eigene gestalterische Handschrift. Du siehst, wenn Typografie, Bild oder Verpackung nicht stimmen, und kannst selbst Entwürfe machen.
  • Du denkst wirtschaftlich – in Budget, Marge und Wiederkauf – und verstehst, wie ein Familienunternehmen entscheidet. Oder du bist Profi genug, es schnell zu lernen.
  • Du arbeitest täglich mit KI-Werkzeugen und kannst anderen zeigen, wie.
  • Du willst zu den Besten deines Fachs gehören und stehst für deine Arbeit ein. Wenn du etwas besser weißt als wir, belegst du es. Wer nur ausführt, passt nicht zu uns.
  • Exzellentes Deutsch, sicheres Englisch – für Lesbos, Messen und internationale Partner.
  • Head-Ebene, in der Regel acht bis fünfzehn Jahre. Wir bewerten das Werk, nicht den Titel. Wer das Werk hat und den Titel noch nicht, soll sich bewerben.

Wer nicht passt

Wer ein Budget und drei Agenturen verwalten will, statt selbst zu gestalten. Wer schöne Dinge macht, aber nicht sagen kann, was sie verkauft haben. Wer Zahlen liebt, aber keine Marke fühlt.

Benefits

Wie wir arbeiten

Kurze Wege. Entscheidungen fallen im Gespräch, nicht im Gremium. Direkter Draht zum Geschäftsführer, der dir das Marketing überträgt – ganz, nicht in Teilen.

Rahmen

Unbefristete Vollzeitstelle in Solingen. Wir wollen dich vor Ort – am Produkt, im Studio, beim Team. Einzelne Homeoffice-Tage sind möglich, der Alltag findet hier statt. Festgehalt, das zur Rolle passt; über Zahlen sprechen wir im ersten Gespräch offen. Eigenes Foto- und Filmstudio mit Team, Fitnessstudio und Restaurant im Haus, Reisen nach Lesbos zu Ernte und Mühle.

So bewirbst du dich

Kein Anschreiben. Wir wollen drei Dinge: deinen Lebenslauf; deine Antworten auf drei Fragen – Was hast du zuletzt von null aufgebaut? Was ist daraus geworden? Was würdest du bei Jordan als Erstes ändern?; und eine Arbeitsprobe: ein Link oder Anhang zu etwas, das du gemacht hast, mit einem Satz zum Ergebnis und zu deinem Anteil.

Wie es weitergeht

Wir lesen jede Bewerbung selbst. Dann 15 Minuten Video, ein ausführliches Gespräch mit Bastian Jordan und einem erfahrenen Unternehmer aus unserem Umfeld, eine Fallaufgabe mit einer Woche Zeit, ein Tag bei uns in Solingen, zwei Referenzgespräche. Danach entscheiden wir schnell – und in beide Richtungen ehrlich.

title: Senior Backend Developer
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Waracle
description_html:
Waracle are looking for a Senior Developer for an exciting new role joining our world-class digital technology consultancy and home to a diverse, smart, curious and ambitious community of specialists in technology-driven transformation.

We work with ambitious clients to help them solve their biggest business and customer challenges. We help our clients to innovate and create intelligent digital products and services. We thrive on complex challenges and deliver business-critical IT transformation projects, moving seamlessly from strategy, design and delivery to operations.

This is a Hybrid role, giving you the flexibility of working from home while spending 2 days a week connecting with the team in either our Glasgow or Dundee office.

Shape the Future of Digital Transformation

As a Senior Developer at Waracle, you will do so much more than just write code; you will be a key influencer, creator, and supportive guide within our engineering practice. Operating at an impactful level, you will design and deliver end-to-end backend features while acting as a trusted guardian of software quality and security.

If you are a collaborative problem-solver who enjoys technical design, sharing knowledge, and helping others thrive in a supportive, modern engineering environment, we would love to welcome your expertise.


Key aspects of the role include:

  • Architectural Delivery: Collaborating to design and deliver robust end-to-end backend subsystems, ensuring code is modular, maintainable, and built to scale.

  • Quality & Security: Championing high standards through constructive peer reviews, establishing defensive application security measures, and guiding thoughtful testing strategies across unit and service levels.

  • Consulting & Communication: Translating complex technical choices into clear, accessible language for clients and stakeholders, building strong, trusting relationships.

  • Mentorship & Practice Growth: Nurturing the growth of junior colleagues through encouraging feedback, while contributing fresh industry ideas to Waracle’s collective knowledge base.

  • Delivery Accountability: Balancing speed and quality thoughtfully to ensure the successful, sustainable delivery of features.


Research shows that underrepresented groups tend to only apply for roles that they believe they meet 100% of the criteria for. At Waracle, we want to buck that trend! We hire for passion, potential and mindset as much as credentials. If you think you'd be incredible in the role, then apply - even if you don't think you tick every box.


What you'll bring:

We know that excellent software engineering is built on diverse perspectives. We are looking for someone with a strong foundation in backend development who values collaboration just as much as technical excellence.

  • A proven track record of contributing to the delivery of complex digital products.

  • Deep, practical experience working with .NET C#.

  • Familiarity or experience with modern cloud tools and patterns, such as Azure, Durable Functions, Event sourcing, SQL, and Docker.

  • A strong understanding of SOLID principles, maintainability, and industry-standard security practices.

  • A supportive, encouraging communication style with a passion for mentoring team members and providing uplifting, constructive feedback.

What to expect from our hiring process

  1. First Hello: An informal chat with your dedicated Talent Attraction Partner to talk about Waracle, what you want out of your next move, salary, benefits, and office hybrid working model.

  2. Craft Showcase: A chance to demonstrate your real-world expertise. Depending on the role, this will be a focused take-home task (capped at 2–3 hours to respect your time).

  3. Talking Impact: A collaborative deep dive into how you solve problems, work with others, and raise the bar, guided by our core values and competency framework.

Your Talent Attraction Partner will be in your corner through every step right up to your Welcome Ritual on day one.

Our Benefits

We believe in supporting our team, inside and outside of work. Here's a glimpse of what you can expect:

  • Rest & Recharge: You'll receive 27 days of annual leave, plus 8 bank holidays, totaling 35 days of holiday to unwind and pursue your passions.

  • Financial Future & Security: Plan for retirement with our company-matched 5% pension contribution. For added peace of mind, we also offer a Death in Service benefit, providing 2 x your annual salary for your loved ones.

  • Health & Wellness: Our Medicash Health Cash Plans help cover everyday healthcare costs, complemented by an Employee Assistance Programme for confidential support, and Group Sickness Cover for peace of mind.

  • Flexible Working: We champion hybrid working, providing a home office setup budget to ensure you're comfortable and productive wherever you are.

  • Learning & Development: Invest in yourself with access to Udemy Business and a dedicated learning and development budget for continuous growth.

  • Lifestyle Perks: Make the most of our Cycle to Work Scheme, and enjoy exclusive gym and retail discounts.

  • Family First: Our enhanced parental leave policies include support for fertility journeys, recognising diverse family needs.

  • Community & Connection: We foster a vibrant culture with regular fun meet-ups and lunch on us in the office once a month. You'll also have the opportunity to make a local impact through Spirit of Waracle, our initiative for getting involved in charitable causes locally, building strong team bonds and giving back.


We are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all suitably qualified persons regardless of their race, gender, disability, religion/belief, sexual orientation or age.

We’re proud of our close-knit culture, where we speak up, celebrate differences and push boundaries together.

About the role

As part of our three-person Line Structure Management Team, you'll play a key role in improving equipment reliability, reducing losses and driving performance across one of our production lines. Working within our Intersnack Work Systems (IWS), you'll lead our Progressive Maintenance programme, using data, problem-solving and technical expertise to eliminate recurring issues and deliver sustainable improvements.

This is a hands-on role that combines technical leadership, continuous improvement and coaching. You'll work closely with Operations colleagues and Equipment Owners to build capability, improve asset performance and create a culture of ownership and reliability. If you enjoy solving complex engineering challenges, influencing teams and making a visible impact in a fast-paced manufacturing environment, we'd love to hear from you.

What is IWS?
Intersnack Work Systems (IWS) is our structured approach to continuous improvement in manufacturing. Rooted in the principles of zero losses and 100% employee ownership, IWS empowers teams to deliver consistent, sustainable performance by identifying and eliminating inefficiencies at every level.

What’s in it for you?
We believe in rewarding our colleagues and helping them thrive. Here’s a flavour of what we offer:

  • Annual salary of £49,890, plus an annual bonus (targeted at 5%)

  • KP Pension Plan with up to 7% matched contributions

  • 25 days holiday, with the option to buy up to five additional days for more flexibility

  • Comprehensive healthcare support including Health Cash Plan, Digital GP and Employee Assistance Programme

  • KP4ME benefits platform with discounts, cashback, wellbeing tools and everyday savings

  • Enhanced family-friendly policies to support colleagues at every stage of life

What will you be doing?

  • Leading the Progressive Maintenance programme by owning maintenance strategy, driving reliability improvements and reducing breakdown and maintenance-related losses across the line

  • Driving continuous improvement activities through root cause analysis, loss elimination and problem-solving techniques to address recurring equipment and process issues

  • Partnering with Operations and Equipment Owners to improve line performance, build strong cross-functional relationships and deliver shared performance goals

  • Coaching and developing colleagues to increase technical capability, embed maintenance best practice and encourage a culture of ownership and accountability

  • Using data and performance insights to identify opportunities, prioritise improvements and support the delivery of safety, quality, cost and productivity targets


We’d love to hear from you if you can bring:

  • A strong engineering background supported by a Level 3 qualification in Engineering, Electrical Engineering, City & Guilds, NVQ or equivalent

  • Proven maintenance and fault-finding expertise with the ability to diagnose issues, implement solutions and improve equipment reliability

  • Experience of Continuous Improvement methodologies such as Lean, TPM, IWS or similar approaches, with a track record of delivering measurable improvements

  • Leadership and coaching skills with the ability to influence, support and develop colleagues in a manufacturing or production environment

  • Experience within manufacturing, food production or FMCG environments would be advantageous, although candidates from other engineering sectors with transferable skills are encouraged to apply

  • A proactive and collaborative approach with a passion for continuous improvement, teamwork and delivering results

Our purpose
At KP Snacks, we're passionate about creating happy snacking moments through our great tasting snacks and iconic brands. Every day, millions of people enjoy our products, including Hula Hoops, McCoy's, KP Nuts, Tyrrells, Skips, POM-BEAR and Butterkist, making us one of the UK's leading snack manufacturers.

For decades, we've been delighting consumers by combining well-loved favourites with exciting innovations that reflect changing tastes and expectations. We're equally passionate about our people and committed to creating a workplace where everyone can grow, develop and make a real impact.

As part of the Intersnack Group, one of the world's leading snack manufacturers, we combine global expertise with a shared commitment to creating happy snacking moments every day.

We’re committed to inclusion
We’re building a workplace where everyone belongs. If you don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you – your unique perspective could be just what we need. And if there’s anything we can do to make the process easier for you, just let us know.

Job Title: Technical & Solution Architect (Distributed Ledger / Regulated Financial Services)

Location: Hybrid - remote + regular on-site (London)

 

This is a hands-on technical leadership position in the making.

 

You will work across product management, engineering, and client-facing discussions to evolve the design of a distributed ledger-based post-trade platform operating within regulated financial services. You will initially contribute as a senior engineer while progressively taking ownership of system-level architecture, solution design, and technical direction.

 

This role is ideal for someone who wants to: Move from senior engineer to architect; Work on real financial market infrastructure problems; Combine deep technical thinking with business context; Shape a product at an early stage.

 

Why join us? You'll have real ownership and influence in a small, high-calibre team, with direct exposure to cutting-edge financial market infrastructure and a genuine say in product and architectural direction. The role offers a steep learning curve spanning technology, regulation, and market structure, along with a clear path to grow into a formal Technical & Solution Architect position.


Responsibilities:

 

Architecture & System Design:

o   Design scalable, secure distributed systems in regulated environments

o   Define and evolve system architecture, APIs, and integration patterns

o   Apply appropriate software design patterns and architectural principles

o   Contribute to smart contract and ledger design decisions

o   Ensure auditability, resilience, and operational robustness

 

Distributed Ledger & Digital Assets:

Work with distributed ledger technologies and smart contracts. Design models for:

o   Tokenised assets

o   Natively digital assets

o   Atomic settlement

o   DvP and RvP mechanisms

o   Central bank digital currency (CBDC) integration concepts

·       Evaluate trade-offs between on-chain and off-chain components

 

Financial Services Context:

o    Translate regulatory and market structure requirements into technical design

o    Understand settlement models and post-trade infrastructure

o    Work within business frameworks such as CSDR and GDPR.

 

Engineering & Implementation:

o   Contribute production-quality code in Java, JavaScript, Solidity, SQL

o   Review code and guide best practices

o   Improve CI/CD, testing strategies, and observability

 

Communication & Influence

o   Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to engineers, product management, clients,  and regulators (where applicable)

o   Tailor messaging to different audiences.

o   Use structured thinking and persuasive communication to amplify the impact of our technology.

o   Contribute to technical documentation and client materials.

 

Requirements:

 Technical:

o   Strong experience designing and building software products

o   Solid understanding of distributed systems principles

o   Experience with distributed ledgers and/or blockchain platforms

o   Familiarity with tokenisation and digital asset concepts

o   Strong API design experience (REST, event-driven architectures, etc.)

o   Working knowledge of: Java; JavaScript; Solidity; SQL

 

Financial Services Knowledge (or strong motivation to learn):

o   Understanding of post-trade processes

o   Familiarity with: CSDR; Central securities depositories; DvP and RvP models; Atomic settlement

o   Appreciation of regulatory constraints in financial infrastructure

 

Communication & Leadership Potential

o   Excellent written and verbal communication

o   Ability to adjust technical depth depending on audience

o   Structured and persuasive thinking

o   Comfortable operating in ambiguity

o   Ambition to grow into a Technical & Solution Architect role

o   Ownership mindset and startup resilience

 

 

What Success Looks Like:

Within 6–12 months, success in this role means owning key architectural decisions and leading solution design discussions both internally and with partners. You'll be the go-to person for system-level trade-offs, using your technical insight to influence product direction, and you'll act as the bridge between business requirements and engineering implementation.

  • Partner with product and engineering. Work closely with product managers to shape requirements, and with developers to ensure designs are implemented faithfully and are technically feasible.

  • Deliver at pace. Prioritise, break large problems into shippable increments and keep momentum across parallel workstreams.

  • Uphold accessibility and quality. Ensure designs meet WCAG 2.2 AA standards and our internal quality bar before handover.

Essential skills and experience

  • Proven track record as a lead UX/UI designer, with a portfolio demonstrating ownership of complex, large-scale digital products.

  • Advanced working knowledge of Sketch, including symbols, libraries and shared styles.

  • Strong prototyping ability - you can move from a rough concept to a testable interactive prototype quickly.

  • Demonstrable experience mentoring or line-managing junior designers.

  • Confident collaborating with product managers, engineers, business stakeholders and, where relevant, clients.

  • Excellent communication skills - you can explain and defend design decisions to non-designers.

Nice to have

title: (Senior) Product Owner | Full Time (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at CONROO GmbH
description_html:
Who Are We ?

🚧 Picture logistics that run like clockwork — fast, smart, and seamless.

Autonomous logistics does not start with self-driving trucks. It starts with CONROO.

At CONROO, we are building an intelligent infrastructure that drives terminals and depots towards autonomy by connecting truck drivers, terminals, and depots through continuous data flows. We replace manual and paper-based processes with real-time, data-driven workflows, turning chaos into connected systems and making truck handling fully digital.

Every step we automate today lays the foundation for terminals and depots to operate autonomously tomorrow.

We are CONROO and we are driving logistics to autonomy.

Tasks

As a (Senior) Product Owner at CONROO, you'll be one of the people steering where our product goes next. You'll spend time with customers and stakeholders to really understand what they need, then turn that into requirements the team can actually build from. You'll work closely with our developers day to day, answering questions, and making calls when priorities need to shift. It's a role with real ownership in the sense that what you decide matters, and you'll see it show up in the product.

🎖 What Success Looks Like

In your first month

  • You become familiar with the company, product, development process, customers, and key business areas and projects.
  • You work closely with Tech, Sales, and other teams to understand customer needs, business objectives, and product priorities.
  • You join Scrum ceremonies and observe how requirements and priorities are managed.
  • You align and guide a cross-functional team. Setting clear priorities, offering direction, and helping people do their best work.

By 3 months

  • You analyse and manage project requirements and stakeholder demands.
  • You independently create, prioritize, and maintain the product backlog based on customer needs and business objectives.
  • You take ownership of user stories, acceptance criteria, and product requirements.
  • You take an active role in Scrum management and coordination.
  • You ensure our product meets UX standards, quality standards, and relevant regulatory requirements.
  • You will communicate product vision, goals, priorities, and progress to internal and external stakeholders.
  • You communicate directly with customers and stakeholders to understand their needs and translate them into actionable requirements.
  • You will have full ownership of assigned projects and topics and manage them with increasing autonomy.

By 6 months

  • You independently manage projects and requirements from initial stage through implementation.
  • You have full ownership of Scrum processes and ensure effective collaboration and communication across teams.
  • You proactively identify customer needs, product opportunities, risks, and areas for improvement.
  • You contribute significantly to product development and prioritisation.
  • You consistently improve project management, requirements management, and quality processes where needed.
  • You operate autonomously while keeping relevant stakeholders aligned and informed.
  • You become the trusted point of contact for product-related topics across Tech, Sales, and other teams.

Requirements

🚀 What You Need to Be Successful

  • You bring 5+ years of experience as a Product Owner in a SaaS environment.
  • You have experience working with SCRUM and agile development processes.
  • You have experience in specifying requirements and developing user and technical stories.
  • You possess a solid understanding of technology, software development, and digital products.
  • You quickly grasp complex processes & technical requirements allowing you to create tailored solutions that deliver value for both clients and the business.
  • You bring strong communication skills and are confident working with a wide range of stakeholders, from C-level executives and internal teams to customers.
  • You bring strong organizational skills and are comfortable managing and prioritizing multiple requirements.
  • You are fluent in both German and English.
  • You are based in Nuremberg, Munich, or the surrounding area and are able to work from our Nuremberg or Munich office at least three days per week.

⚙️ Must Have Tools & Technologies

  • You have experience working with Jira or similar project management tools.
  • You are familiar with Figma or similar design and collaboration tools.
  • You have experience working with CRM systems.

💡It’s a Plus If You Have

  • Previous experience in the logistics industry.
  • Experience working in a startup or scale-up environment.

🌱 How We Set You Up to Be Successful

At CONROO, we don’t just define what success looks like — we actively support you in getting there through a structured, hands-on onboarding process during your first six months with us.

  • Onboarding sessions with your manager and our Head of Product and Engineering Alex, to understand your role, goals, and priorities.
  • Onboarding sessions with our COO, Ksenia and CEO, Felix, to learn about CONROO’s vision, strategy, and business.
  • HR onboarding with our People Partner, Hind, covering our values, tools, policies, and processes.
  • Product onboarding with our Product Owner, Özgür.
  • A buddy system during your first two months to help you onboard smoothly, get up to speed, and have a go-to person for questions.
  • Clear goals for your first 1, 3, and 5 months, with expectations defined from day one so you know how success is measured.
  • We know that starting a new role can be overwhelming. That’s why we provide clear documentation, a structured to-do list, and role-specific materials to help you get up to speed quickly.

Benefits

🌱About Our Team

We’re a team of around 30 curious minds working from our offices in Munich and Nuremberg — and remotely across Germany. We value ownership and a mindset driven by continuous learning. We take ideas seriously, see them through, and aren’t afraid to roll up our sleeves when challenges arise. As we grow, we keep raising the bar, looking for smarter, better ways to work — and have fun in the process together along the way.

🤝Why Us

💫 A mission that matters: Be part of a company that’s working on something meaningful and a purpose you can stand behind.

🏝️ Workation: Switch up your usual scenery and spend up to 30 days working remotely from a different location.

👊 Witness your actions shape our direction: You’re given the ownership and trust to make decisions that matter and the results are visible.

🏔️ Company getaway: Two annual team getaways where we work, unwind, and connect — away from the office. We went to the Austrian Alps last year, where should we go next?

🏢 Multiple office locations: Join us in one of our vibrant offices in Munich, Nuremberg, or Duisburg.

🎟️ Employee discounts: Use our employee discount portal to access attractive deals from top brands across tech, travel, fashion, home, and more — online and in-store.

🌍 International team: With 10 nationalities across a team of around 30 people, you’ll be part of a naturally diverse environment where different perspectives come together.

🧠 Hungry for knowledge? Our monthly S.H.A.R.E sessions teach you something new every month and give you the stage to share your passion & expertise too. If you want to go further, we’re happy to support you with a course, workshop, or other training opportunities.

Our Recruitment Process - simple, quick, and human.

  1. Application review
  2. Introduce yourself in a 30-minute call with our People Partner, Hind
  3. Deep dive into your experience in a 45-minute interview with our Head of Product & Engineering, Alex.
  4. Raise the bar in a case study and a 60-minute interview with our COO, Ksenia, and CEO, Felix, in our Munich office.

💪 Join us and shape the future of logistics.

description_html:
Du schraubst privat gerne an PCs und hast Lust, deine Leidenschaft in den Job einzubringen? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig!

Wir, die spo-comm GmbH, sind die Spezialisten für Mini-PC-Lösungen im Industrie- und Handelsbereich in Deutschland und Europa. Neben starker Hardware bieten wir unseren Kunden maßgeschneiderte Software-, Service- und Logistiklösungen. Zur Unterstützung unserer Montageabteilung suchen wir ab sofort motivierte Verstärkung.

Aufgaben

Das sind deine Aufgaben:

  • Assemblierung: Du übernimmst die Endmontage unserer kompakten Embedded- und Mini-Industrie-PCs.
  • Systemeinrichtung: Du installierst Betriebssysteme und bereitest die Systeme für den Einsatz vor.
  • Logistik: Du verpackst die fertigen Systeme sorgfältig und machst sie bereit für den Versand an unsere Kunden.

Qualifikation

Das bringst du mit:

  • Begeisterung für Technik: Vorkenntnisse sind nicht erforderlich – aber eine gewisse Affinität zu Hardware und PCs hilft dir extrem weiter (ideal für Tüftler und PC-Begeisterte!).
  • Sorgfalt: Du arbeitest zuverlässig und genau.
  • Flexibilität: Du suchst eine Anstellung auf Mini-Job-Basis oder als Werkstudent:in.

Benefits

Was dich bei spo-comm erwartet:

  • Starkes Team: Ein junges, ambitioniertes und kollegiales Team, das mit Begeisterung bei der Sache ist.
  • Moderne Kultur: Ein innovatives Unternehmen mit flachen Hierarchien und kurzen Entscheidungswegen.
  • Gute Atmosphäre: Eine entspannte, lockere Arbeitsumgebung, in der Zusammenarbeit Spaß macht.
  • Echte Flexibilität: Arbeitszeiten, die sich optimal an dein Studium oder deine Freizeit anpassen lassen.

Lust anzupacken?

Dann freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen! Sende uns einfach deine Kurzbewerbung (Lebenslauf reicht völlig aus) an.

title: DevOps Engineer (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at citema systems GmbH
description_html:
Driving Digital Technologies.
Den digitalen Wandel begleiten und aktiv mitgestalten – unsere Mission bei citema. Mit unseren innovativen Ansätzen beraten und unterstützen wir unsere Kunden in den Technologiefeldern Cyber Security, KI und Blockchain. Ebenso gehört die Umsetzung system- und sicherheitsrelevanter Softwareprojekte zu unserem Portfolio. So verbinden wir die neuen Technologien mit der klassischen Softwarewelt. Bei uns wird ein professionelles, kollegiales Miteinander mit Du-Kultur gelebt, denn unser exzellenter Teamgeist und die offene Kommunikation sind der Spirit unseres Unternehmens. Als sehr erfolgreiches und kontinuierlich wachsendes Unternehmen mit solider Basis, bieten wir Dir vielfältige Möglichkeiten in einem hochinteressanten, dynamischen Umfeld. Werde Teil unseres Erfolgs, bring Deine Expertise mit ein und gestalte gemeinsam mit uns die Zukunft verantwortungsvoll.

Aufgaben

Deine Mission
Wir suchen Dich als DevOps Engineer (m/w/d) im Bereich Test für Naval IT Systems am Standort Kiel (hybrid).

Deine Aufgaben dabei sind:

  • Du arbeitest in einem agilen Entwicklungsteam für unsere Systemprodukte im Bereich Marinekommunikation
  • Du betreust unsere entwicklungseigenen HIL-Testsysteme und unterstützt aktiv bei der Einbindung in unsere Test-Automatisierungsstrategie und zugehöriger Test-Prozesse
  • Du unterstützt bei der Administration und dem Ausbau unserer virtualisierten Testumgebungen im Sinne der Testsystem-Strategie, hierbei kannst du dein Wissen über Automatisierung, GitLab Runner und Pipelines demonstrieren

Qualifikation

Dein Profil
Folgende Kenntnisse und Fähigkeiten solltest Du auf jeden Fall mitbringen:

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, Elektro- und Informationstechnik oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung
  • Erfahrung mit Linux Betriebssystemen, gute Python Kenntnisse, sowie Erfahrung mit Virtualisierungssoftware.
  • Erfahrung mit CI/CD Pipelines (GitLab Runner).
  • Die Motivation an der Umsetzung unserer Teststrategie tatkräftig mitzuwirken.
  • Gute Kenntnisse in der Anwendung agiler Methoden wie Scrum
  • Erfahrung mit Versionsverwaltung, vorzugsweise mit GitLab oder GitHub.
  • Selbständige, zielorientierte Arbeitsweise, sowie ein hohes Maß an Teamfähigkeit und offene Kommunikation.
  • Für die effektive Kommunikation im Projektumfeld sowie mit unseren deutschsprachigen Kunden ist ein sehr gutes mündliches und schriftliches Deutsch erforderlich

Benefits

Das bieten wir Dir
Wir sind der Überzeugung, dass folgende Rahmenbedingungen die besten Voraussetzungen für Effizienz und kreative Lösungsfindungen bieten:

  • Aktives Mitwirken an innovativen Zukunftstechnologien
  • Flexibles New-Work-Modell mit hybriden Arbeitsmöglichkeiten
  • Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag
  • Givve-Card als steuerfreier Unternehmensbenefit
  • Maximale Entscheidungs- und Gestaltungsspielräume
  • Individuelle Karriereplanung und Entwicklungsperspektiven
  • Wissenstransfer und Synergieeffekte durch ein starkes Team
  • Technologische Vielfalt mit spannenden Einblicken in sicherheitsrelevante Systeme

Und: Herausforderungen, die wirklich Spaß machen!

Ready to shape the future?

Drive digital technologies with us!

Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung.

description_html:
Das nanacom Kommunikationskollektiv bietet als ganzheitliche Beratungsagentur eine umfassende Betreuung in den Bereichen Public Relations, der Erstellung und Umsetzung von Marketing- und Kommunikationsstrategien sowie Content Creation. Unsere Expertise liegt dabei in der Sport-, Outdoor-, Active-Lifestyle- und Tourismusbranche, in der wir mit führenden Herstellern und Marken zusammenarbeiten.

Du möchtest digitale Kommunikation, Content und Projekte erfolgreich voranbringen? Dann werde Teil unseres Teams als Digital Communications Consultant & Project Manager (w/m/d) in Vollzeit (40 Std./Woche).

Unser Basecamp liegt nahe dem Isartor in München. Die Stelle ist hybrid und remote deutschlandweit besetzbar.

Aufgaben

Social Media & Community Marketing

Du entwickelst Social-Media- und Community-Marketing-Strategien für unsere Kunden aus Sport, Outdoor und Tourismus sowie für unsere eigenen Kommunikationskanäle rund um nanacom, OUTTA und The Female Explorer.

Creator Relations & Kooperationen

Du baust Beziehungen zu Creator:innen, Multiplikator:innen und Communities auf, entwickelst passende Kooperationsansätze und begleitest deren Umsetzung von der Idee bis zur Auswertung.

Projektmanagement & Kampagnensteuerung

Du steuerst Projekte und Kampagnen eigenständig, koordinierst Timings, Abstimmungen und Budgets und sorgst dafür, dass Ideen strukturiert, kreativ und zuverlässig umgesetzt werden.

Content, Trends & Storytelling

Du erkennst relevante Themen, Trends und Plattformdynamiken, übersetzt sie in starke Kommunikationsideen und entwickelst Formate, die Zielgruppen aktivieren und Marken sichtbar machen.

Monitoring, Reporting & Weiterentwicklung

Du analysierst die Performance von Kampagnen, Social-Media-Aktivitäten und Kooperationen, leitest Learnings ab und entwickelst unsere Kommunikationsmaßnahmen kontinuierlich weiter.

Qualifikation

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Social-Media-Plattformen, Analyse-Tools und Reporting-KPIs
  • Erfahrung im Aufbau und in der Pflege von Netzwerken und Partnerschaften mit Creator:innen, Communities oder Markenpartnern
  • Ein bestehendes Netzwerk in relevanten Sport-, Outdoor- oder Lifestyle-Communities ist ein Plus
  • Organisationstalent und Erfahrung in der Steuerung mehrerer Projekte gleichzeitig, inklusive Budget-, Zeit- und Stakeholdermanagement
  • Leidenschaft für Sport, Outdoor, Active Lifestyle oder Tourismus
  • Teamgeist, Eigeninitiative und Beratungskompetenz

Benefits

  • Flexibilität: Vollzeit (40h), hybrides Arbeiten und Remote-Option – deutschlandweit möglich
  • Weiterentwicklung: Coachings, Fortbildungen und individuelle Entwicklungsperspektiven
  • Vertrauen & Eigenverwantwortung: viel Freiraum für eigene Ideen, kurze Entscheidungswege und Arbeiten auf Augenhöhe
  • Vielfältige Projekte: Mitarbeit an Kundenprojekten sowie an eigenen Plattformen und Communities wie OUTTA und The Female Explorer
  • Teamkultur: motiviertes Team, Offsites, sportliche Erlebnisse und Workations
  • Benefits: faire Vergütung, unbefristeter Vertrag und flexible Benefits mit become1

Du möchtest Marken sichtbar machen, Communities aktivieren und Kommunikation strategisch weiterdenken?

Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung inklusive möglichem Starttermin sowie deiner Gehaltsvorstellung.

description_html:
Dich zeichnen als Finanzexperte sowohl analytischer Scharfsinn, strategisches Denken als auch eine ausgeprägte "Hands-on"-Mentalität aus?

Kurz zu uns: FlexPeople® ist auf die branchenübergreifende Vermittlung von Fach- und Führungskräften im kaufmännischen Umfeld spezialisiert. Dabei sind wir Berater aus Leidenschaft: Unser Anspruch ist es, Expertise mit Empathie zu verbinden, wir schauen dabei hinter den CV. Wir hinterfragen, hören zu und wir erkennen Potenziale, die auf dem Papier oft unsichtbar bleiben.

  • Do you enjoy working in an international team, analyzing complex interrelationships, and organizing various projects and topics?
  • Are you looking to work independently and take personal responsibility within a successful team?
  • We are an innovative international consulting firm specializing in the healthcare sector (pharmaceuticals, consumer health & aesthetic medicine).
  • To support our company’s continued growth, we are seeking a motivated International Consultant to join us on a full-time basis.
  • We are a small team working face to face in our Berlin office, together with our Mexico office and our CPC Experts in 20 countries – no remote work.

Tasks

Your responsibilities:

  • Analysis of international commercial and regulatory healthcare topics regarding market entry and market expansion
  • Breakdown of complex situations and to identify solutions
  • Coordination and planning of international client projects
  • Ownership for corporate content and digital strategy (Webpage, LinkedIn, Webinars, ...)

Requirements

What we are looking for:

  • Maybe you have a professional service background from a different industry, project manager or similar
  • Ability to structure complex information clearly and communicate findings effectively
  • Strong Research and problem-solving skills
  • Strong customer Service mindset
  • Willingness to work with international client project responsibilities and deadlines.
  • Proficiency in English is mandatory, Spanish or Portuguese would be an additional plus
  • Good knowledge of MS Office
  • A proactive mindset and willingness to work independently
  • Bachelor’s/Master’s degree with first 1-2 years working experience or practical internships, strong interest in Consulting
  • Your personality is more important than your professional experience – we welcome career changers!

Benefits

What we offer:

  • Responsibility from day one – your work directly contributes to real client projects and decisions
  • Industry insights, Contact with our international clients
  • Possibility to gain experience in different projects like Systematic Market Analysis, Partner Search, Market Entry, M&A, etc.
  • Being able to see your work input in the project’s results
  • A small and international team with flat hierarchies

  • Deutschlandticket

Join our team!

If you are looking for a role where you can learn quickly, take responsibility and work on international healthcare projects, we would be happy to meet you.

Our highly motivated, friendly and international team looks forward to welcoming you at our office in Berlin Kreuzberg.

Interested?

We are looking forward to your application!
