description_html:
About Sidetrade:

Sidetrade (Euronext Growth: ALBFR.PA) is an AI-native company dedicated to Order-to-Cash (O2C). Its platform combines O2C applications, autonomous AI agents, and Aimie IQ, an intelligent natural-language interface that helps multinationals accelerate their cash generation, all built on SAFE, the Sidetrade Agentic Framework for Enterprise. Sidetrade operates the world's largest proprietary O2C Data Lake, built on $9 trillion in B2B transactions and millions of buying companies. We use this data to train specialized AI models that monitor, analyze, decide, and act autonomously throughout the O2C cycle. Sidetrade supports companies in 85 countries with 450 employees across Europe, North America, and Asia-Pacific.

We’re proud of our 38 nationalities, and these diverse perspectives drive our innovation, one-team culture, and customer-first mindset. Sidetrade has been positioned as a Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ Leader since 2022. We value passion over perfection. So, if you’re eager to learn and bring great energy, we want to hear from you. Be you. Grow with us. 

Curious about Sidetrade? Catch Aimie in motion: Aimie Video

Requirements

Today, we're looking for our Global VP of Talent Acquisition to build and lead our Ai-native shift and create the dream team for our next stage of growth. This is both a strategic and hands-on leadership challenge for designing a scalable, data-driven talent acquisition function across all regions in the world (North America, Europe, and APAC), all functions and levels -from AI expert to GTM and from Mid-level to Executives. You'll partner directly with the executive team and hiring managers to ensure we attract, hire, and onboard the talent needed to hit our growth targets, while building a TA function that's efficient, candidate-centric, and built for scale.

Because it’s instrumental to the strategy, this role will report directly to the CEO.

What you would do:

  • Strategy & Leadership: Define and own the global talent acquisition strategy, aligning hiring plans with headcount budgets, business goals, and workforce planning across all regions.
  • Team Management: Build, lead, and develop a high-performing global TA team, including regional leads, recruiters, sourcers, and coordinators; set goals, coach performance, and grow internal talent.
  • Executive & Leadership Hiring: Personally in charge of hiring senior C-level roles with the CEO.
  • Process & Scale: Design and continuously improve AI Agents for recruiting processes, workflows, and SLAs to ensure a consistent, efficient, and high-quality hiring experience.
  • Employer Brand: Own the company's employer brand and candidate value proposition globally; partner with Marketing and Comms to strengthen our reputation as an employer of choice.
  • Data & Metrics: Establish TA metrics and dashboards (time-to-fill, cost-per-hire, quality-of-hire, pipeline conversion, diversity metrics) and use data to drive decisions and report to the executive team and board.
  • Systems & Tools: Own the ATS and recruiting tech stack; evaluate and implement tools (sourcing, assessment, AI-enabled recruiting tools, CRM) to improve efficiency and candidate experience.
  • DEI: Champion diverse and inclusive hiring practices globally, ensuring equitable processes across all regions.
  • Global & Compliance: Ensure hiring practices comply with local labor laws and regulations across all operating countries; manage relationships with external agencies, RPOs, and immigration/visa partners as needed.
  • Budget Ownership: Own the TA budget, including headcount, tooling, agency spend, and employer branding investments.
  • Stakeholder Partnership: Act as a strategic advisor to hiring managers and executives on org design, market talent trends, compensation benchmarking, and hiring strategy.

 What we are looking for:

  • 10+ years in talent acquisition, with 5+ years in a senior TA leadership role (VP, Head of TA, or similar) at a SaaS or high-growth AI company.
  • Proven experience building and scaling global TA functions across multiple countries/regions (US, Europe)
  • Track record of personally hiring C-Levels
  • Experience operating in a mid-size, fast-growing company environment
  • Hands-on, roll-up-your-sleeves approach balanced with strategic, big-picture thinking.
  • Experience managing distributed, cross-cultural teams.
  • Natural ability to convince and motivate C-Level candidates to join our AI strategy.
  • Strong analytical mindset; comfortable building and presenting TA metrics and forecasts to executive leadership and the board.
  • Deep knowledge of modern sourcing strategies, employer branding, and recruiting technology (AI Recruiter Agents, ATS, CRM).
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills; able to influence and partner with senior executives.
  • Strong understanding of global employment law and compliance considerations related to hiring.

Because when you thrive, we all succeed! 

We’re committed to providing a welcoming and inclusive experience for every candidate If you need any accommodation during the hiring process, just let us know. 

Agencies 

We only accept applications from invited agencies via our Workable portal. Unsolicited CVs sent to managers or HR won’t be subject to fees.

title: Senior PR Manager (m/w/d) - Freelance
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at getpress
description_html:
Overview

PR steht vor einem strukturellen Bruch. Vertrauen verschiebt sich, Sichtbarkeit wird neu verteilt, KI wächst exponentiell. Wir bei getpress glauben, dass Reputation in den nächsten zehn Jahren der entscheidende Wettbewerbsvorsprung für Unternehmen wird. Und dass die Agentur, die das ernst nimmt, anders aussehen muss als die Agentur von gestern.

Deshalb bauen wir die PR Company der Zukunft. Outcome-getrieben statt Retainer-Stunden. KI-first statt KI-on-top. Automatisiert, wo es skaliert und menschlich, wo es wirklich zählt. Unser über 40 köpfiges Team aus Journalist*innenund PR-Strateg*innen hat seit 2017 die PR für 450+ der spannendsten Wachstumsunternehmen Europas gesteuert – und hat Hunger auf mehr.

Für Phasen, in denen unser Pipeline-Tempo schneller ist als unsere Teamgröße, bauen wir uns einen festen Pool erfahrener Freelancer*innen auf. Bist du dabei?

Deine Rolle

  • Verstärkung im Team, nicht allein auf Distanz: Du arbeitest gemeinsam mit dem zuständigen PR-Team an einem oder mehreren Mandaten, nicht isoliert für dich allein. Die Kundenkommunikation läuft über das Team, mit dem du regelmäßig im Kontakt stehst und dich austauscht.
  • Klare Ziele, eigenständige Umsetzung: Team und Kunde geben Ziele und die Zielmedienliste vor – wie du deinen Teil einbringst, entscheidest du. Du entwickelst Storys, pitchst Journalist*innen und bringst dich aktiv ins Team ein.
  • Skalierbar für dich: Ein Pilotprojekt ist der Einstieg. Läuft die Zusammenarbeit für beide Seiten gut, begleitest du je nach Bedarf und deiner Kapazität gerne auch weitere Mandate parallel.

Wer du bist

  • Mehrjährige, wirklich eigenständige PR- oder journalistische Erfahrung.
  • Du bringst ein aktives, belastbares Netzwerk zu Journalist*innen mit, keine Kontaktliste aus der Vergangenheit, sondern Redaktionen, mit denen du heute noch sprichst.
  • Du deckst mindestens eine unserer Kern-Verticals ab (z. B. VC, Mobility, Cleantech, HealthTech) und weißt, wie die jeweilige Medienlandschaft tickt.
  • Du bist mit ergebnisbasierter Vergütung vertraut oder offen dafür.
  • Du sprichst Deutsch auf C2-Niveau, kannst auch auf Englisch professionell kommunizieren.

Was dich erwartet

  • Klare Konditionen von Anfang an: Du bekommst einen Rahmenvertrag mit transparenter Umsatzbeteiligung – wir legen Zahlen offen auf den Tisch, nicht erst im dritten Gespräch.
  • Kein Vertrag ohne Mandat: Die Unterschrift des Rahmenvertrags verpflichtet dich zu nichts. Erst wenn wir ein passendes Mandat für dich haben, sprechen wir konkret über Kunde, Ziele und Zielmedien – und du entscheidest, ob es passt.
  • Unkomplizierte Zusammenarbeit: Kein Mikromanagement. Ein Kick-off und danach je nach Bedarf regelmäßigen Austausch mit dem Team – so, wie es für euch beide funktioniert.

Wie gehts weiter?

Wenn du jetzt denkst: „Klingt nach spannend!", dann melde dich bei uns , ganz ohne klassisches Anschreiben. Wir sprechen offen über Themen, Netzwerk und Konditionen, damit für beide Seiten schnell klar ist, ob es passt.

description_html:
About Andercore

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials for energy, infrastructure, and construction in wholesale and beyond.

We trade with global suppliers and distribute to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade and distribution end-to-end: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, and embedded financing. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier; for our partners, it is the most convenient and safe way to do business across borders. Behind it, our software and agentic AI do the heavy lifting that used to take an asset-intensive supply chain with four or five intermediaries and weeks of manual coordination.

Where we are today:

  • Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover

  • Seven European markets live

  • 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), offices in London, Mumbai, and Shanghai

$40M Series B just closed, $75M raised to date from Atomico, Project A, and Inven Capital, institutional financing from international banks.

We are building the world's first and last industrial-grade AI operating system for materials, redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth.

What You’ll Do

Dive in as the strategic force behind our post-sales customer journey, transforming satisfaction into a powerful engine for growth. As a key player in a nimble, high-impact team, you'll own the customer experience for the DACH market, shaping processes and driving initiatives that directly enhance customer lifetime value and accelerate our market expansion.

  • Architect and implement a best-in-class post-sales strategy for the DACH market, serving as the expert for all customer-related initiatives and elevating their lifetime value.

  • Proactively identify and resolve complex customer challenges, utilizing creative problem-solving to ensure customer satisfaction while leveraging insights to drive improvements.

  • Design, champion, and operationalize highly scalable processes that enhance customer experience, working in tandem with other internal teams to ensure operational excellence.

  • Manage end-to-end post-sales journeys, including onboarding, claims handling, and delivery issues, to ensure the successful resolution of customer queries, whether large or small.

  • Drive critical cross-functional alignment with Tech, Logistics, and other departments, ensuring customer insights directly inform roadmaps.

  • Execute high-touch, multi-channel communication, engaging directly with customers via phone and email to resolve inquiries and provide a premium support experience.

Who You Are

You're a hands-on and execution-driven individual contributor with a proven track record of shaping outcomes in fast-paced environments. As a vital member of a small team, you're ready to make a significant impact on our customer success architecture and contribute directly to our disruptive mission in the DACH market.

  • You are enrolled in a university or have recently graduated and you are looking to gain work experience in a fast paced venture backed environment (minimum 6 months).

  • Deeply curious and passionately aligned with the vision of hyper-growth startups, eager to contribute to scaling.

  • You are motivated and passionate about new ideas and possess a creative solution oriented mindset.

  • Excellent analytical and communication skills in German and English. C1 German is required for this role.

We are an equal-opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, or any other characteristic. We believe that diversity drives innovation, creativity, and collective strength.

description_html:
Who we are

Melotech is revolutionizing media and entertainment. We create art through technology for humans to enjoy. In just 24 months, our work has been heard, watched and loved for over 3 billion minutes worldwide.

Founded by entrepreneur and investor Soheil Mirpour, we are backed by top VCs Cherry Ventures, Speedinvest and GFC, alongside world-class angels from firms such as Spotify, Blackstone and KKR.

What you will do

Everything we ship runs on data, and the systems that collect, move and store that data need an owner. As Backend Engineer - Data & Orchestration, you take a data platform that grew fast and turn it into one system the whole company can rely on. You keep it running, you keep it clean, and you make it simpler every month. This is not a pure ETL or warehouse role: you work across the pipelines and the backend services they depend on. We will walk you through exactly what we are building as you go through the process. On a typical day, your tasks may include:

  • Data collection: keeping our scrapers and platform integrations running across flaky sources, rate limits, anti-bot measures and APIs that change overnight

  • Pipelines and storage: owning our event-driven pipelines end to end, from orchestration (Airflow, Dagster or similar) to databases and warehouses, built to survive failures and to keep costs in check

  • Monitoring and reliability: building the monitoring and alerting (Datadog or similar) that keeps our services and integrations healthy, and the checks on freshness, volume, schema and values that catch a wrong number before anyone downstream notices

  • Backend services: working on the production services and APIs our data flows through, including our JavaScript backends

  • Infrastructure and security: owning CI/CD, infrastructure as code and cloud for our data systems, plus access and secrets: who and what can reach which system, including AI tools

  • Simplification: consolidating what grew fast into one documented system, and removing what is no longer needed

  • Working across the team: explaining what the data can and cannot do to non-technical colleagues, and guiding junior engineers as the team grows

Who you are

We are looking for an engineer who runs what they build, and builds things that keep running. You have operated real production systems in a small, fast-moving company, and people trust you with them.

Typically, your profile will look like this:

  • Experience: 3 to 10 years of hands-on engineering, most of it in small or fast-growing companies where you owned production systems yourself rather than handing them to a platform team

  • Python and backend: advanced Python, including async code and long-running data jobs, and enough backend experience to work on production services and APIs, including basic JavaScript or TypeScript backends

  • Scraping and data acquisition: you have kept unreliable external sources running in production (scrapers, platform APIs, unofficial endpoints) and you know how to handle proxies, rate limits and anti-bot measures; using LLMs to extract data from messy sources is a plus

  • Pipelines and storage: you have designed and run event-driven, fault-tolerant pipelines handling millions of records a day, with Airflow, Dagster or task queues, on databases such as Postgres, ClickHouse, MongoDB or Redshift, and you know what they cost to run

  • Data reliability and monitoring: your systems report their own problems through freshness, volume, schema and value checks, and you use Datadog or an equivalent to keep services and integrations reliable, because a wrong number that nobody noticed is the outcome you design against

  • Infrastructure and security: you are comfortable with Docker, Terraform, CI/CD and cloud, and ideally you have run an access review and set up role-based access and secrets management

  • Ownership and communication: you have owned a messy data setup end to end at a smaller company and left it simpler, documented and maintainable; you explain trade-offs to non-technical colleagues, push back when it matters, and have guided junior engineers or led a small team

  • Engineering fundamentals: you learned to build solid systems before AI coding tools were everywhere, and today you use them to go faster, not to replace that judgment; you ship fast, keep the codebase clean, and take the time to understand the context before you build

  • Pace: you thrive in a fast-paced and performance-oriented environment

What makes this exciting

Our data systems feed everything the company does, and you own them outright. You are not maintaining someone else's legacy: you decide how these systems should work and you make them work that way. You're not a cog in the machine but the captain of your own ship, rewarded for performance and respected for leadership. Flat hierarchies mean that your voice matters, your ideas get implemented, and your impact is immediate.

We pay competitive salaries and make you an owner of the business with equity. We work remotely to give you complete freedom over your life, while meeting regularly around the world for global offsites where we strategize, bond, and push boundaries together.

What the process will look like

We hire on a rolling basis. Earliest starting date is always ASAP.

Once you begin our process, you can progress from start to offer within a week, depending on how quickly you can move through each stage:

  1. Initial interview: 30-minute introductory call - getting to know you

  2. Case interview: 90-minute case discussion - present and debate your skills

  3. Founder interview: 90-minute interview with our CEO - going deep on all topics

  4. Offer, contract signing and onboarding

Note: As we are still in stealth, you will learn more about Melotech as you progress through the stages. By the end of the Founder interview, you will have a full grasp of our business and the details of your role.

title: Controls Systems Engineer (f/m/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Focused
description_html:
About Focused Energy

Focused Energy is an international deep-tech company based in Germany and the US, working to commercialize laser-driven nuclear fusion. Our mission is to provide clean, safe, and virtually unlimited energy to the world. We are rapidly scaling and looking for talented individuals who thrive in building clarity and structure within fast-growing environments.

Join us as a Control Systems Engineer and help to provide the clean energy of the future. In this role, you will lead the design and delivery of critical control systems across our experimental and production environments in Germany and the USA, and work closely with a passionate, cross‑functional team.

About the Role

You will report to the Controls Engineering Lead and join a small, collaborative team of 3–5 engineers. The role is hybrid, with the expectation of occasional travel to our Austin, TX site. Working hours follow standard business schedules, and on-call needs are minimal and largely confined to regular working hours.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead the design and development of PLC-based control subsystems, supporting cutting-edge laser fusion technologies, and work in collaboration with scientists and engineers to gather requirements and iterate solutions.

  • Own the integration and control systems for critical experiment support infrastructure such as vacuum, pneumatics, and cooling plant.

  • Develop control software for modern PLCs such as Beckhoff TwinCAT in Structured Text (IEC 61131-3) for machine safety and process control systems.

  • Commission complex experimental equipment together with scientists and engineers, including field debugging and systematic fault-finding of cutting-edge technology.

  • Specify and implement SCADA systems and HMIs, including alarms, logging, data acquisition, and database integration.

  • Contribute to team standards and solution architecture, and mentor junior engineers through design reviews and guidance.

Who You Are

  • Degree in Electrical/Electronic Engineering, Control/Automation, Mechatronics/Robotics, Physics or similar, with a focus on PLC-based control, embedded or real‑time systems.

  • 5+ years in plant control systems, factory automation, embedded software, or complex scientific experimental work with significant PLC-based elements.

  • Proficient in PLC programming in Structured Text (IEC 61131-3) following good software engineering practice, including modularization, version control (e.g. Git), and unit testing.

  • Knowledge of SCADA systems (e.g. Ignition, EPICS, Tango, WinCC, FactoryTalk, AVEVA) and hands-on experience of delivering HMIs to stakeholders, including alarm and error handling, status and data visualization.

  • Proficient in reading electrical wiring diagrams and P&IDs, collaborating with electrical and mechanical engineering teams to deliver physical systems.

  • Familiarity with industrial networking and fieldbus protocols such as EtherCAT, OPC UA, and Modbus TCP.

  • Familiarity with risk assessment processes and relevant safety standards (e.g. ISA 84, IEC 61508).

  • Clear communicator in English, comfortable working in hybrid and international cross-site teams, self-organized and proactive, comfortable leading technical discussions and decisions.

  • Practical, hands-on approach with proven experience in hardware/software integration, and a strong track record in debugging and fault-finding on real systems.

Desirable Skills and Knowledge (be sure to highlight any of the following in your application):

  • Beckhoff PLCs and TwinCAT.

  • DDS (Data Distribution Service) protocol, related tools and utilities.

  • OPC UA protocol, related tools and utilities.

  • Design of vacuum control systems.

  • Designing control cabinet hardware to EU standards (IEC 60204 -1).

  • Safety-critical systems design: safety relays, SIL determination, LOPA, risk assessment.

  • Proficiency in at least one higher-level language (LabVIEW, Python, MATLAB/Simulink, C/C++).

  • Higher LabVIEW qualifications (CLD, CLED, CLA) and NI hardware experience (PXIe, cRIO).

  • Other non-PLC embedded or real-time systems (FPGAs, RTOS, microcontrollers, robotics).

  • Experience working on complex scientific equipment or large-scale research facilities.

  • Image processing and machine vision, motion control and robotics.

 


Focused Energy is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive environment. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Focused Energy will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, benefits.

title: Mechanical Engineer – Design & Simulation (f/m/d)

description_html:
About Focused Energy

Focused Energy is an international deep-tech company based in Germany and the US, working to commercialize laser-driven nuclear fusion. Our mission is to provide clean, safe, and virtually unlimited energy to the world. We are rapidly scaling and looking for talented individuals who thrive in building clarity and structure within fast-growing environments.

About the Role

As a Mechanical Engineer – Design & Simulation, you’ll perform engineering analysis and simulation work across Focused Energy projects, helping design and validate complex mechanical systems before hardware is committed. You’ll provide the analytical confidence needed to make sound design decisions across structural, thermal, dynamic, and fluid-system performance.

Working closely with senior mechanical engineers, systems engineers, project teams, and other engineering disciplines, you’ll use modelling and simulation to identify design risks early, recommend mitigations, and ensure mechanical designs are technically sound, manufacturable, safe, and ready for integration. Your work will contribute to systems including vacuum chambers, laser integration, diagnostic structures, and facility infrastructure.

What You’ll Do

  • Perform structural, mechanical, and thermal analysis using FEA tools such as ANSYS, Abaqus, COMSOL, or equivalent.

  • Carry out fluid-system analysis and thermal modelling to support mechanical design decisions.

  • Assess vibration, stability, and dynamic behaviour of mechanical assemblies and identify potential design risks.

  • Validate simulation outputs against design requirements, engineering standards, and expected operating conditions.

  • Translate analysis results into practical design recommendations that improve performance, safety, manufacturability, and system compatibility.

  • Develop and maintain 3D CAD models and engineering drawings using Autodesk Inventor or a similar tool.

  • Define and execute verification activities, prepare analysis reports, and provide simulation evidence for design reviews.

  • Collaborate with mechanical, systems, and project engineering teams to define interfaces, communicate results, and support multidisciplinary design decisions.

Who You Are

  • You are an analytical and technically rigorous mechanical engineer who enjoys solving complex engineering problems through modelling and simulation.

  • You take a methodical approach to setting up analyses, checking assumptions, interpreting results, and documenting conclusions.

  • You can translate complex simulation outputs into clear, actionable engineering decisions.

  • You identify design risks early and proactively propose practical mitigation strategies.

  • You communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, adapting the level of detail to the audience.

  • You collaborate effectively across mechanical, systems, and project engineering disciplines.

  • You take ownership of the quality, traceability, and accuracy of your analysis work and design evidence.

  • You are detail-oriented and committed to applying sound engineering fundamentals and standards consistently.

Desirable Skills & Knowledge

  • Experience performing structural, thermal, dynamic, and fluid-system analysis in a professional mechanical engineering environment.

  • Proficiency with FEA tools such as ANSYS, Abaqus, COMSOL, or equivalent, together with experience validating and documenting simulation results.

  • Experience with 3D CAD tools, preferably Autodesk Inventor, and the ability to connect analysis outputs with practical mechanical design decisions.

  • Knowledge of CFD tools such as ANSYS Fluent or OpenFOAM, vacuum or cryogenic mechanical systems, laser or optical integration, or scientific instrumentation.

  • Familiarity with design for manufacture and assembly (DFMA), prototype build and commissioning support, verification planning, and engineering documentation in experimental or multidisciplinary environments.

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.

title: Senior Software Engineer (f/m/d)

description_html:
About Focused Energy

Focused Energy is a pioneering international deep-tech company with locations in Germany and the US, dedicated to commercializing laser-driven nuclear fusion. Our mission is to deliver clean, safe, and virtually limitless energy to the world. As we rapidly scale, we seek talented individuals who thrive on bringing clarity and structure to fast-growing environments.

About the Role

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be the primary software point of contact for the Laser team and provide technical leadership across software, hardware, and experimental-system interfaces. You will help define the architecture and technology direction for a greenfield laser-software platform while remaining hands-on in developing reliable tools for calibration, operation, human-machine interaction, and experimental data processing.

This role offers the opportunity to work across software, hardware, and experimental-system boundaries while contributing to a strong engineering culture within the Darmstadt Software Department. You will help shape technical direction, establish the foundations of a new software platform, and grow toward a broader technical leadership role. The position does not initially include direct people-management responsibility.

What You’ll Do

  • Act as the primary software partner for the Laser team and coordinate software activities across laser projects.

  • Provide technical leadership for software initiatives, including planning, technical alignment, risk identification, and coordination with laser physicists, engineers, and systems-integration partners.

  • Help define the architecture, technology choices, development practices, and interfaces for a new laser-software platform in a greenfield environment.

  • Design and implement reliable software for critical laser projects, from system-level interfaces to user-facing applications.

  • Develop and maintain automated calibration software that improves repeatability, reduces manual effort, and supports reliable laser operation.

  • Design and build clear, dependable human-machine interfaces, dashboards, and operational tools for monitoring and operating laser systems.

  • Develop software that interfaces with laser devices, diagnostic systems, cameras, and experimental equipment to support data acquisition, system monitoring, operational control, and visualization.

  • Develop data-processing pipelines and data-storage solutions for experimental and operational data, including diagnostic and camera data where appropriate.

  • Define robust interfaces between software, hardware, cameras, and experimental systems in an environment where requirements and technologies are still evolving.

  • Work with networked device and system interfaces, potentially including TCP/IP, REST APIs, webhooks, DDS, SCADA, or comparable communication technologies.

  • Write automated tests, technical documentation, and operational guidance to support long-term maintainability and safe, reliable operation.

  • Identify and address reliability, performance, integration, debugging, and maintenance risks in software that interacts with real-world systems.

  • Contribute to technical design discussions, code reviews, and knowledge sharing across the Software Department.

  • Mentor engineers and help establish engineering practices as the software team grows.

Who You Are

  • You are an experienced software engineer who enjoys solving complex, ambiguous technical problems and building systems from the ground up.

  • You are comfortable taking ownership of technical direction while collaborating closely with software specialists, laser physicists, experimental experts, and systems-integration partners.

  • You can move effectively between technical leadership, project coordination, architecture, and hands-on implementation.

  • You take ownership of the quality, reliability, testability, and long-term maintainability of the systems you build.

  • You communicate clearly with both software specialists and technical partners from adjacent disciplines.

  • You apply sound technical judgment when making design, implementation, and technology-selection decisions in an evolving environment.

  • You are curious, adaptable, and motivated to understand how software interacts with hardware, cameras, diagnostics, and experimental systems.

  • You are experienced in debugging and testing complex software and understand their importance in senior-level engineering work.

  • You value constructive feedback, knowledge sharing, and mentoring other engineers.

  • You are interested in developing toward technical leadership and project ownership. Formal people-management responsibility is not required at the outset.

Desirable Skills & Knowledge

  • Strong programming experience in C++, Python, or comparable programming languages.

  • Experience designing, implementing, testing, debugging, and maintaining complex software systems.

  • Knowledge of software architecture, code review practices, automated testing, technical documentation, and engineering best practices.

  • Experience with greenfield development, platform or architecture definition, and making technology choices where requirements are still evolving.

  • Experience with automated calibration, control-adjacent software, laboratory systems, automation, or physical-device interfaces.

  • Experience developing human-machine interfaces, dashboards, or software for operating technical equipment.

  • Experience with camera integration, image processing, diagnostic data, or experimental data-processing pipelines.

  • Experience developing data-storage solutions for high-volume, time-series, experimental, or operational data.

  • Familiarity with software-hardware integration and working across experimental-system boundaries.

  • Experience with networked device communication or system interfaces, such as TCP/IP, REST APIs, webhooks, DDS, SCADA, or comparable technologies.

  • Familiarity with control systems or optics is beneficial, but not required; the ability to learn and collaborate across these disciplines is more important.

  • Previous experience mentoring engineers or leading technical design discussions.

description_html:
About Focused Energy

Focused Energy is an international deep-tech company based in Germany and the US, working to commercialize laser-driven nuclear fusion. Our mission is to provide clean, safe, and virtually unlimited energy to the world. We are rapidly scaling and looking for talented individuals who thrive in building clarity and structure within fast-growing environments.

Your Role

As our Legal Operations Specialist, you will build and run the operational backbone of Focused Energy’s growing Legal function. You will own the systems, processes, records, and calendars that enable our lawyers to focus on high-value legal work across Corporate, Commercial, IP, and Compliance.

You will have broad ownership and the opportunity to build legal operations from the ground up — from corporate entity administration and contract lifecycle management to IP docketing, compliance records, workflow design, and automation. You will work independently across German and US corporate structures and become a trusted operational partner to the VP Legal and the wider Legal team.

What you’ll do

  • Build and own the legal operations backbone for a growing international company — creating reliable systems, processes, and standards that make a visible difference every day.

  • Take end-to-end responsibility for corporate administration across our German and US entities, including registers, minute books, cap tables, powers of attorney, filings, restructurings, and notarial processes.

  • Lead the contract lifecycle from signature to renewal, managing CLM and e-signature workflows, keeping agreements accessible, and ensuring no important deadline is missed.

  • Create structure across IP and Compliance, maintaining patent and trademark docketing, IP registers, compliance records, policy documentation, and key legal calendars.

  • Turn recurring legal work into scalable processes by mapping workflows, developing templates, introducing automation, and selecting tools that reduce manual effort for the whole Legal team.

  • Work directly with decision-makers and external partners, including the VP Legal, specialist counsel, Finance, notaries, registry offices, and external IP advisers.

  • Spot what needs to be done and make it happen — proactively identifying gaps, managing risks, and improving how Legal operates without waiting for instructions.

Who You Are

  • You have extensive experience in legal operations, corporate administration, paralegal work, entity management, or a comparable role.

  • You understand German corporate formalities and ideally have exposure to US corporate administration.

  • You are organised, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing records, deadlines, and recurring processes.

  • You have experience with contract management, e-signature, document management, or legal operations tools.

  • You work independently, improve processes, and know when to escalate matters requiring legal judgement.

  • You communicate clearly and proactively and are fluent in German and English.

Nice to Have

  • Background as a Rechtsfachwirt/in, Paralegal, or legal operations specialist.

  • Experience with CLM, entity management, e-signature, or workflow automation tools.

  • Experience in a fast-growing international company or across German and US legal environments.


Why Work with Us

  • Innovative Technology & Mission: Be part of a cutting-edge company working on groundbreaking research in clean energy and scientific discovery.

  • Career Development: We invest in our people. This is an opportunity to join an early, growing company at the forefront of new technology, where you’ll have the opportunity to develop and grow your career.

title: Interim Staff Systems Engineer - IT & Infrastructure (d/f/m)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Taxfix
description_html:
Our story:

Every year millions of people are either filing their taxes in fear or giving up on their tax refund altogether. We're working on fixing that. Our intuitive app enables anyone, regardless of education or background, to file their taxes with newfound confidence.

 

Spread across Germany, Spain and the UK, the team at Taxfix Group with its brands Taxfix and Steuerbot, is a compassionate group of solution-finders. We speak our minds openly, and with over 400 professionals, including tax experts, developers, and IT security experts, we're rich in ideas and voices. The group has facilitated more than 3.5 billion euros in tax refunds for its customers since its founding in 2016.

 

The opportunity (Interim/Freelance basis):

As our Staff Systems Engineer within the IT & Infrastructure team, you'll be responsible for keeping the enterprise systems that power Taxfix running reliably, securely, and intelligently — from cloud infrastructure and identity management to network, device, and application performance. Reporting to our Director of IT & Infrastructure, and collaborating closely with cross-functional stakeholders across the business, you'll architect and operate the backbone that enables every team at Taxfix to do their best work. In a company that moves fast and thinks big, you'll be the person who makes sure the foundation never wobbles.

This is an interim position on a freelance basis.

 
 

Your responsibilities:

  • Maintain and operate enterprise cloud infrastructure that serves employees and internal systems, ensuring high availability, performance, and security at all times.

  • Lead and evolve identity management across the enterprise — including platform management and Okta — developing concepts and processes to govern both human and agentic identities in a scalable, secure way.

  • Support the integration of new tools and systems based on business requirements, owning the technical evaluation, onboarding, and configuration end to end.

  • Ensure enterprise systems remain up to date, with security configurations, patches, and compliance standards consistently applied across the board.

  • Maintain security backups and redundancies for enterprise infrastructure, proactively identifying and closing gaps before they become incidents.

  • Manage and improve network, device management, and systems, keeping the environment stable, modern, and fit for a growing, hybrid workforce.

  • Develop automations, AI-powered and agentic solutions, and scripts that reduce manual toil and improve the efficiency of infrastructure maintenance.

  • Provide third-level support for cloud applications, acting as the deepest technical escalation point for complex issues and enablement of internal app deployment.

  • Collaborate with SRE and platform engineering to assess risk, develop guardrails, and resolve incidents together with application owners.

  • Collaborate with the Director of IT to continuously improve the enterprise architecture and infrastructure landscape, contributing strategic thinking alongside hands-on execution.

  • Own performance tuning of application stacks, including communication and messaging between applications, load management, and components such as Apache and Ruby.

 
 

Your profile

  • You bring strong, hands-on experience in enterprise cloud administration — ideally with GCP — and know how to design, operate, and scale cloud environments that real businesses depend on.

  • You have solid practical experience with Kubernetes, containerisation, and virtualisation technologies such as Docker and VMware, and you're comfortable navigating complex, layered infrastructure.

  • Your networking knowledge is deep and grounded — TCP/IP and related protocols are second nature to you, and you can diagnose and resolve network issues with confidence.

  • You implement best practices for network security and governance, ensuring that access, segmentation, and policy controls are consistently applied and continuously improved.

  • You're proficient in at least one scripting or programming language such as Python or shell, and you use code as a tool to make infrastructure smarter and more maintainable.

  • You have hands-on experience configuring and troubleshooting Google Workspace and Linux environments, and you know how to keep them healthy and secure.

  • You've set up and improved monitoring and visualisation systems, and you understand how good observability translates into faster incident response and better decision-making.

  • A background in engineering or computer science is a plus — what matters most is that you bring structured thinking and hands-on experience to make systems work together.

 
 

Why Taxfix?

  • A chance to do meaningful, people-centric work with an international team of passionate professionals.

  • Holistic well-being with free mental health coaching sessions.

  • A monthly allowance to spend on an extensive range of services that you can use and roll over as flexibly as you like.

  • Employee stock options for all employees—because everyone deserves to benefit from the success they help to create.

  • 30 annual vacation days and flexible working hours.

  • A generous learning budget to support your personal and professional development and guidance from our internal L&D experts.

  • Work from abroad for up to six weeks every year. Just align with your team, and then enjoy your trip.

  • Plenty of opportunities to socialise as a team. In addition to internal meetups, our international team hosts regular get-togethers—virtually and in person when possible.

  • Free tax declaration filing, of course, through the Taxfix app—and internal support for all personal tax-related questions.

  • Have a four-legged friend in your life? We’re happy to have dogs join us in the office.


Excited? So are we. Learn more about Team Taxfix on our blog and get a glimpse of our culture.

 

At Taxfix, we believe that incredible things happen when you have a wealth of perspectives and experiences. We're proudly committed to equal employment and development opportunities no matter your gender, race, religion, age, sexual orientation, colour, disability, or place of origin. To help mitigate any potential unconscious biases, we ask that you refrain from including your picture, age, or marital status on your CV. Let your experiences speak for themselves.

 

Not sure if you meet all the requirements for this role? Please apply anyway. You might bring something special to the team that we hadn't considered previously.

Please note: This role is offered on an interim/freelance basis.

description_html:
Job Title: Project Manager - Software Implementation (m/f/x) 

Location: EU

(Remote) 

 

Who You’ll Work For: 

 

At Makersite, we're pioneering the future of sustainable product development and digital collaboration. As a leading platform for product lifecycle management (PLM), we empower companies to make smarter, more sustainable decisions across their entire supply chain. Our cutting-edge software enables teams to design, prototype, and manufacture with transparency, efficiency, and responsibility—reducing environmental impact while optimizing performance. 

We're a fast-growing, innovative company that thrives on creativity, collaboration, and continuous learning. If you're passionate about technology, sustainability, and creating meaningful impact, we’d love to hear from you. Join us and be a part of shaping the future of manufacturing and product innovation. 

 

Who we're looking for: 

 

As part of our growing team, you will play a key role in shaping the future of sustainable product development. We’re looking for innovative, driven Project Managers who are passionate about technology and sustainability to join us in building tools that enable companies to make smarter, more responsible decisions. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to collaborate with talented professionals, contribute to cutting-edge projects, and help drive the digital transformation of industries worldwide. If you're ready to make an impact and contribute to meaningful change, we want to hear from you! 

This role is a fixed, permanent position. All successful applicants will receive a permanent employment contract regardless of location.  

 

The role:

  

  • Lead the planning and implementation of software projects related to system connections with our customers, ensuring they are delivered on time and within scope. 

  • Maintain and update project plans, proactively identifying and managing any project risks. 

  • Ensure the availability of the right expertise for each project phase, coordinating with internal and external resources as necessary. 

  • Manage stakeholder expectations, delivering regular and comprehensive project updates and effectively resolving any arising issues. 

  • Contribute to the standardization of project implementation methodology and project templates to improve project standardization and efficiency. 

  • Generate thorough Project/Solution Documentation, outlining project goals, deliverables, and timelines. 

  • Handle all customer communication across various projects, ensuring clear, consistent, and timely communication with all stakeholders. 


  • Master's degree in project management or related technical field required. 

  • Background in Electronics/Electricals

  • Professional Project Management Certification from an accredited institution preferred. 

  • Demonstrated understanding of Project Management processes, strategies, and methods 

  • Excellent time management and organizational skills and experience establishing guidelines in these areas for others. 

  • 3+ years of Project management experience in the field of software implementations 

  • Experience with complex data projects where a systematic approach is crucial to success. 

  • Dexterity with software tools and data manipulation & analysis 

  • A creative mind that can think outside the box. 

  • Curiosity to find disruptive as opposed to incremental solutions to challenging data problems. 

  • Residing in and legally permitted to work in the EU. 

 

What We Offer: 

 

  • Competitive Salary – We reward your skills and experience with a compensation package that reflects your value. 

  • 30 Days Paid Time Off – Take the time you need to recharge and maintain a healthy work-life balance. 

  • Remote-First Flexibility – Work from anywhere in the EU, with the option to collaborate in person at our offices in Stuttgart, Berlin (role dependent). 

  • Generous Learning & Development Budget – We invest in your growth, providing ample resources for personal and professional development. 

  • Choose Your Ideal Work Equipment – Whether you prefer Apple or Microsoft, we’ll equip you with the tools you need to excel. 

 

The Experience: 

 

  • Purpose-Driven Work – Build something meaningful. Here, you’re not just creating another app; you’re contributing to a transformative vision that you can be proud of. 

  • Great Colleagues – Join a team that’s open, transparent, and international. We value inclusivity and foster a culture of collaboration and mutual respect. 

  • Work-Life Balance – As a remote-first company, we trust you to do your best work, your way. You have the flexibility to work when it suits you, ensuring a healthy balance between personal and professional life. 

  • Pride in Impact – We're already making a significant difference with global, well-known customers who share our vision. Be part of something that matters. 

  • Stability with Ambition – With realistic growth plans, we’re committed to changing the way things are made—without sacrificing our ambitious goals for innovation and impact. 

If you want to find out more about what it’s like to work at Makersite, check out our Careers Page here 

  

Diversity and Inclusion 

If you have a medical condition or an individual need for an adjustment to our process, and you believe this may affect your ability to be at your best – please let us know so we can talk about how we can best support you and make any adjustments that may be needed.  

 

At Makersite, we are dedicated to fostering an environment that champions diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging. We believe that diverse teams drive innovation and success, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and will consider all applications regardless of age, disability, gender identity, marital status, pregnancy or maternity, race, nationality, religion, sex, sexual orientation, or any other status protected by applicable law. Rest assured, all applications will be handled with the utmost confidentiality.

description_html:
GeneralMind builds AI Systems of Action for complex enterprise workflows. We deploy AI employees that automate messy operational handovers across supply chains - processing orders, validating invoices, coordinating suppliers, and handling exceptions directly on top of enterprise systems like SAP, Oracle, JDE, and Dynamics.

Our platform combines AI agents, operational context graphs, and real transaction data to achieve Autopilot-grade automation in real operational environments. We work closely with leading global companies across manufacturing, retail, and logistics to deploy AI into mission-critical workflows.

Tasks

  • Design, build, and evolve production-grade full-stack applications using Python (FastAPI) and React (Next.js).
  • Architect and develop next-generation interfaces for our Systems of Action, enabling seamless human-in-the-loop interactions and complex data visualization.
  • Build durable backend workflow systems using tools like Temporal to support asynchronous AI agent execution.
  • Improve reliability, observability, and operational tooling across both client and server applications.
  • Integrate with enterprise systems such as ERP platforms (SAP, Dynamics, etc.) and external APIs, surfacing that data intuitively on the frontend.
  • Scale multi-tenant systems, database architectures (PostgreSQL), and platform abstractions.
  • Work closely with product and forward-deployed engineering teams to translate real customer problems into cohesive end-to-end features.

Requirements

  • Strong full-stack engineering fundamentals and production experience owning end-to-end feature delivery.
  • Deep experience with React and modern frontend ecosystems, coupled with a strong eye for user experience and interface design.
  • Deep experience with Python and distributed / backend systems.
  • A strong ownership mentality and systems thinking - you care just as much about UI state management as you do about backend database query optimization.
  • Ability to design reliable, observable, maintainable systems.
  • Comfort operating in ambiguous, fast-moving startup environments.
  • Clear communication and sound engineering judgment.
  • Excitement about AI-native software development and agentic systems.

Join GeneralMind as a Lead Full Stack Engineer! Drive innovation in AI, transform enterprise workflows, and grow with us. Be part of a team shaping the future of business automation!

title: Quality Assurance Engineer (Berlin)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at GeneralMind
description_html:
GeneralMind is a Berlin-founded AI company building its own System of Action for modern enterprises: an operational AI layer on top of ERP systems. This is not a copilot. It's an autopilot: human-supervised, with approvals where needed. Our AI Autopilot autonomously executes recurring, complex workflows end-to-end across email, Excel, and enterprise systems. Incoming tasks are captured, analyzed, and completed with human-level capability, tracking handovers, meeting deadlines, and ensuring compliance across multiple stakeholders. Designed for mid-sized and large enterprises, GeneralMind helps organizations eliminate inbox-driven work, improve execution across goods and money flows, and keep supply chains moving at scale. Founded in 2025, GeneralMind serves customers across industry, commerce, and logistics in Europe and beyond.

Tasks

  • Test the platform from a real user's perspective, running through both typical flows and the unusual ones ("what happens if I enter the wrong thing?").
  • Track down bugs, crashes, display issues, and illogical behaviour, and document them clearly with steps to reproduce.
  • Judge whether features work the way they should, and flag anything confusing, clunky, or inconsistent (usability).
  • Check different devices, browsers, and screen sizes to make sure everything works everywhere.
  • Rank bugs by severity (critical vs. cosmetic) and prioritise them so the team knows what to fix first.
  • Retest fixed bugs and confirm that the fixes didn't break anything else (regression testing).
  • Work closely with engineering and product, answer their questions, and help reproduce issues.

Requirements

  • A sharp, thorough eye for detail and the patience to get to the bottom of things.
  • A structured, clear way of documenting bugs so anyone can follow them.
  • The ability to think like a user and to use software "the wrong way" on purpose to find its limits.
  • Clear, easy-to-understand communication, both written and spoken.
  • First experience with software testing, QA tools, or ticketing systems (e.g. Jira, Linear) is a plus, but not a must depending on focus.

Werde Teil von GeneralMind als Quality Assurance Engineer! Entwickle deine Fähigkeiten in einem innovativen AI-Unternehmen in Berlin und gestalte die Zukunft der Automatisierung. Bewirb dich jetzt!

description_html:
Du willst Systemadministrator Linux nicht einfach administrieren, sondern selbst entscheiden, wie eine moderne Open Source IT Landschaft aussehen soll?🚀

Dann bekommst du hier den Freiraum dafür. Unser Kunde ist ein wachsendes, familiengeführtes Technologieunternehmen aus Freiburg, das Hard- und Softwarelösungen für die industrielle Bildverarbeitung und Automation entwickelt. Die eigenen Systeme kommen heute in mehr als 15.000 Maschinen weltweit zum Einsatz.

Als Systemadministrator Linux verstärkst du einen bewusst klein gehaltenen IT Bereich und bekommst entsprechend viel Gestaltungsspielraum. Statt starrer Konzernstrukturen erwarten dich kurze Wege, direkter Austausch mit der Geschäftsführung und die Möglichkeit, technische Entscheidungen aktiv mitzugestalten. 

Der technologische Fokus liegt konsequent auf Linux und Open Source. In den kommenden Jahren stehen spannende Themen an: bestehende Anwendungen sollen auf Open Source Alternativen migriert, Cyber Security und Resilience weiter ausgebaut und ein eigener interner Linux basierter KI Server kontinuierlich weiterentwickelt werden. 

Wenn Linux dein fachliches Zuhause ist und du lieber neue Lösungen entwickelst, als nur bestehende Systeme am Laufen zu halten, kannst du hier eine IT Landschaft langfristig mitprägen. 

Deine Benefits

  • Gestaltungsspielraum: Entscheide aktiv mit, wie sich die interne IT in den Bereichen Linux, Open Source, Cyber Security, Resilience und Automatisierung weiterentwickelt.  

  • Spannende Zukunftsprojekte: Arbeite unter anderem an Open Source Migrationen, dem Ausbau der IT Security und einem eigenen internen Linux basierten KI Server.  

  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit: Arbeite eng mit der Geschäftsführung zusammen und profitiere von kurzen Entscheidungswegen und viel Freiheit bei technischen Lösungen.  

  • Flexibles Arbeiten: Nutze flexible Arbeitszeiten ohne feste Kernarbeitszeit und arbeite in der Regel einen Tag pro Woche im Homeoffice. Individuell kann nach Absprache auch mehr Remote Arbeit möglich sein. 

  • 30 Urlaubstage: Profitiere von 30 Tagen Urlaub und individuellen Lösungen, wenn du darüber hinaus einmal eine längere Auszeit benötigst.  

  • Bonus: Zusätzlich zu deinem Fixgehalt erhältst du einen vom Unternehmenserfolg abhängigen Jahresbonus, der in erfolgreichen Jahren bereits bei mehreren Tausend Euro lag.  

  • Mobilität: Nutze das bezuschusste Deutschlandticket, JobRad, Firmenparkplätze, kostenloses Laden deines E Autos sowie Poolfahrzeuge für dienstliche Termine.  

  • Sport & Gesundheit: Profitiere von Hansefit, einem Boulderfelsen und einer Tischtennisplatte direkt am Standort sowie zahlreichen von Kollegen organisierten Aktivitäten wie Klettern, Mountainbiken oder Kajaken.  

  • Team & Events: Freue dich auf Sommerfest, Weihnachtsfeier, gemeinsame Grillnachmittage auf der Dachterrasse sowie mehrtägige Entwickler Camps, bei denen bewusst neue Technologien und Themen ausprobiert werden.  

  • Weiterentwicklung: Erhalte individuell abgestimmte Weiterbildungen und einen Mentor aus einem anderen Unternehmensbereich als persönlichen Sparringspartner.  

  • Gehalt: Jahresbruttogehalt ab 60.000 € mit Bereitschaft zur deutlichen Überzahlung abhängig von Qualifikation und Erfahrung. 

Deine Aufgaben

Als Systemadministrator Linux hältst du nicht nur bestehende Systeme am Laufen, sondern entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Team die zukünftige IT-Landschaft des Unternehmens. 

  • Linux & Infrastruktur: Verantworte und optimiere die Linux Systemlandschaft sowie die zugehörige Netzwerk- und IT-Infrastruktur.  

  • Open Source: Entwickle bestehende Systeme konsequent weiter und begleite Migrationen von Standardsoftware zu geeigneten Open Source Alternativen.  

  • Virtualisierung & Automatisierung: Arbeite mit Technologien wie Proxmox, Docker und vSphere und automatisiere Prozesse beispielsweise mit Python und Ansible.  

  • Cyber Security: Entwickle Security und Resilience weiter und beschäftige dich mit technischen Anforderungen rund um NIS 2, DSGVO, CRA und TISAX.  

  • KI Infrastruktur: Betreue und erweitere den unternehmenseigenen Linux basierten KI-Server und schaffe eine sichere Infrastruktur für die interne Nutzung künstlicher Intelligenz.  

  • Technischer Support: Löse komplexere interne IT-Fragestellungen für überwiegend technisch versierte Anwender mit Schwerpunkt auf dem zweiten und dritten Supportlevel. 

Dein Profil Systemadministrator Linux

  • Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Fachinformatiker, IT-Systemadministrator, abgeschlossenes Informatikstudium oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.  

  • Mindestens zwei Jahre Berufserfahrung mit klarem Schwerpunkt auf Linux Administration nach Abschluss deiner Ausbildung oder deines Studiums.  

  • Sehr gute Linux Kenntnisse: Du arbeitest bereits routiniert mit Linux und möchtest dich nicht erst in das Betriebssystem einarbeiten.  

  • Solides Verständnis von Netzwerktechnik, Netzwerkprotokollen und IT-Infrastruktur.  

  • Erfahrung mit Virtualisierung oder Containertechnologien wie Proxmox, Docker oder vSphere.  

  • Kenntnisse in der Automatisierung, beispielsweise mit Python, Ansible oder vergleichbaren Technologien.  

  • Begeisterung für Open Source und Interesse daran, eine IT-Landschaft langfristig auf offenen und sicheren Lösungen aufzubauen.  

  • Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse auf mindestens C1 Niveau sowie fließende Englischkenntnisse.  

  • Eigenständige, pragmatische Arbeitsweise und Lust darauf, technische Entscheidungen aktiv mitzugestalten und gemeinsam im Team neue Lösungen auszuprobieren.  

  • Kenntnisse in Nextcloud, Open Xchange, Nginx, pfSense, OpenVPN, Git oder Ceph sowie Erfahrung mit IT Security sind von Vorteil. 

Du suchst keinen Job, in dem du nur Tickets abarbeitest, sondern möchtest eine Linux und Open Source Landschaft wirklich mitgestalten? 🚀 

Sende uns deinen Lebenslauf und erfahre in einem kurzen 10 minütigen Kennenlerngespräch mehr über das Unternehmen, die IT Landschaft und die Möglichkeiten, die du in dieser Rolle hast.

title: Tech Operations Analyst - Graduate (all genders)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Distribusion Technologies
description_html:
About us

Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travellers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers including Google Maps and Booking.com.

We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. We are one of the fastest-growing startups in travel, backed by two leading VCs (TQ Ventures & Lightrock), and now, following our recent $80m Series C funding, we are ready to push beyond.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a Technical Operations Analyst to join our Control Room team. You will support the management of ongoing escalations and investigations, help ensure clear communication with our partners and management during issue resolution, and contribute to operational flows that keep all company products running smoothly.

What you will do

  • Operational Support: Monitor system operations daily to help maintain smooth processes across the platform.

  • Incident Management: Assist in investigating reported issues, troubleshooting errors, and helping the team resolve incidents quickly.

  • Problem Solving: Develop a deep understanding of our stack in order to perform technical investigations to identify issue root causes and support long-term fixes.

  • Data Analysis: Run database queries to gather insights, validate technical issues, and spot areas for improvement.

  • Process Support: Collaborate with senior team members on operational projects and test new internal tools.

  • Effective Communication: Manage internal and external communication effectively, collaborating across teams to ensure seamless issue resolution and clear, transparent updates.


Workplace: Berlin- hybrid; Germany- remote; Remote.


Who you are:

  • Experience: 0–2 years of experience or a relevant degree (e.g., Computer Science, IT, Business Information Systems).

  • Technical Skills: Familiarity with basic SQL queries, log analysis and database concepts; comfortable learning monitoring tools like Grafana, Prometheus, or New Relic.

  • Mindset: Curiosity to learn how complex systems work and a desire to solve technical problems.

  • Communication: Good written and spoken English, with the ability to explain technical details clearly.

  • Adaptability: Comfortable working in a fast-paced tech environment and juggling different tasks.

A view into our Tech stack:

  • Tracking and analytics: Prometheus, Grafana, New Relic, BigQuery.

  • Database: PostgreSQL.

  • Project management: Jira.

Our hiring team:

Your Talent Partner (TP) and point of contact is Anh Do, and the Hiring Manager (HM) is Ygor Alvarez.
For any queries, please reach out to your Talent Partner at (

title: (Senior) M&A Associate (w/m/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Arsipa GmbH
description_html:
Du möchtest den Wachstumskurs einer dynamischen Unternehmensgruppe durch anspruchsvolle M&A-Transaktionen aktiv mitgestalten? Dann suchen wir genau Dich, zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt als:

Senior M&A Associate (w/m/d) - Berlin

Als Senior M&A Associate (w/m/d) gestaltest Du die Buy-&-Build-Strategie der Arsipa Gruppe aktiv mit und steuerst anspruchsvolle Buy-Side-Transaktionen eigenverantwortlich von der Identifikation potenzieller Akquisitionsziele bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss. Dabei übernimmst Du Verantwortung für Unternehmensbewertungen, Transaktionsstrukturen und Due-Diligence-Prozesse und koordinierst interne sowie externe Stakeholder. Im engen Austausch mit unserem M&A-Team, dem Head of M&A sowie unserem Management leistest Du damit einen direkten Beitrag zum weiteren Wachstum der Arsipa Gruppe. Dafür brauchen wir Deine Unterstützung!

Die Arsipa Gruppe ist eine schnell wachsende Unternehmensgruppe im Bereich Health, Safety & Environment, unterstützt von Warburg Pincus. Mit über 1.000 Mitarbeitenden, 20+ Tochtergesellschaften und 90 Standorten in Deutschland und Österreich bauen wir im Rahmen einer klaren Buy-&-Build-Strategie eine skalierbare Plattform mit nachhaltiger Wertschöpfung. Unser Ziel: eine der führenden Anbieterinnen im deutschsprachigen Markt – unterstützt durch zentrale Funktionen wie Finance, People, Marketing und IT am Standort Berlin.

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Steuerung von M&A-Transaktionen

    • Buy-Side-Transaktionen steuerst Du eigenverantwortlich von der ersten Analyse bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss.

    • Unternehmensbewertungen führst Du durch und entwickelst geeignete Transaktions- und Finanzierungsstrukturen.

    • Angebote und relevante Transaktionsdokumente erstellst und verhandelst Du gemeinsam mit dem M&A-Team.

    • Due-Diligence-Prozesse begleitest und koordinierst Du über die relevanten Fachbereiche hinweg.

  • Deal Sourcing & Akquisitionsstrategie

    • Potenzielle Akquisitionsziele identifizierst und analysierst Du mit besonderem Fokus auf den Health-, Safety- & Environment-Markt.

    • Geeignete Zielunternehmen sprichst Du proaktiv an und entwickelst bestehende Kontakte im Rahmen unserer Buy-&-Build-Strategie weiter.

    • Markt- und Unternehmensanalysen nutzt Du, um attraktive Akquisitionsmöglichkeiten frühzeitig zu erkennen und zu bewerten.

    • Strategische und wirtschaftliche Potenziale möglicher Akquisitionen beurteilst Du und bereitest fundierte Entscheidungsgrundlagen für das Management vor.

  • Projektsteuerung & Stakeholdermanagement

    • Sämtliche am Transaktionsprozess beteiligten internen und externen Stakeholder koordinierst Du eigenständig und stellst einen strukturierten Deal-Prozess sicher.

    • Eng arbeitest Du mit unserem M&A-Team, dem Head of M&A sowie CEO und CFO zusammen.

    • Externe Berater:innen steuerst Du zielgerichtet und sorgst dafür, dass die relevanten Workstreams effizient zusammenlaufen.

    • Transaktionsprozesse behältst Du hinsichtlich Zeitplan, Meilensteinen und relevanter Entscheidungsgrundlagen kontinuierlich im Blick.

Deine Startvoraussetzungen:

  • Das bringst Du mit:

    • Ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Betriebswirtschaftslehre, Finance, Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung bildet Deine fachliche Grundlage.

    • Mehrjährige relevante Berufserfahrung im Bereich M&A, Corporate Finance, Investment Banking oder einer vergleichbaren transaktionsnahen Tätigkeit bringst Du mit.

    • Nachweisliche End-to-End-Deal-Erfahrung, idealerweise auf der Buy-Side, ermöglicht Dir die eigenständige Steuerung von Transaktionen.

    • Erfahrung in der eigenverantwortlichen Projektsteuerung von Small- bis Mid-Cap-Transaktionen sowie sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse runden Dein Profil ab.

  • Das hilft Dir, schneller erfolgreich zu sein:

    • Erfahrung in einem Private-Equity- bzw. Buy-&-Build-Umfeld wäre von Vorteil.

    • Kenntnisse im Health-, Safety-, Healthcare- oder Professional-Services-Umfeld wären ein Plus.

    • Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit Geschäftsführungen, Investor:innen und externen Transaktionsberater:innen ist wünschenswert.

    • Eine strukturierte, analytische und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise sowie ausgeprägte Kommunikationsstärke helfen Dir, komplexe Transaktionsprozesse sicher zu steuern.

Unsere Benefits:

  • Attraktives Arbeitsumfeld: 30 Tage Jahresurlaub, Heiligabend und Silvester jeweils einen halben Tag frei, ein hybrides Setup mit großzügigen Homeoffice-Möglichkeiten sowie ein zentral gelegenes Office im Rocket Tower inklusive Gym, unmittelbar an der U-Bahn-Station „Kochstraße“. Ein Full-Remote-Setup innerhalb Deutschlands ist ebenfalls möglich.

  • Starke Teamkultur: Eine offene und wertschätzende Unternehmenskultur mit regelmäßigen Stand-ups, monatlichen All-Hands Meetings und gemeinsamen Events fördert den fachlichen Austausch und eine positive, kollegiale Zusammenarbeit.

  • Direkte Nähe zu Management und M&A: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit unserem Head of M&A, CEO und CFO sowie den Geschäftsführungen unserer Tochtergesellschaften ermöglicht Dir, Buy-Side-Transaktionen eigenverantwortlich zu begleiten und direkten Einfluss auf den Wachstumskurs der Arsipa Gruppe zu nehmen.

  • Gestaltungsspielraum in einer Buy-&-Build-Plattform: Prozesse, Strukturen und Standards im M&A-Bereich gestaltest Du aktiv mit und erhältst unmittelbare Einblicke in die Umsetzung unserer Buy-&-Build-Strategie - unterstützt durch Warburg Pincus.

  • End-to-End-Verantwortung im Deal-Prozess: Von Deal Sourcing und Unternehmensbewertung über Due Diligence und Transaktionsstrukturierung bis hin zur Vertragsverhandlung und zum Closing übernimmst Du Verantwortung für zentrale Schritte unserer Buy-Side-Transaktionen.

description_html:
Want a 3D Career? Join Norgine. 

At Norgine, our colleagues Dare themselves to be different and try new things, Drive to achieve their goals and beyond, and Develop themselves and their community.  

We call it the 3D career at Norgine and it offers you a fully-rounded experience with no limits.  

Bring everything about yourself that you’re proud of, whether that’s your passion for making a difference, focus on others’ well-being, or intellectual curiosity to unleash in a fast-paced environment and supportive community.  

In return, get a sense of belonging, a long-term career with ongoing development and upskilling, and a company that cares about people’s wellness as much as you do.  

Norgine: Transforming Healthcare, Backed by Over a Century of Expertise.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced Senior Brand Lead DACH (Consumer Health) who combines strategic marketing expertise with strong commercial acumen and a passion for driving growth. In this highly visible role, you will be the local ambassador for our consumer health portfolio across Germany, Austria and Switzerland, leading the development and execution of brand and commercial strategies that maximize business performance and market impact.

Working closely with cross-functional teams and key external partners, you will take full ownership of the local business, ensuring the successful implementation of global strategies while identifying and unlocking opportunities tailored to local market needs. You will play a pivotal role in shaping the future of our brands, inspiring teams, building strong customer relationships, and delivering sustainable growth in a dynamic and entrepreneurial environment.

Requirements

Financial Management

  • Drive sustainable growth by achieving agreed sales, profit and market share targets across the Consumer Healthcare portfolio.
  • Take full ownership of the local Brand P&L, ensuring efficient resource allocation and identifying opportunities to improve profitability.
  • Deliver key business KPIs, including financial performance, forecasting accuracy, market share growth and strategic project execution.
  • Optimize marketing and commercial investments to maximize return on investment and business impact.

Commercial Management

  • Lead the commercial strategy and execution across the DACH region to deliver profitable channel growth.
  • Manage relationships with distributors, customers and third-party partners, including contract negotiations and performance management.
  • Develop and implement effective route-to-market, trade and channel strategies to ensure optimal market coverage and commercial success.
  • Drive e-commerce and digital growth initiatives in line with the global digital strategy.
  • Monitor commercial performance, identify opportunities and implement corrective actions where required.
  • Equip sales teams and external partners with the tools, insights and support needed to achieve business objectives.
  • Build strong relationships with key stakeholders and ensure high levels of engagement with Norgine brands.

Consumer Marketing

  • Adapt and implement global brand strategies to meet local market needs and drive market share growth.
  • Lead the development and execution of local brand and marketing plans aligned with company objectives.
  • Deliver impactful marketing campaigns from concept to execution, ensuring measurable business results.
  • Collaborate closely with media agencies and internal stakeholders to maximize brand visibility across all relevant channels, with a strong focus on digital.
  • Monitor campaign effectiveness and optimize activities based on agreed KPIs and market insights.
  • Maintain a strong understanding of market trends, consumer behaviour and competitive dynamics to identify growth opportunities.
  • Work cross-functionally with global and local teams, including Marketing, Digital, Regulatory, Supply Chain and other operational functions.
  • Contribute to annual and long-term business planning while sharing best practices to support global brand development.

SKILLS

  • Strategic mindset with a strong commercial vision.
  • Excellent leadership, decision-making and stakeholder management capabilities.
  • Strong communication and influencing skills, with the ability to inspire and engage others.
  • Highly analytical, results-driven and customer-focused.
  • Strong financial and commercial acumen, including P&L management experience.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a proactive and hands-on approach.
  • Ability to work independently while successfully leading cross-functional collaboration.
  • Adaptable, resilient and comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment.

EXPERIENCE

  • Significant experience in brand marketing and/or commercial leadership roles within the Consumer Healthcare and/or FMCG industry.
  • Proven track record of delivering profitable growth, building brands and managing commercial performance.
  • Demonstrated experience in managing cross-functional teams, external partners and multiple stakeholders.
  • Strong P&L management experience with the ability to translate strategy into measurable business results.

Why Join Us? 

At Norgine, you’ll be part of an inclusive environment where diverse perspectives are valued. You will have the opportunity to grow your career while making a meaningful impact on patients’ lives. 

Bring your curiosity, creativity, and drive — however you work best, you will find the support to succeed.

Apply via LinkedIn or through our careers page.

We are committed to building an inclusive workplace and welcome applications from all backgrounds. 

Our benefits may vary per location. Please liaise with the Norgine TA representative to obtain more information.  

If you want a multi-dimensional 3D career in a leading healthcare organisation, join us.
