title: Chief of Staff
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at DiliTrust
description_html:
Ready to be part of the Legal Tech revolution?

DiliTrust is a global SaaS publisher transforming legal departments worldwide through cutting-edge technology.

Our vision: As a SaaS provider, DiliTrust is dedicated to offering an integrated suite of legal and governance solutions. Our vision is to digitize legal departments around the world and become the global leader in Legal Tech.

Our impact: From generating General Meeting reports to AI-assisted contract lifecycle management, our international teams are the driving force behind our global success. We proudly support customers across numerous countries and markets.

Our recognition: DiliTrust is at the forefront of Legal Tech innovation and has been integrating artificial intelligence into its solutions since 2022. The company is recognized for offering a positive and entrepreneurial work environment and has received the “Happy at Work” and “Tech at Work” labels.

The role

We are looking for a Chief of Staff to the CEO to help drive the company’s strategic priorities and coordinate key cross-functional initiatives.

This role is suited to an early-career, high-potential professional who is structured, analytical and hands-on. You will work closely with the CEO and senior stakeholders across the company, helping translate priorities into action, improving execution and ensuring that key topics receive the appropriate level of attention and follow-up.

The ideal candidate will have an engineering or technical background, or a strong affinity for technology, and will be comfortable working with data, complex business topics and multiple stakeholders.

This is an opportunity to gain broad exposure to the company while contributing directly to strategic decision-making and operational execution.

Missions

  • Support the CEO in preparing strategic analyses, recommendations, presentations and decision-making materials.
  • Coordinate important cross-functional projects from planning through execution, ensuring clear objectives, ownership, timelines and next steps.
  • Track company priorities, deadlines, risks, dependencies and key decisions, escalating issues when appropriate.
  • Analyse business data and prepare dashboards, management reports and concise executive-level updates.
  • Prepare leadership meetings, structure agendas, document decisions, follow up on actions and ensure accountability.
  • Work closely with teams across the company to improve execution, information flow and alignment around strategic priorities.
  • Help synthesize complex technical and business topics into clear, actionable recommendations for senior stakeholders.

Your Profile

  • The successful candidate will be a high-potential professional with approximately 2–5 years of experience in technology, consulting, engineering, operations, product or project management.
  • A structured and analytical approach, with the ability to break down complex topics and identify practical solutions.
  • Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage several priorities in parallel.
  • A proactive, reliable and hands-on mindset, with a strong sense of ownership.
  • The discretion and maturity required to work closely with the CEO and senior stakeholders.
  • The ability to work independently while knowing when to seek input or escalate an issue.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with confidence presenting information to senior audiences.
  • The ability to build effective working relationships with teams across the company.
  • An interest in technology, SaaS and the way technology can transform business processes.

Technical knowledge

  • Strong proficiency with spreadsheets and business data analysis. Familiar with AI tools.
  • Ability to build or maintain dashboards, management reports and performance tracking tools.
  • Comfortable working with business metrics, KPIs and operational reporting.
  • Experience coordinating projects, action plans, deadlines and cross-functional dependencies.
  • Ability to prepare clear presentations and executive-level documentation.
  • Comfortable understanding technical concepts and collaborating with technology, product or engineering teams.

Languages

  • Fluent in French and English is required.
  • German, Italian or Spanish would be a strong advantage.

Recruitment process

  • Interview with a member of the Talent Acquisition team — 30 to 45 minutes.
  • Interview with the CEO — approximately 45 minutes.
  • Case study or practical exercise related to the role.
  • Final interview.

DiliTrust is committed to diversity, inclusion and professional equality at all levels.

title: Applied AI, Forward Deployed Machine Learning Engineer - (Internship)
salary_basis: Based on historical internship stipend records at Mistral.ai
description_html:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

 

As an Applied Engineering Intern, you will work closely with our Applied AI Engineering team to facilitate the adoption of Mistral AI products among customers and collaborate with them to address complex technical challenges. This role is based in Paris, with an internship duration of 6 months. We are open to CIFRE programs as a continuation after the internship.

 

What you will do

 

• Contribute to the deployment of state-of-the-art GenAI applications, driving technological transformation with our customers.

• Collaborate with researchers, AI engineers, and product engineers on complex customer projects.

• Work with the product and science team to continuously improve our product and model capabilities based on customer feedback.

 

How We Work in Applied AI

 

- We care about people and outputs.

- What matters is what you ship, not the time you spend on it

- Bureaucracy is where urgency goes to vanish. You talk to whoever you need to talk to. The best idea wins, whether it comes from a principal engineer or someone in their first week.

- Always ask why. The best solutions come from deep understanding, not from copying what worked before

- We say what we mean. Feedback is direct, timely, and given because we care.

- No politics. Low ego, high standards.

- We embrace an unstructured environment and find joy in it.

 

About you

 

• You are currently pursuing a degree in AI, data science, or a related field from a tier 1 engineering school or university.

• You have strong programming skills in Python.

• You are familiar with machine learning algorithms and natural language processing techniques.

• You hold basic understanding of MLOps and deploying machine learning use cases.

• You have good communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

 

Ideally you have:

• Experience with deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch.

• Familiarity with version control systems (e.g., Git) and Linux shell environment.

• Experience working in HPC Environments

• Publication record in AI or a related field

Location & work authorization: This internship is available only in France. Please apply only if you have the required work authorization to complete the internship in the relevant country for its full duration.

 

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

title: Senior/Staff Product Designer | JetBrains
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Hirehire
description_html:
About JetBrains Air

JetBrains has been building developer tools since 2000 — including IntelliJ IDEA, Kotlin, TeamCity, and more, now trusted by 15M+ developers at 287K companies worldwide. The company is 100% private, profitable, and driven by a single thesis: great tools make developers better.

Air is what JetBrains is building next: an agentic development environment where multiple AI agents run tasks in parallel while the developer stays in control. It’s a genuinely new kind of developer tool — spanning a native desktop app, an expanding web experience, and cloud-based automations. It’s the next frontier after IDEs: not just helping developers write code, but helping them orchestrate it.

The Air design team is two people now — and you’d be the third. Your primary focus will be the web surface and the automations sub-team: an emerging part of the product that is ready for dedicated design ownership, with a real opportunity to raise the bar and shape the experience from the ground up.

What you’ll be working on

  • Design the web interface for Air: team management, automation setup, and a results overview

  • Shape the design process for the automations sub-team, working directly with developers to establish review and handoff practices

  • Take features from ambiguous briefs to shipped interfaces

  • Contribute to the shared design system: add and maintain components in Figma as the product grows

  • Vibe-code and use AI for prototyping when it helps move ideas forward faster

  • Participate in cross-team demos and quarterly planning, bringing a design perspective to where Air should go next

What you need

  • 5+ years of product design experience, with great examples of delivering results that impact the business.

  • Ownership instinct. You see features through from design to production. Delivery is part of your definition of done.

  • Excellent cross-team project delivery. You can work with limited context, clarify what matters, define the scope, and move projects forward across teams without needing constant hand-holding.

  • Active AI user. You use AI tools in your design workflow. You’ve experimented with building or prototyping with Cursor, Claude, or similar. This market moves weekly; you should too.

  • Solid Figma skills. Proficient with components, tokens/variables, and design systems — you can navigate an existing UI kit, understand how it works, and contribute new components as the product grows.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with developer-focused products or technical tooling (IDEs, dashboards, data tools)

  • Experience with vibe-coding, design engineering, or code-level prototypes

  • Familiarity with agentic or AI-native interface patterns — trust signals, human-in-the-loop, error handling at scale

What you get

  • Rare product scope. Work on a product that could define the next generation of developer tooling — small team, direct impact, decisions that ship fast.

  • JetBrains’ culture. Engineering-first, quality-focused, 100% private. No VC pressure, no artificial growth targets.

  • Competitive compensation and benefits — location-dependent, with a full breakdown available on request.

title: Junior Product Owner
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Erasys
description_html:
Your journey

ROMEO is the queer company behind the legendary ROMEO dating app, one of Europe’s longest-standing dating platforms for queer communities. We are looking for a Product Owner to join our Product team in Berlin and help shape how ideas and product requirements make their way into the hands of millions of users.

In this delivery-focused role, you will work closely with Product Management, Design, Engineering, QA and BI to turn product priorities into clear, actionable work for our development teams. It is a great opportunity to grow your product skills while taking real ownership of the day-to-day delivery process.


Your typical day

  • Support the Product Management team in refining product requirements and translating approved PRDs into implementation-ready epics, user stories and tickets.
  • Ensure user stories have clear acceptance criteria and are sufficiently refined before entering development.
  • Maintain and order the backlog according to priorities set by product leadership.
  • Take part in regular and ad hoc meetings to clarify product requirements with development, design and other delivery teams.
  • Support our two-week delivery cycle by ensuring development teams have the information and decisions they need to proceed.
  • Identify missing requirements, dependencies, open decisions and blockers early, and escalate them to Product or Delivery.
  • Work closely with QA to communicate product and release priorities, clarify acceptance criteria, and support defect triage and release-readiness decisions.
  • Support product acceptance and release readiness by checking delivered functionality against agreed requirements and acceptance criteria.
  • Support the BI team by translating product questions, KPIs and tracking needs into clear data requirements.
  • Ensure agreed analytics requirements are captured as part of delivery, including relevant event tracking before work is considered complete.
  • Maintain clear and up-to-date product documentation in Jira and Confluence.


We look for

  • You are passionate about building products for LGBTQ+ communities and interested in contributing to the continued development of ROMEO.
  • You have initial experience in a Product Owner or similar product delivery role, ideally in a B2C environment. Experience in social, dating or community products is a plus. Being familiar with how our product works is a plus.

title: Développeur C# confirmé H/F - ASP.NET / React
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Valsoft Corp
description_html:
À propos de nous

E-finances est un éditeur de logiciels B2B spécialisé dans les solutions de gestion financière et de trésorerie. Nos solutions permettent aux entreprises d'optimiser la gestion de leurs flux financiers, d'améliorer leur visibilité sur leur trésorerie et de renforcer leur performance financière.

Nous sommes en pleine phase de modernisation : refonte technique de nos produits historiques, lancement de nouvelles fonctionnalités, montée en puissance de nos stacks. C'est le bon moment pour rejoindre l'aventure et laisser une vraie empreinte sur ce que nous construisons.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre

  • Un vrai rôle de bâtisseur. Vous n'arrivez pas sur un projet figé : vous participez activement à la refonte de nos applications et à la définition de la manière dont elles doivent évoluer. Vos idées et votre esprit d'initiative sont attendus, pas seulement votre code.
  • De l'autonomie et de la confiance. Vous travaillez en petite équipe soudée (un Lead Tech, trois développeurs, un Product Owner), avec la liberté d'organiser votre travail et de proposer vos propres solutions techniques.
  • Des perspectives d'évolution concrètes. En rejoignant une équipe en croissance sur un produit stratégique, vous avez l'opportunité de faire grandir vos responsabilités techniques (architecture, mentorat, choix technologiques) au fil du temps.
  • De la flexibilité. Organisation de travail flexible et équilibre vie pro / vie perso respecté, dans un environnement où l'on juge sur les résultats plutôt que sur la présence.
  • Des sujets qui comptent. Modernisation d'un legacy réel (.NET Framework 3.5/4.8 vers .NET 8), dette technique à réduire, nouveaux features à concevoir de zéro : de quoi élargir votre expertise technique en continu.
  • Un process rapide et direct. un premier échange avec notre Lead Tech (en visio), puis une case study en présentiel avec la Directrice d'E-finances.

Vos missions

  • Développer :  concevoir, développer, tester et maintenir des applications en C#.
  • Moderniser :  participer activement à la refonte technique de nos solutions et à la migration vers les technologies récentes.
  • Réduire la dette technique :  contribuer à l'amélioration continue de notre codebase et proposer des solutions.
  • Collaborer en agilité :  participer aux rituels agiles (sprints, daily stand-ups, weekly meetings) au sein d'une équipe où la communication est directe et fluide.
  • Garantir la qualité :  assurer la qualité du code via des tests unitaires et les bonnes pratiques de développement.

Compétences principales requises

  • C# :  minimum 4 ans d'expérience.
  • .NET Framework 3.5 / 4.8 à .NET 8 :  maîtrise de ces technologies.
  • ASP.NET (Razor et jQuery) ou React :  expertise dans l'une de ces stacks.
  • SQL Server, MySQL, Oracle :  maîtrise de SQL et expérience avec au moins l'un des trois SGBD.
  • Git :  gestion des versions avec Git, Pull Requests et Code Review.
  • Tests unitaires :  expérience avec les TU pour garantir la qualité du code.
  • Agilité :  connaissance des pratiques agiles et des méthodologies associées.
  • CI/CD.

Profil recherché

  • Au moins 3 ans d'expérience en développement.
  • Basé(e) à moins d'une heure de Nantes.
  • Français et anglais courants.
  • Esprit d'initiative et mentalité « doer » :  à l'aise pour proposer, tester et itérer plutôt qu'attendre des consignes.
  • Adaptabilité :  capacité à monter rapidement en compétence sur de nouvelles technologies et à comprendre les enjeux métier.
  • Autonomie et goût du collectif :  capable de travailler aussi bien seul qu'en équipe.
  • Excellentes compétences en communication et en résolution de problèmes.

 

Vous ne cochez pas toutes les cases ? Postulez quand même, nous discutons volontiers de votre profil.

description_html:
Inautalent recrute, pour le compte d'un de ses clients — un acteur international du secteur des applications lifestyle et relationnelles, en croissance active sur le marché français — un(e) Associate Director, Integrated Marketing, en charge du pilotage stratégique du marché France.

Le défi : ce poste consiste à identifier soi-même les enjeux et opportunités du marché français, puis à construire et exécuter la stratégie qui en découle — de bout en bout. Le poste est pensé pour quelqu'un qui est à l'aise pour opérer sans une large équipe, en portant plusieurs casquettes, et pour qui la construction d'une stratégie compte autant que sa mise en œuvre concrète sur le terrain.

Requirements

Le poste, en synthèse :

  • Piloter le marché France de bout en bout : diagnostic des enjeux et opportunités, construction de la stratégie, exécution.
  • Déterminer le marketing mix et faire des recommandations stratégiques sur le mix média payant.
  • Piloter la collaboration quotidienne avec l'agence média, garantir l'alignement stratégique et l'optimisation continue des canaux payants.
  • Construire des plans marketing intégrés multicanaux (média, influence, RP, partenariats), de la rédaction du brief à l'analyse de performance.
  • Communiquer régulièrement les enjeux du marché, la stratégie et les résultats à la direction et aux parties prenantes transverses.
  • Adapter les apprentissages globaux au marché français, et remonter les enseignements locaux à l'organisation globale.

Profil recherché :

  • Solide expérience en leadership, avec une capacité démontrée à superviser des responsables de canaux (channel leads) et à porter une stratégie globale cohérente.
  • 8 à 10 ans d'expérience en marketing de marque, marketing intégré ou marketing stratégique, idéalement dans la tech grand public, le lifestyle ou des marques à forte identité culturelle.
  • Expérience en marketing et/ou média avec une expertise approfondie et une réelle compréhension du marché français.
  • Expérience avérée de pilotage autonome d'un marché, du diagnostic des enjeux jusqu'à l'exécution.
  • Expérience avérée du lancement de campagnes multicanales générant à la fois de la connexion émotionnelle et des résultats mesurables.
  • Bonne compréhension du paysage média, des canaux et de la mesure de performance.
  • Solides compétences analytiques, avec une utilisation démontrée de la donnée et des indicateurs pour mesurer l'impact des actions et ajuster la stratégie en conséquence.
  • Expérience dans la gestion de partenariats avec des célébrités, talents, influenceurs ou créateurs de contenu, y compris la gestion de relations avec des agences, est un plus.
  • À l'aise pour opérer sans une large équipe, en portant plusieurs casquettes, de façon autonome.
  • Français natif ou bilingue, anglais courant indispensable.

Benefits

Conditions : France, full remote — Rémunération : 100 000 € à 111 000 € brut/an — Prise de poste : 1er octobre.

title: Stage - Assistant(e) Chef de Produit - Art de Vivre & Maison (H/F)
description_html:
Il y a vingt ans, les premières sélections Les Composantes voyaient le jour. Une histoire née d’une soif d’indépendance et d’une passion pour le vintage. Une manière instinctive de faire circuler les vêtements, guidée par une attention particulière à ce qui dure.

Dans son prolongement, Sézane prend vie en 2013 : la première marque de mode française née en ligne. Puis sont venus enrichir cet univers : Octobre Éditions pour les hommes, Les Composantes, dédiée cette fois à l’art de vivre, et Petit Sézane pour les enfants.

Tout s’est construit comme on avance dans la vie : par élans, par gestes spontanés avec cette manière d’apprendre en faisant. Une autre relation au détail, au service et au lien. Une autre manière d’habiller le réel, d’abord en ligne, puis à travers nos Appartements.

Nous recherchons aujourd’hui des talents créatifs, structurés et agiles qui partagent l’envie d’améliorer sans cesse tout ce qui peut l’être. Des talents passionnés, autonomes qui conçoivent le travail dans le respect des autres et pour qui rien n'est hors d'atteinte, pour peu qu'on s'en donne les moyens.

Envie d’imaginer la suite de cette histoire à nos côtés ? Ecrivez-nous !

Nous recherchons les talents d’un(e) Assistant(e) Chef de Produit (H/F) pour rejoindre notre équipe Art de Vivre & Maison à l’occasion d’un stage de 6 mois à partir de Janvier 2027. Ce poste est basé à Paris (75).

Rattaché(e) à la Responsable de Développement des Collections, vos principales responsabilités seront :

  • Suivre et participer au développement des collections ;  
  • Préparer des dossiers de lancement et fiches techniques ;
  • Assurer le suivi et les relances des fournisseurs ; 
  • Mettre à jour les plans de collection ;
  • Interagir avec l’équipe qualité pour chaque lancement ; 
  • Créer et mettre à jour les fiche produit des lancements validés ; 
  • Collecter et analyser les prix des modèles ainsi que les consommations de matières et d’accessoires auprès des façonniers.

Requirements

  • Vous êtes étudiant(e) en école de commerce ou équivalent universitaire et vous recherchez un stage de 6 mois en fin d’étude
  • Vous êtes dynamique, proactif(ve), et vous aimez travailler en équipe ;
  • Rigoureux(se) et organisé(e), vous avez le sens des responsabilités et une bonne capacité à gérer les priorités ;
  • Vous êtes doté(e) d’une forte sensibilité produit ;
  • Vous maîtrisez les outils informatiques et parlez couramment Anglais.

Sézane recrute et valorise tous les talents, quels que soient votre genre, âge, nationalité, culture, croyances religieuses et orientations sexuelles.

Vous vous êtes reconnu(e) dans ce descriptif et souhaitez rejoindre l’aventure Sézane ? Alors n’attendez plus !

title: SAP SuccessFactors Consultant (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at IBS Schreiber GmbH
description_html:
Deine Aufgaben

Als SAP SuccessFactors Consultant (m/w/d) gestaltest du gemeinsam mit uns die sichere SAP-Welt von morgen. Dich erwarten spannende Prüfungs- und Beratungsprojekte rund um moderne SAP-Technologien wie S/4HANA, SuccessFactors, SAP BTP und innovative Security-Lösungen. Wenn du technologische Neugier, Beratungskompetenz und Begeisterung für KI-gestützte Arbeitsweisen mitbringst, bieten wir dir ein Umfeld, in dem du Verantwortung übernehmen, Kunden begeistern und dich kontinuierlich weiterentwickeln kannst.

Vollzeit (39h/Woche) II Hamburg (Hybrid) oder full-remote
 
Du passt perfekt zu uns, wenn Du Spaß hast,...

  • Unsere Kunden in Security- & Berechtigungsfragen innerhalb der SAP-Welt mit Schwerpunkt in den SuccessFactors Modulen, Concur und SAP HCM zu beraten
  • Dich idealerweise mit Security-Tools wie z.B. SAP Access Control, SAP IAG, One Identity Manager, Pathlock SAST, Xiting XAMS etc. zu befassen
  • mit Hilfe von Generativer KI unsere Produkte und deine Arbeitsabläufe zu verbessern
  • in Prüfungsaufträgen und Beratungsprojekten bei unseren Kunden eine leitende Rolle zu übernehmen
  • interne und externe Workshops zu Themen in HR-Prozessen (Security & Berechtigungen) durchzuführen


Dein Profil

  • du ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium in Informatik, Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung mitbringst
  • mehrjährige Kenntnisse im Bereich Human Ressource Cloud Technologien gesammelt hast und dich gut in den SAP SuccessFactors Module Employee Central, Time Management, Recruiting, Onboarding, Learning, Performance & Goals, Succession & Development, Compensation, Analytics auskennst
  • dich idealerweise auch gut mit Concur und externer HR-Software auskennst
  • gerne selbstständig, analytisch und konzeptionell
  • du über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (mind. B2) und gute Englischkenntnisse verfügst


Warum wir?

Wir sind für dich der richtige Arbeitgeber, weil:

  • uns ein familiäres Arbeitsklima wichtig ist
  • wir als Pionier im Bereich SAP Security & Berechtigungsanalysen neue Wege gehen
  • du deine Arbeit auch von zu Hause durchführen kannst
  • dir eine flache Hierarchie wichtig ist
  • wir dir die Möglichkeit geben wollen, dich weiterzuentwickeln
  • wir dir einen unbefristeten Arbeitsvertrag anbieten

 Du kannst dich außerdem freuen auf:
  • 30 Tage Urlaub
  • eine 39h/ Woche
  • Zusatzkrankenversicherung
  • betriebliche Altersvorsorge
  • kostenfreier Tiefgaragenstellplatz
  • Kaffee, Wasser und Obst
  • HVV-Fahrkartenzuschuss oder
  • Edenred-Gutschein oder
  • Leasingbike oder
  • EGYM-Wellpass (Sportabo)

description_html:
Aircall is a unicorn, AI-powered customer communications platform used by 22,000+ companies worldwide to drive revenue, resolve issues faster, and scale customer-facing teams. We’re redefining customer communications by bringing voice, SMS, WhatsApp, and AI together into one seamless workspace.

Our momentum comes from a simple idea: help teams work smarter, not harder. Aircall’s AI Voice Agent automates routine calls, AI Assist streamlines post-call work, and AI Assist Pro delivers real-time guidance so people can do their best work. The result is higher revenue, faster resolutions, and teams that scale with confidence.

Aircall is headquartered in Paris, our European HQ, with a strong North American presence anchored in Seattle, our North American HQ, and teams across Madrid, London, Berlin, San Francisco, New York City, Sydney, and Mexico City. We’ve built a product customers love and a business that’s scaling quickly, backed by world-class investors and driven by rapid AI innovation across multiple product lines.
At Aircall, you’ll join a company in motion. We’re ambitious, product-driven, and execution-focused, with visible impact, fast decisions, and real growth.

This role is ideal for someone with strong communication skills, discretion, attention to detail, and a willingness to learn and grow within a fast-paced remote work environment.

As an Office Assistant, you will help support daily administrative operations, assist with entry-level bookkeeping, organize client documents, support internal reporting, and help maintain accurate company records. This position offers strong growth potential for the right candidate, including opportunities for advancement within the Accounting team or other departments.

We are looking for talented and diligent candidates who perform well on our skills assessments. Strong skills test performance may be considered even if a candidate does not meet every preferred experience or educational background requirement.

 

Why Join Coalition Technologies?

Coalition Technologies is committed to delivering high-quality work for our clients while providing our team with a fun, thriving, innovative, and growth-focused work environment. We offer:

  • 100% remote work with a company that has supported remote team members for more than a decade
  • Competitive profit-sharing bonus plan, with up to 50% of company profits paid to full-time employees each month
  • Competitive Paid Time Off plan that supports work-life balance
  • Subsidized gym memberships
  • Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance packages for eligible US-based team members
  • International Health Insurance Reimbursement Program for eligible international team members
  • Device upgrade and learning reimbursement programs
  • Career development plans with clearly defined goals and rewards
  • Additional job-specific incentives and bonuses

 

Office Assistant Responsibilities

As an Office Assistant, your duties will include:

  • Answering phones and emails
  • Completing entry-level bookkeeping tasks, including recording expenses, organizing receipts, and maintaining transaction records
  • Resolving billing issues with clients and internal team members
  • Providing account access, usage reports, data analysis, and other ad hoc support for team members
  • Supporting quality assurance checks for internal and client-facing reports
  • Organizing new client contracts, creating invoices, and processing client payments
  • Contributing to internal database maintenance, upkeep, and data entry
  • Researching, ordering, and distributing company-wide gifts two to three times per year
  • Organizing company events, competitions, and special projects throughout the year
  • Facilitating company holiday calendars, time-off calendars, and schedule variation calendars

 

Required Skills and Qualifications

The ideal candidate will have:

  • Willingness to learn, grow, and collaborate with the team and company as a whole
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • High level of discretion, ethics, and trustworthiness
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
  • Ability to support administrative, bookkeeping, billing, reporting, and data entry tasks
  • Innovative thinking and willingness to challenge existing methods when improvement is possible
  • Availability to work 40 hours per week, Monday through Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. Pacific Time
  • Reliable remote workspace with a fast computer, quality internet, camera, microphone, and speakers

 

Preferred Skills

  • The following experience is preferred but not required:
  • Intermediate spreadsheet skills
  • Experience with bookkeeping or financial record keeping
  • Experience with Google Sheets, Microsoft Excel, QuickBooks Online, and Google Workspace
  • Experience supporting billing, invoicing, reporting, data entry, or administrative operations

 

Remote Work Environment

Coalition Technologies is a fully remote company. Our team works remotely with the support of time tracking software, structured communication, and a company culture designed to help remote team members succeed. We have supported remote team members for more than a decade and welcome qualified applicants from around the world.

 

Growth Opportunity

This position offers a strong opportunity for growth. Successful Office Assistants at Coalition Technologies have advanced quickly and earned promotions within the Accounting team and across other departments.

 

Compensation

For candidates located in California, New York, Washington, and Colorado, the starting base pay for this position ranges from $15 to $25 per hour. Compensation may vary based on factors such as experience, qualifications, skills test performance, geographic location, and seniority of the position offered. For candidates outside of California, New York, Washington, and Colorado, compensation may fall outside the listed range.

company.headquarters: France, Japan, Turkey, Vietnam, Mexico, Norway

salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at iMerit Technology
description_html:
iMerit is looking for detail oriented analysts to evaluate and rank AI generated responses to image based prompts. You will judge answers on accuracy, relevance, clarity, conciseness, safety, localization, and how well they follow the user's instructions, then explain your reasoning in writing.
Much of the job comes down to this: look at the image, look at what the model said about it, and decide whether the two actually match.

What you will do

  • Interpret conversational context and identify what the user really wanted

  • Rate and rank responses against defined quality criteria

  • Compare multiple answers and explain in writing why one wins

  • Verify factual claims using approved research sources

  • Flag tasks that cannot be reliably assessed rather than guessing

What you bring:

  • Strong critical thinking and sound judgment in ambiguous cases

  • Solid research skills and attention to detail

  • Excellent reading comprehension

  • Self direction and the discipline to hit deadlines without supervision

Good to know

  • Independent contractor engagement for the length of the project. 

  • Fully remote and flexible.

  • You choose your hours as long as volume and deadlines are met.

  • Task volume varies with project demand.

title: Data Scientist - Music Promotion
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Spotify
description_text: The Music Mission enables Music creators to grow, engage & monetize their fan bases on Spotify. Central to the Music Mission's vision is the development of promotional tools for artist and label teams, powered by Spotify's deep knowledge of listener behavior. Products like Discovery Mode, Marquee, Showcase, Music Videos and Clips enable artists and their teams to grow, monetize and connect with their audience. We're looking for a Data Scientist to join Discovery Mode, part of the Music Mission. Discovery Mode helps artists and music marketers reach new listeners when it matters most. Artists and labels flag priority songs, and our system feeds that signal into the algorithms behind personalized playlists. In this role, you'll partner with product, engineering, and user research to build the technology that powers Discovery Mode. Your focus will be customer engagement and reporting — understanding what customers need, building instrumentation and dashboards for our self-serve product, and running experiments that improve the experience and drive business impact. As part of the Product Insights team, you'll help define the next generation of promotion products for the music industry.

title: Director of Engineering - Content Platform (Catalog)
salary_basis: Based on leadership compensation records at Spotify
description_text: We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify. This position sits at the heart of Spotify’s Content Platform, responsible for the systems that define, structure, and govern content across the platform. Our mission is to provide a trusted, consistent source of truth so content can be reliably managed and reused across every Spotify experience. We build and operate the core systems and workflows that ensure content is accurate, complete, and available, from APIs and lifecycle orchestration through to content quality and integrity. As Spotify’s content ecosystem continues to grow in scale and complexity across new formats, use cases, and regulatory environments, this domain plays a critical role in helping us scale intentionally while maintaining the trust and quality our users and creators expect. We’re seeking a Director of Engineering to lead this domain, shaping its technical direction, developing teams, and evolving the systems that underpin Spotify’s global content platform.

title: Inside Sales Contractor
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Credit Wellness, LLC
description_html:
About Us

We are a financial services start up focusing on helping to improve consumer credit profiles. We are currently seeking KPI driven sales representatives looking to earn up to 45K in their first year while working remotely. We offer comprehensive training and continuous sales coaching to help you meet your financial goals.

During our training period we offer a guaranteed training stipend while our trainees are acclimating to the position (*see weekly pay below). If you are a seasoned sales professional looking for the autonomy of a remote position combined with great compensation, we want to hear from you!

Compensation Structure

This role is 100% commission-based, which means your earning potential is unlimited. In addition, we regularly offer competitive performance-based bonuses to reward hard work and results.

Training Period (Weeks 1–4)

We invest in your success and want to make sure you’re supported as you get up to speed:

  • Week 1: Commission-only (a chance to start earning right away while learning the ropes).

  • Weeks 2–4: Guaranteed training stipend of $500 USD total – or your commission if it’s higher. You’ll always receive whichever amount benefits you most.

    • Week 0: Unpaid

    • Week 1: $100 guaranteed minimum

    • Week 2: $150 guaranteed minimum

    • Week 3: $250 guaranteed minimum

By the end of training, you’ll have the skills to maximize commissions, with the safety net of a guaranteed base during your ramp-up period.

Post Training Period:

  • Average first year OTE: 25K-35K (US) Annually

  • Top Rep first year OTE: 35K-45K (US) Annually

*The above is the average pay you can expect, however, there is unlimited earning potential for those who are financially motivated top performers looking to exceed sales targets.

What will you be doing?

Educating inbound callers on their credit standing by providing consultations with the goal of enrolling them in one of our services should they be a good fit.

We are looking for team members who are:

  • Tech savvy with the ability to navigate digital tools such as SLACK, CRM software, google sheets, etc. Our team uses these digital tools daily.

  • Growth oriented and always looking to learn and acquire new skills.

  • Autonomous self starters who can work independently and efficiently.

  • Team players with the ability to implement feedback from their sales coaches.

  • Patient and professional with clients. Finances can be a difficult topic for some clients to discuss. We are looking for individuals who showcase empathy and professionalism especially under pressure!

  • Financially motivated individuals who can meet and exceed sales targets.

  • Outgoing with outstanding rapport building and active listening skills. Can you carry a conversation with anyone? This may be for you!

You will need:

  • Home office or a quiet place to work.

  • Strong internet connection.

  • Desktop or laptop

(*Please Note: Devices such as Chromebooks, IPADs and laptops with 8G’s of RAM and under will have issues supporting our system)

Scheduling

Training: The schedule for the first four weeks of our training period is 10 AM - 6 PM EST.

*The first week of training is mandatory for all new trainees. If a day is missed you may be asked to restart the first week of training.

Post Training:

We are currently seeking representatives to work on the following schedule:

Monday - Friday

Shift hours to be discussed with our hiring manager based on our company's needs at the time of hire. Shifts are as follows:

  • 8:00 AM - 4:00 PM EST

  • 8:30 AM - 4:30 PM EST

  • 9:00 AM - 5:00 AM EST

  • 9:30 AM - 5:30 PM EST

  • 10:00 AM - 6:00 PM EST

  • 10:30 AM - 6:30 PM EST

  • 11:00 AM - 7:00 PM EST

  • 11:30 AM - 7:30 PM EST

  • 12:30 PM - 8:30 PM EST

  • 1:30 PM - 9:30 PM EST

  • 2:30 PM - 10:30 PM EST

  • 3:00 PM - 11:00 PM EST

Job Type: Contract

Shift:

  • 8 hour shift

  • Day shift

  • Evening shift

  • Morning shift

  • Night shift

Supplemental Pay:

  • Bonus opportunities

  • Commission pay

Experience:

  • Sales: 1 year (Required)

Work Location: Remote

title: Tier III Service Desk Engineer
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Unio Digital
description_html:
Unió Digital is an Arizona-based managed service provider (MSP) delivering Managed IT Services, Low Voltage Cabling, Access Control, Video Surveillance, and Intrusion Services. We believe technology should be intuitive, not intimidating.

 

We are looking for an experienced Tier 3 Service Desk Technician with exceptional problem-solving skills. You will serve as the escalation point within the team, resolving complex technical issues while also leading client onboarding and project initiatives. You are expected to be involved in direct end-user support when required. If you have a passion for ensuring top-quality user support and thrive in a collaborative environment, this role is for you.

 

Duties

 

·       Lead and support our helpdesk environment for managed service clients

 

·       Coordinate and manage client projects, acting as a bridge between the technical team and the client to ensure project success

 

·       Provide above and beyond support to our clients and respond to queries for technical assistance in person, via phone, or electronically as required

 

·       Provide training and support to clients during the onboarding process to ensure they understand how to effectively use their new IT systems and services.

 

·       Develop project plans for client onboarding and standardization projects, outlining tasks, resources required, and estimated timelines

 

·       Install, configure, diagnose, test and resolve technical hardware and software issues

 

·       Maintain and update written client and process documentation to ensure effective knowledge management

 

·       Provide mentorship and guidance to Tier I and Tier II service desk technicians, fostering a collaborative and knowledgeable team environment

 

·       Contribute to the development and improvement of IT service management processes and practices

 

·       Evaluate and anticipate IT trends and recommend strategies and implement improvement initiatives

 

Our Technology Stack

 

·       Helpdesk / Ticketing – HaloPSA

 

·       Documentation – Hudu

 

·       RMM – Intune / Immybot

 

·       Networking – Meraki

 

·       Email/Calendar/Voice/AD – Microsoft 365

 

·       Security Cameras – Rhombus / Avigilon

 

·       Door Access – Avigilon

 

Qualification

 

·       6+ years of experience providing IT services and end-user support

 

·       Prior experience at a managed service provider is critical to understand the fast-paced nature of the industry

 

·       Client-oriented approach with a passion for delivering high-quality customer service

 

·       Proven experience leading IT projects

 

·       A self-starter who is eager to expand their qualifications

 

·       Background in providing direct end-user support

 

·       High level of attention to detail

 

·       Excellent verbal and written communication skills

 

·       IT-related degree and/or certifications (Cisco, A+, Network+, Microsoft, or equivalent)

 

·       Advanced technical knowledge, including experience with Azure AD, Active Directory, Intune, or other RMM agents

 

Our Core Values

 

Dream Big, Then Make it Real

 

We flex our imagination and challenge ourselves to a higher standard.  Do, rather than talk and tell.

 

Client Driven Results

 

Clients trust us to find solutions that deliver exceptional results.  When they succeed, we succeed.

 

Own Your Progress

 

We continuously improve through rapid innovation and embracing our mistakes.  Own it means a relentless pursuit of the solution.

 

We Do It Right…even when no one’s watching. Period.

title: Freelance Writer
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at IAPWE
description_html:
Our organization is seeking content writers to create articles and blog posts on a variety of topics.

 

The rate of pay is $20 per 100 words (this comes out to approximately $100 per article or $50 per hour).

 

Some topics you may be asked to write about include the following (you can always turn down a topic if you do not feel comfortable writing about it, however if you have experience or expertise in a specific area, please let us know):

 

  • Health & beauty
  • Fitness
  • Home Decor
  • Fashion
  • Sports
  • Do it yourself
  • Finance
  • Legal
  • Medical
  • Family/Parenting
  • Relationships
  • Real Estate
  • Restaurants
  • Contracting (plumbing, pool building, remodeling, etc.)

 

These are just some of the more general industries and topics that we cover.

 

Requirements:

  • We ask that all work be completed using a word processor such as Microsoft Word or Open Office
  • A reliable internet connection and the ability to meet deadlines
  • Good communication skills and respond in a timely manner to editorial staff when they ask for updates on tasks, etc
  • Work well as a team member with the rest of our content management and editorial staff



Note: Applicants to this job signaled that accessing some writing tasks may require payment.

description_text: We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify. Content Platform is responsible for the full content lifecycle at Spotify — from ingestion through to delivery — across music, podcasts, and audiobooks. We ensure content is structured, evaluated, and delivered reliably at global scale, powered by deep content understanding. We bring valuable content to users while ensuring it remains trusted and high-quality over time. The Product Insights team works across the full content lifecycle to improve decision-making, improve our catalog understanding and ensure one of the world’s largest content catalogs is safe and engaging. We’re looking for a Staff Data Scientist to join the team and tackle complex, high-impact problems by combining strategic thinking with hands-on, tactical execution.

title: Freelance Copywriter
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Coalition Technologies
description_html:
CT Marketing Agency is seeking skilled Freelance Copywriters to write high-quality, SEO-driven content for eCommerce and lead generation websites. This is a freelance, project-based writing role.

 

The ideal candidate has excellent English writing skills, strong research ability, and experience writing content that follows detailed, client-specific guidelines. Projects commonly include category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, SEO landing pages, and website copy.

 

About the Role

Our client base is constantly evolving, and writers may create content across a wide range of industries, including:

  • Fashion, including mass-market and luxury brands
  • Skincare and beauty
  • Tech and software
  • Finance and investing
  • Law, including family law, divorce, and product liability
  • Education
  • Home improvement
  • Automobiles and motorcycles
  • Health and wellness
  • Medical and clinical fields
  • Digital marketing
  • SEO, PR, advertising, and marketing

Writers with experience in highly specialized industries such as tech, finance, law, health, medical, SEO, PR, advertising, or marketing are strongly encouraged to apply.

Responsibilities
  • Write clear, engaging, SEO-friendly content for eCommerce and lead generation websites
  • Create category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, landing pages, and website copy
  • Research client industries, products, services, audiences, and competitors
  • Follow detailed client guidelines and adapt to different brand voices
  • Blend SEO best practices with brand priorities and conversion-focused writing
  • Complete assignments by deadline and communicate professionally with the team

Qualifications
  • Excellent English writing, grammar, editing, and proofreading skills
  • 2 to 4 years of professional, non-academic writing experience preferred
  • Strong understanding of SEO writing best practices
  • Ability to research unfamiliar industries and technical topics
  • Ability to write creative, engaging, accurate, and ROI-focused content
  • Portfolio featuring published work preferred
  • Experience in specialized industries strongly preferred

Compensation

Writers are paid on a per-word basis. Rates are assessed according to our KPI rubric.

Initial compensation is up to $0.06 per word, with $0.034 per word being the most typical rate

This equals approximately $30 or $17 per 500-word page

After 400 live pages, the top rate increases to $0.064 per word, with $0.038 per word being the most typical rate

description_text: Spotify’s Propositions team is responsible for what we offer and how we package it — the plans, tiers, and propositions that shape how hundreds of millions of people experience and pay for Spotify. As Manager - Proposition Strategy, you’ll help define how Spotify grows its next billion users by developing affordable, locally relevant propositions, evolving existing tiers, and identifying new opportunities that can unlock sustainable growth. This is a role for someone who thinks in business cases as much as ideas. You’ll take work from an initial hypothesis through to an executive-ready recommendation — building the economics, assessing margin and licensing implications, modeling cannibalization risk, and creating a clear narrative for senior leaders. You’ll work closely with Strategy, Finance, Product, Legal, and Market teams, and your work will directly influence the propositions Spotify brings to some of the world’s fastest-growing markets.

title: Senior React Full-stack Developer
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Lemon.io
description_html:
Are you a talented Senior Developer looking for a remote job that lets you show your skills and get decent compensation? Look no further than Lemon.io — the marketplace that connects you with hand-picked startups in the US and Europe.

 

What we offer:

  • The rate depends on your seniority level, skills and experience. We've already paid out over $11M to our engineers.
  • No more hunting for clients or negotiating rates — let us handle the business side of things so you can focus on what you do best.
  • We'll manually find the best project for you according to your skills and preferences.
  • Choose a schedule that works best for you. It’s possible to communicate async or minimally overlap within team working hours.
  • We respect your seniority so you can expect no micromanagement or screen trackers.
  • Communicate directly with the clients. Most of them have technical backgrounds. Sounds good, yeah?
  • We will support you from the time you submit the application throughout all cooperation stages.
  • Most of our projects involve working in a fast-paced startup environment. We hope you like it as much as we do.
  • Through our community, we will connect you with the best developers from more than 75 countries.

We have several open positions for Full-Stack React.js Developers - please see the details below. We also have some backend positions; the full list is included below as well.

 
Requirements for the Senior Node & React Position:
  • 5+ years of software development experience

Commercial experience:

  • React.js: 3+ years, Node.js: 5+ years, and Next.js: 2+ years
    OR
    React.js: 5+ years, Node.js: 3+ years, and Next.js: 2+ years
  • Expertise in AWS, TypeScript and AI-assisted coding is a must.
 
 

Other requirements:

  • Strong technical skills: as a Senior Developer, you are expected to be able to create projects from scratch and have a deep understanding of application architecture.
  • Clear and effective communication in English — advanced ability to discuss business tasks, justify decisions, and communicate issues. Good self-presentation is also essential for upcoming client calls.
  • Strong self-organizational skills — ability to work full-time remotely with no supervision.
  • Reliability — we want to trust you and expect that you won’t let us and the client down.
  • Adaptability and Flexibility — the ability to onboard the project promptly after accepting it and start delivering results quickly.

 

Sounds good for you?

 

NOT YOUR TECH STACK?

We're placing Senior Developers (4+ yrs commercial experience) across AI Agent Architecture, AI Automation Architecture, AI Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, Platform Engineering, React & Python, React & Golang, Golang, React & Java, React & Ruby, Ruby, PHP & Vue, Vue & Node.js, React & .NET, Android & iOS, iOS & Swift, Flutter & Firebase, Solutions Engineer, Blockchain (Ethereum/Ethers.js/Wagmi/Viem/Solana), Angular & Node.js, Vue & .NET, Python & Vue, DevOps, MLOps, Data Science, Angular & PHP, Angular & .NET, Symfony & React, Symfony & Vue, Symfony & Angular, Python, Symfony & JavaScript & Next.js & TypeScript, Data Analysis, React & PHP, Data Engineering, Project Management, Product Management, QA Automation, QA Manual, Embedded Software Engineering, React Native & Node, React Native & React, React Native & Ruby, React Native & Python, WordPress, Android, Data Annotation, Angular, Python & Node, Java & Spring, Svelte & Python, Svelte & Node.js, Svelte & TypeScript, Rust, Shopify & JavaScript, Vue & Nuxt, PHP & Laravel, UI/UX Design, Animation, Graphic Design, React & Node & React Native, .NET & C#, Electron, Scala, C++, Unreal Engine & C++, Python & LLM, Unity, or Machine Learning Engineering and more. Reach out and we'll match you.We do not provide visa assistance, and our cooperation model does not include the benefits typically offered with direct hire.

 

We work with developers from 75+ countries across Europe, Latin America, North America (the U.S. and Canada), selected countries in Asia (Japan, Singapore, South Korea, the Philippines, Indonesia, Malaysia, Vietnam, Thailand, and Israel), Oceania (Australia, New Zealand, and Papua New Guinea), and Africa (including Morocco and South Africa).

description_html:
Are you a talented Senior DevOps looking for a remote job that lets you show your skills and get decent compensation? Look no further than Lemon.io — the marketplace that connects you with hand-picked startups in the US and Europe.

 

 

We currently have multiple DevOps openings open at once, each with a different setup, stack, and benefits. Check which one fits you:

 

Direct hire for our client in the gambling industry. Relocation and visa assistance included. This role bridges infrastructure and application operations: you’ll keep environments reliable, redundant, and secure, investigate production issues, and support dev and QA teams with technical context.

We're seeking a DevOps Engineer with strong Laravel and Nuxt experience to manage and improve our application infrastructure. This role bridges infrastructure and application operations — you'll keep environments reliable, redundant, and secure, investigate production issues, and support dev and QA teams with technical context.

Benefits: paid leave; gym allowance; lunch allowance; monthly team-building activities; birthday and work anniversary presents.

 

Requirements - DevOps with Linux:

  • 4+ years of experience as a DevOps Engineer
  • At least 3 years of experience with Linux
  • Knowledge of Laravel, PHP, and Nuxt is a must
  • 2+ years of experience with Heroku, DigitalOcean, or Cloudflare

We also have other positions that aren't direct hire.

 

Requirements - DevOps (Python/Bash):

  • 4+ years of experience as a DevOps Engineer

  • At least 3 years of experience with Python or Bash

  • 3+ years of experience with AWS/GCP/Microsoft Azure/Azure DevOps is required

  • Experience in at least 2 commercial projects using Terraform, Kubernetes and SQL is required

  • Strong technical skills: as a Senior DevOps, you are expected to be able to create projects from scratch and have a deep understanding of application architecture.

  • Clear and effective communication in English — advanced ability to discuss business tasks, justify decisions, and communicate issues. Good self-presentation is also essential for upcoming client calls.

  • Strong self-organizational skills — ability to work full-time remotely with no supervision.

  • Reliability — we want to trust you and expect that you won’t let us and the client down.

  • Adaptability and Flexibility — the ability to onboard the project promptly after accepting it and start delivering results quickly.

 

NOT YOUR TECH STACK?

We're placing Senior Developers (4+ yrs commercial experience) across AI Agent Architecture, AI Automation Architecture, AI Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, Platform Engineering, React & Python, React & Golang, Golang, React & Java, React & Ruby, Ruby, PHP & Vue, Vue & Node.js, React & .NET, Android & iOS, iOS & Swift, Flutter & Firebase, Solutions Engineer, Blockchain (Ethereum/Ethers.js/Wagmi/Viem/Solana), Angular & Node.js, Vue & .NET, Python & Vue, MLOps, Data Science, Angular & PHP, Angular & .NET, Symfony & React, Symfony & Vue, Symfony & Angular, Python, Symfony & JavaScript & Next.js & TypeScript, Data Analysis, React & PHP, Data Engineering, Project Management, Product Management, QA Automation, QA Manual, Embedded Software Engineering, React Native & Node, React Native & React, React Native & Ruby, React Native & Python, WordPress, Android, Data Annotation, Angular, Python & Node, React & Node.js, Java & Spring, Svelte & Python, Svelte & Node.js, Svelte & TypeScript, Rust, Shopify & JavaScript, Vue & Nuxt, PHP & Laravel, UI/UX Design, Animation, Graphic Design, React & Node & React Native, .NET & C#, Electron, Scala, C++, Unreal Engine & C++, Python & LLM, Unity, or Machine Learning Engineering and more. Reach out and we'll match you.

 

We do not provide visa assistance, and our cooperation model does not include the benefits typically offered with direct hire.

We work with developers from 75+ countries across Europe, Latin America, North America (the U.S. and Canada), selected countries in Asia (Japan, Singapore, South Korea, the Philippines, Indonesia, Malaysia, Vietnam, Thailand, and Israel), Oceania (Australia, New Zealand, and Papua New Guinea), and Africa (including Morocco and South Africa).

description_text: We are currently looking for a new band member to join the Spotify Tax Team. This new band member will be an Analyst, joining the Global Indirect Tax Team. This position will report into the Senior Manager for Indirect Tax in EMEA and APAC and will be based in Stockholm, Sweden. In your role, you will focus on compliance and reporting. Spotify reports indirect taxes in more than 90 countries globally and you will be a key member of the team responsible for ensuring the completeness, timeliness and accuracy of Spotify’s global indirect tax compliance obligations. You will work in close collaboration with global tax team members in both Stockholm and New York, and work cross functionally with various accounting and finance teams. We are a team of highly skilled and dedicated colleagues and we offer a challenging and dynamic role in an ever changing environment with the opportunity to take on much responsibility in a rapidly growing international company. Above all, your work will impact the way the world experiences audio.

title: Content Reviewer - English US
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at TELUS Digital
description_html:
Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of more than one million contributors from

diverse backgrounds who help customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize

content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and contribute

to the development of innovative AI technologies used by some of the world's largest

brands.

We are looking for an independent, flexible, remote opportunity where you can help

improve AI-powered search technology from the comfort of your home? If you're

curious, internet-savvy, and enjoy evaluating online content, this freelance project could

be a great fit.

 

A Day in the Life of a Content Reviewer - US

In this role, you will analyze and provide feedback on text, webpages, images, and other

types of online content for leading search engines using a specialized online platform.

By reviewing and rating search results for relevance and quality, you will help improve

the overall search experience for millions of users around the world, including yourself.

Join our global community and put your skills to work supporting one of the world's

leading search technologies.

 

Service Rates

The rate of pay is $0.2333 per completed task, with an estimated earning potential of

$14 per hour. Compensation is based on tasks completed and project availability.

Estimated earnings may vary depending on task volume and program requirements

including, quality, and productivity, in accordance with the program's quality standards

and guidelines.

Please note that only one member per household may participate in this program. If it is

identified that more than one person from the same household is participating in the

TELUS Digital Rating Program, all associated accounts may be removed from the

program.

 

Independent Contractor Relationship

This opportunity is offered on an independent contractor basis. Contributors have the

flexibility to choose when and how much they work, subject to project availability and

quality requirements. This opportunity is not and should not be construed as creating an

employment relationship with TELUS Digital.

 

Qualification path

Qualification Process

No previous professional experience is required to apply for this opportunity. However,

participation in this project requires meeting the basic requirements and successfully

completing the qualification process.

 

Basic Requirements

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English

• Must have resided in the United States for the past three consecutive years

• Familiarity with current and historical business, media, sports, news, social media, and

cultural affairs in the United States

• Active use of Gmail and social media platforms

• Experience using web browsers to navigate and interact with a variety of online

content

• Daily access to a reliable broadband internet connection

• Access to a smartphone (Android 5.0 or higher, or iOS 14 or higher)

• Access to a personal computer

 

Assessment

You must complete an English language assessment, pass an open book qualification

exam, and complete an ID verification in order to be successful for this role. These

assessments will determine your suitability for the position.

description_html:
Are you a talented Senior Developer looking for a remote job that lets you show your skills and get decent compensation? Look no further than Lemon.io — the marketplace that connects you with hand-picked startups in the US and Europe.

 

We are currently seeking a Senior Software Engineer for our client — a research-driven artificial intelligence company.

 

The client’s mission is to cut the cost of modern AI by co-designing hardware, software, algorithms, and models — with the goal of making AI’s benefits accessible to society. They’re active contributors to open-source AI research and are looking for researchers and engineers to help build the next generation of AI infrastructure.Cooperation: This starts as contract work via our platform. If it goes well, you’ll transition to a direct hire, with equity, health insurance, and other competitive benefits.

 

Locations: the EU, the US, Canada, the UK, Australia, Singapore

 

About the role:

  • You’d build the Go-based platform that lets research and inference teams provision, scale, repair, and tear down GPU clusters through an API - instead of filing tickets.
  • You’d own the product end to end: shaping internal platforms, improving developer experience, and operating the systems in production.

 

Requirements:

  • 5+ years of software development experience

  • 3+ years of experience with Golang and Kubernetes controllers

  • Knowledge of Temporal is a must

 

  • Strong technical skills: as a Senior Developer, you are expected to be able to create projects from scratch and have a deep understanding of application architecture.

  • Clear and effective communication in English — advanced ability to discuss business tasks, justify decisions, and communicate issues. Good self-presentation is also essential for upcoming client calls.

  • Strong self-organizational skills — ability to work full-time remotely with no supervision.

  • Reliability — we want to trust you and expect that you won’t let us and the client down.

  • Adaptability and Flexibility — the ability to onboard the project promptly after accepting it and start delivering results quickly.

 

Sounds good for you? Apply now and join the Lemon.io community!

 

NOT YOUR TECH STACK?We have a variety of projects, so if you have 4+ years of commercial software development experience and are proficient in AI Agent Architecture, AI Automation Architecture, AI Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, Platform Engineering, React & Python, React & Golang, React & Java, React & Ruby, Ruby, PHP & Vue, Vue & Node.js, React & .NET, Android & iOS, iOS & Swift, Flutter & Dart, Blockchain (Ethereum/Ethers.js/Wagmi/Viem/Solana), Angular & Node.js, Vue & .NET, Python & Vue, DevOps, MLOps, Data Science, Angular & PHP, Angular & .NET, Symfony & React, Symfony & Vue, Symfony & Angular, Python, Symfony & JavaScript & Next.js & TypeScript, Data Analysis, React & PHP, Data Engineering, Project Management, Product Management, QA Automation, QA Manual, Embedded Software Engineering, React Native & Node, React Native & React, React Native & Ruby, React Native & Python, WordPress, Android, Data Annotation, Angular, Python & Node, React & Node.js, Java & Spring, Svelte & Python, Svelte & Node.js, Svelte & TypeScript, Rust, Shopify & JavaScript, Vue & Nuxt, PHP & Laravel, UI/UX Design, Animation, Graphic Design, React & Node & React Native, .NET & C#, Electron, Scala, C++, Unreal Engine & C++, Python & LLM, Unity, or Machine Learning Engineering, we would be happy to connect with you and match you with a project that fits your experience.

 

We do not provide visa assistance, and our cooperation model does not include the benefits typically offered with direct hire.

We work with developers from 75+ countries across Europe, Latin America, North America (the U.S. and Canada), selected countries in Asia (Japan, Singapore, South Korea, the Philippines, Indonesia, Malaysia, Vietnam, Thailand, and Israel), Oceania (Australia, New Zealand, and Papua New Guinea), and Africa (including Morocco and South Africa).

title: Senior Data Engineer
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Lemon.io
description_html:
Are you a talented Senior Data Engineer looking for a remote job that lets you show your skills and get decent compensation? Look no further than Lemon.io — the marketplace that connects you with hand-picked startups in the US and Europe.

 

What we offer:

  • The rate depends on your skills and experience. We've already paid out over $11M to our engineers.
  • No more hunting for clients or negotiating rates — let us handle the business side of things so you can focus on what you do best.
  • We'll manually find the best project for you according to your skills and preferences.
  • Choose a schedule that works best for you. It’s possible to communicate async or minimally overlap within team working hours.
  • We respect your seniority so you can expect no micromanagement or screen trackers.
  • Communicate directly with the clients. Most of them have technical backgrounds. Sounds good, yeah?
  • We will support you from the time you submit the application throughout all cooperation stages.
  • Most of our projects involve working in a fast-paced startup environment. We hope you like it as much as we do.
  • Through our community, we will connect you with the best developers from more than 75 countries.

We have several different roles for Data Engineers — please check the details if you're interested.

 

Requirements — Data Engineers:

  • 5+ years of commercial experience as a Data Engineer
  • 2+ years of commercial experience with Azure DevOps is a must
  • 2+ years of commercial experience with Databricks
  • 2+ years of experience with DBT is required
  • Experience with Airflow is a plus

 

Requirements — Data Engineers:

  • 4+ years of commercial experience as a Data Engineer

  • 3+ years of experience with Apache Airflow and 2+ years of experience with Snowflake

  • 3+ years of experience with Python and 1+ year with SQL

  • Experience with AWS/GCP/Microsoft Azure/Snowflake is a must

 

  • Strong technical skills: as a Senior Data Engineer, you are expected to be able to create projects from scratch and have a deep understanding of application architecture.

  • Clear and effective communication in English — advanced ability to discuss business tasks, justify decisions, and communicate issues. Good self-presentation is also essential for upcoming client calls.

  • Strong self-organizational skills — ability to work full-time remotely with no supervision.

  • Reliability — we want to trust you and expect that you won’t let us and the client down.

  • Adaptability and Flexibility — the ability to onboard the project promptly after accepting it and start delivering results quickly.

title: Senior Product Quality Analyst - AI Voice
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Spotify
description_text: The Personalization team makes deciding what to play next easier and more enjoyable for every listener. From Blend to Discover Weekly, we’re behind some of Spotify’s most-loved features. We built them by understanding the world of music and podcasts better than anyone else. Join us and you’ll keep millions of users listening by making great recommendations to each and every one of them. We are the Voice Production Team, the creative team behind Spotify’s AI voice experiences. We think about AI voices from a casting perspective — including voice type, age and gender — and from a performance perspective, recognizing that a voice may need to perform differently for DJ than it does for an audiobook recap. We bring expertise in voice casting, direction, recording and production, and work closely with Speak to set the quality bar for AI voice models across experiences including AI DJ, Generative AI Ads, Personalized Podcasts, Agent Voice Chat and more. As a Senior Product Quality Analyst, you’ll bring a dedicated evaluation perspective to the team. You’ll own how we define and measure AI voice quality, bringing together Voice Production’s creative bar, Speak’s technical bar and the wider industry bar. Your goal won’t simply be to determine whether Spotify has the “best” AI voice technology on the market. You’ll help us answer a more important question: is our technology the best at serving Spotify’s specific needs?

title: Director of ML Engineering - Conversation Product Area
salary_basis: Based on leadership compensation records at Spotify
description_text: The Personalization team makes deciding what to play next easier and more enjoyable for every listener. From Blend to Discover Weekly, we're behind some of Spotify's most-loved features. We built them by understanding the world of music and podcasts better than anyone else. Join us and you'll keep millions of users listening by making great recommendations to each and every one of them. Spotify's Personalization mission (PZN) is building the single intelligence layer that powers how hundreds of millions of people discover and experience audio. One agent, one reasoning engine, and one taste model, moving to a unified single stack. We're looking for a Director of Engineering to lead the Conversation Product Area. The Conversation Product Area is the technical center of gravity for the shift to one Agent, building the shared Agent Engine harness and the evaluation infrastructure that supports it. The Product Area also owns the Search Brain (intent routing and search-driven conversation) the intent-detection and prompt-suggestion platform behind our agentic consumer features like Chat and AI DJ, and the Speak Platform, Spotify's first-party voice team, which spans applied research, production infrastructure, and the character/brand decisions behind every voice Spotify users hear. This is the engineering org where architecture decisions get made that power every agentic surface at the company. You'll be working with many of Spotify's senior architects, with product leadership in the consumer AI space, and with cross functional partners. The team needs a leader who is as comfortable making critical architectural calls as they are managing the people making them.

description_text: Spotify is looking for a Marketing Manager to lead our marketing strategy and execution in Taiwan. This is a hands-on, high-impact role for someone who can set strategy, lead integrated campaigns, create scroll-stopping social content, and make Spotify one of the most talked-about brands in one of Asia's most vibrant music markets. Taiwan is the birthplace of Mandopop and a cultural tastemaker for the broader Chinese-speaking world. Growing the Spotify brand and business in this market demands genuine cultural fluency, a deep understanding of what resonates across social platforms, strong relationships within the music and creative industries, and the ability to turn insights into bold, locally relevant campaigns that grow our listener base and strengthen our connection with fans and artists. Reporting to the SEA Head of Marketing, you'll work closely with cross-functional teams across Taiwan and the wider region to shape strategy, deliver impactful campaigns, and represent the Taiwan market at a regional and global level. You'll partner with teams across Music, Growth, Communications, Business Development, Partnerships, and other functions to bring Spotify's brand to life in Taiwan and help unlock new opportunities for growth.

With scale comes complexity. You will focus on tackling payment fraud, chargebacks/disputes, creator onboarding and platform misuse that risks revenue leakage and partner trust. As a 12-month cover, you will seamlessly step into our ongoing operations, keeping our momentum strong while bringing fresh perspectives to our workflows. You will work with a global team of world-class business managers, data scientists, product managers, and engineers to build robust operational defenses. If you have a keen eye for detail, strong analytical skills, and a drive to stay one step ahead of fraudsters using cutting-edge technologies, we want to hear from you!

Join the Monaco squad, where we create the internal products that enable Spotify teams to launch, configure, and manage Premium offers with confidence. From subscriptions and prepaid products to pricing updates and promotional campaigns, our tools support business-critical operations through intuitive experiences, trusted workflows, and reliable platform services. As a Fullstack Engineer, you'll develop end-to-end solutions spanning modern web applications, backend services, and data platforms. Working closely with engineers, product managers, designers, and business partners, you'll help create the tools that enable Spotify's global subscription business to innovate safely, efficiently, and at scale.

title: Product & Regulatory Operations Manager
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Spotify
description_text: Spotify’s Legal team is growing. We’re facing innovative challenges that mirror the ground-breaking industry and product at the heart of our company. As we’ve expanded into more than 184 countries and our company has grown tremendously, we find ourselves facing new and interesting legal issues every day. Legal Affairs sits at the heart of this mission, ensuring that Spotify meets its obligations under an evolving global regulatory landscape while championing user safety, transparency, and trust. Spotify’s Product & Regulatory team within Legal Affairs leads the company’s global approach to digital-platform regulation. We drive the operational backbone of Spotify's approach to digital-platform regulation—managing the workflows, documentation, and cross-functional coordination needed to comply with laws like the EU Digital Markets Act (DMA), EU Digital Services Act (DSA), the UK Online Safety Act (UK OSA), the Australian Online Safety Act (AUS OSA), and similar frameworks worldwide. Working closely with Legal stakeholders, Trust & Safety, Public Policy, Product, Design, and Engineering, we turn regulatory requirements into well-managed processes and keep them on track. We’re looking for a resourceful operator who can own the day-to-day machinery of our product and regulatory compliance work—document management, regulatory monitoring, terms updates, and cross-functional special projects. If you’re a self-starter who thrives on bringing order to complexity and keeping programs moving, we’d love to hear from you.

All of our products will put artists and songwriters first, through these four principles: Partnerships with record labels, distributors, and music publishers: We’ll develop new products for artists and fans through upfront agreements, not by asking for forgiveness later. We will leverage our role as the place where more than 700 million people already come to listen to music every month to ensure that generative AI deepens artist-fan connections. salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Spotify
description_text: Spotify’s mission is to unlock the potential of human creativity by giving a million creative artists the opportunity to live off their art and billions of fans the chance to enjoy and be passionate about these creators. Data is a means to an end, and Spotify extracts value from data through application. The Data Platform Studio helps Spotify win by enabling the application of data in an intuitive and efficient way. Data Platform is responsible for how data is collected, processed, stored, governed, and made available to the thousands of engineers, data scientists, analysts, and machine learning practitioners who build Spotify’s products. As AI agents increasingly generate code, write data pipelines, and power personalized user experiences, Data Platform sits at the center of one of the most important infrastructure domains at Spotify. We're looking for a passionate Product Manager to join the team responsible for Spotify’s data catalogue, metadata, and data lineage capabilities. In this role, you'll own the strategy and roadmap for a critical part of Spotify's data ecosystem, helping users discover, understand, trust, and safely use data at scale. You'll work closely with engineers, designers, data scientists, and product teams across Spotify to make working with data faster, safer, and more intuitive.

description_text: Spotify’s Global Experiential and Content Production team is seeking an Associate Director with well-rounded content and event production experience to join our team. salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Spotify
description_text: We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join the Subscriptions Mission. Our team grows Spotify’s audience by finding future listeners around the world and delivering the right value to them, at the right time. With research, product development, product design, engineering, and marketing all collaborating in one organization, we’re able to quickly create meaningful features and services for millions of people around the world, resulting in joyful, long-lasting relationships with Spotify.
